[No.2] Robust Graph Condensation via Classification Complexity Mitigation
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 稳健的图凝聚通过分类复杂性缓解
类别: deep learning
作者: Jiayi Luo;Qingyun Sun;Beining Yang;Haonan Yuan;Xingcheng Fu;Yanbiao Ma;Jianxin Li;Philip S. Yu;
机构: Zhongguancun Academy;Beihang University;;Guangxi Normal University;Renmin University of China;Xidian University;University of Illinois at Chicago;
类型: Spotlight
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=vATe64ktAo
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.26451
英摘: Graph condensation (GC) has gained significant attention for its ability to synthesize smaller yet informative graphs. However, existing studies often overlook the robustness of GC in scenarios where the original graph is corrupted. In such cases, we observe that the performance of GC deteriorates significantly, while existing robust graph learning technologies offer only limited effectiveness. Through both empirical investigation and theoretical analysis, we reveal that GC is inherently an intrinsic-dimension-reducing process, synthesizing a condensed graph with lower classification complexity. Although this property is critical for effective GC performance, it remains highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. To tackle this vulnerability and improve GC robustness, we adopt the geometry perspective of graph data manifold and propose a novel Manifold-constrained Robust Graph Condensation framework named MRGC. Specifically, we introduce three graph data manifold learning modules that guide the condensed graph to lie within a smooth, low-dimensional manifold with minimal class ambiguity, thereby preserving the classification complexity reduction capability of GC and ensuring robust performance under universal adversarial attacks. Extensive experiments demonstrate the robustness of \ModelName\ across diverse attack scenarios.
中摘: 图凝聚（GC）因其能够合成更小但更具信息量的图而引起了广泛关注。然而，现有研究往往忽视了在原始图被篡改的情况下GC的鲁棒性。在这种情况下，我们观察到GC的性能显著下降，而现有的鲁棒图学习技术也只能提供有限的有效性。通过实证研究和理论分析，我们揭示了GC本质上是一个降低内在维度的过程，它生成一个分类复杂度较低的凝聚图。尽管这一特性对于有效GC性能至关重要，但它仍然高度易受对抗性扰动的影响。为了应对这一脆弱性并提高GC的鲁棒性，我们采用了图数据流形的几何视角，并提出了一种新的约束鲁棒图凝聚框架，名为MRGC。具体而言，我们引入了三个图数据流形学习模块，引导凝聚图位于一个光滑且低维的流形上，同时具有最小的类别模糊性，从而保持GC的分类复杂度降低能力，并确保在通用对抗性攻击下的稳健性能。广泛的实验表明，\ModelName\ 在多种攻击场景下具有鲁棒性。

[No.5] Towards Understanding the Mechanisms of Classifier-Free Guidance
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 理解无分类引导机制
类别: deep learning
作者: Xiang Li;Rongrong Wang;Qing Qu;
机构: University of Michigan;Michigan State University;
类型: Spotlight
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=bRAm7A02Qm
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.19210
英摘: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a core technique powering state-of-the-art image generation systems, yet its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we begin by analyzing CFG in a simplified linear diffusion model, where we show its behavior closely resembles that observed in the nonlinear case. Our analysis reveals that linear CFG improves generation quality via three distinct components: (i) a mean-shift term that approximately steers samples in the direction of class means, (ii) a positive Contrastive Principal Components (CPC) term that amplifies class-specific features, and (iii) a negative CPC term that suppresses generic features prevalent in unconditional data. We then verify these insights in real-world, nonlinear diffusion models: over a broad range of noise levels, linear CFG resembles the behavior of its nonlinear counterpart. Although the two eventually diverge at low noise levels, we discuss how the insights from the linear analysis still shed light on the CFG's mechanism in the nonlinear regime.
中摘: 无分类引导（Classifier-Free Guidance, CFG）是推动先进图像生成系统的核心技术之一，但其背后的机制仍不甚明了。在本研究中，我们首先在简化的一维扩散模型中分析了CFG，展示了其行为与非线性情况下的观察结果高度相似。我们的分析揭示了线性CFG通过三个不同的组件来提高生成质量：(i) 平均偏移项，该项大致引导样本朝类平均值方向移动；(ii) 正的对比主成分（Contrastive Principal Components, CPC）项，该项放大了特定于类别的特征；(iii) 负的CPC项，该项抑制了在无条件数据中普遍存在的通用特征。然后，我们在现实世界的非线性扩散模型中验证了这些洞察：在广泛的噪声水平范围内，线性CFG的行为与其非线性对应物相似。尽管在低噪声水平下两者会逐渐分离，但我们讨论了线性分析的见解如何仍然照亮了CFG在非线性区域中的机制。

[No.7] Adaptive Classifier-Free Guidance via Dynamic Low-Confidence Masking
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 自适应无分类器自由引导通过动态低置信度掩码
类别: deep learning
作者: Pengxiang Li;Shilin Yan;Jiayin Cai;Renrui Zhang;Ruichuan An;Ziyu Guo;Xiaowei Gao;
机构: Hong Kong Polytechnic University;Dalian University of Technology;Alibaba Group;Xiaohongshu;Chinese University of Hong Kong;Peking University;Xi'an Jiao Tong University;Imperial College London;
类型: Poster
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=0EcomthIKh
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20199
英摘: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) significantly enhances controllability in generative models by interpolating conditional and unconditional predictions. However, standard CFG often employs a static unconditional input, which can be suboptimal for iterative generation processes where model uncertainty varies dynamically. We introduce Adaptive Classifier-Free Guidance (A-CFG), a novel method that tailors the unconditional input by leveraging the model's instantaneous predictive confidence. At each step of an iterative (masked) diffusion language model, A-CFG identifies tokens in the currently generated sequence for which the model exhibits low confidence. These tokens are temporarily re-masked to create a dynamic, localized unconditional input. This focuses CFG's corrective influence precisely on areas of ambiguity, leading to more effective guidance. We integrate A-CFG into a state-of-the-art masked diffusion language model and demonstrate its efficacy. Experiments on diverse language generation benchmarks show that A-CFG yields substantial improvements over standard CFG, achieving, for instance, a 3.9 point gain on GPQA. Our work highlights the benefit of dynamically adapting guidance mechanisms to model uncertainty in iterative generation.
中摘: Classifier-Free 指导（CFG）通过插值条件性和无条件预测显著增强了生成模型的可控性。然而，标准的 CFG 经常使用静态的无条件输入，这在模型不确定性动态变化的迭代生成过程中可能不是最优选择。我们引入了自适应 Classifier-Free 指导（A-CFG），这是一种新颖的方法，通过利用模型即时预测的信心来定制无条件输入。在迭代（掩码）扩散语言模型的每一步中，A-CFG 会识别出当前生成序列中模型信心较低的标记，并暂时重新掩码这些标记以创建一个动态、局部化的无条件输入。这种方法将 CFG 的纠正影响精确地集中在模糊区域，从而实现更有效的指导。我们将 A-CFG 集成到最先进的掩码扩散语言模型中，并展示了其有效性。实验结果显示，A-CFG 在各种语言生成基准上相较于标准的 CFG 取得了显著改进，例如在 GPQA 上获得了 3.9 分的提升。我们的研究突显了根据模型不确定性动态调整指导机制的好处，特别是在迭代生成过程中。

[No.9] Rethinking Multimodal Learning from the Perspective of Mitigating Classification Ability Disproportion
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 从减少分类能力偏差的角度重新思考多模态学习
类别: deep learning
作者: Qing-Yuan Jiang;Longfei Huang;Yang Yang;
机构: Nanjing University of Science and Technology;
类型: Oral
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Q6IyUpBmrG
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.20120
英摘: Multimodal learning (MML) is significantly constrained by modality imbalance, leading to suboptimal performance in practice. While existing approaches primarily focus on balancing the learning of different modalities to address this issue, they fundamentally overlook the inherent disproportion in model classification ability, which serves as the primary cause of this phenomenon. In this paper, we propose a novel multimodal learning approach to dynamically balance the classification ability of weak and strong modalities by incorporating the principle of boosting. Concretely, we first propose a sustained boosting algorithm in multimodal learning by simultaneously optimizing the classification and residual errors. Subsequently, we introduce an adaptive classifier assignment strategy to dynamically facilitate the classification performance of the weak modality. Furthermore, we theoretically analyze the convergence property of the cross-modal gap function, ensuring the effectiveness of the proposed boosting scheme. To this end, the classification ability of strong and weak modalities is expected to be balanced, thereby mitigating the imbalance issue. Empirical experiments on widely used datasets reveal the superiority of our method through comparison with various state-of-the-art (SOTA) multimodal learning baselines. The source code is available at https://github.com/njustkmg/NeurIPS25-AUG.
中摘: 多模态学习（MML）受到模态不平衡的显著限制，在实践中导致性能不佳。尽管现有的方法主要集中在平衡不同模态的学习以解决这一问题，但它们从根本上忽视了模型分类能力的固有不均衡，这是这种现象的主要原因。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的多模态学习方法，通过引入提升的原则动态平衡弱模态和强模态的分类能力。具体而言，我们首先提出了一种在多模态学习中的持续提升算法，该算法同时优化分类和残差误差。随后，我们引入了一种自适应分类器分配策略，以动态增强弱模态的分类性能。此外，我们从理论上分析了跨模态差距函数的收敛性质，确保所提出的提升方案的有效性。因此，强模态和弱模态的分类能力有望得到平衡，从而缓解模态不平衡的问题。通过对广泛使用的数据集进行实证实验，我们的方法在与各种最先进的（SOTA）多模态学习基线的比较中展现出优越性。源代码可在https://github.com/njustkmg/NeurIPS25-AUG获取。

[No.11] Stealthy Yet Effective: Distribution-Preserving Backdoor Attacks on Graph Classification
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 隐秘而有效：基于分布保持的图分类后门攻击
类别: deep learning
作者: Xiaobao Wang;Ruoxiao Sun;Yujun Zhang;Bingdao Feng;Dongxiao He;Luzhi Wang;Di Jin;
机构: Tianjin University;Dalian Maritime University;;
类型: Poster
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=EpEluUcQ6A
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.26032
英摘: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have demonstrated strong performance across tasks such as node classification, link prediction, and graph classification, but remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks that implant imperceptible triggers during training to control predictions. While node-level attacks exploit local message passing, graph-level attacks face the harder challenge of manipulating global representations while maintaining stealth. We identify two main sources of anomaly in existing graph classification backdoor methods: structural deviation from rare subgraph triggers and semantic deviation caused by label flipping, both of which make poisoned graphs easily detectable by anomaly detection models. To address this, we propose DPSBA, a clean-label backdoor framework that learns in-distribution triggers via adversarial training guided by anomaly-aware discriminators. DPSBA effectively suppresses both structural and semantic anomalies, achieving high attack success while significantly improving stealth. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets validate that DPSBA achieves a superior balance between effectiveness and detectability compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
中摘: 图神经网络（GNNs）在节点分类、链接预测和图分类等任务上表现出强大的性能，但在训练过程中植入不可感知触发器以控制预测的后门攻击中仍存在脆弱性。虽然节点级攻击利用局部消息传递，但图级攻击面临着更难的挑战——在保持隐蔽性的前提下操纵全局表示。我们发现现有图分类后门方法中的异常主要来源于两个方面：结构上的偏差，即从罕见子图触发器中偏离；以及语义上的偏差，由于标签翻转导致的混淆。这两种偏差使得中毒图容易被异常检测模型识别出来。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了DPSBA，这是一种清洁标签后门框架，通过由异常感知鉴别器引导的对抗训练学习内部分布触发器。DPSBA有效地抑制了结构和语义上的异常，实现了高成功率的攻击同时显著提高了隐蔽性。在真实数据集上的广泛实验验证了，与最先进的基线方法相比，DPSBA在效果和可检测性之间取得了更好的平衡。

[No.12] Multiclass Loss Geometry Matters for Generalization of Gradient Descent in Separable Classification
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 多类损失几何结构对可分分类中梯度下降泛化的意义
类别: theory
作者: Matan Schliserman;Tomer Koren;
机构: Tel Aviv University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=FBjTMq2Rby
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.22359
英摘: We study the generalization performance of unregularized gradient methods for separable linear classification. While previous work mostly deal with the binary case, we focus on the multiclass setting with $k$ classes and establish novel population risk bounds for Gradient Descent for loss functions that decay to zero. In this setting, we show risk bounds that reveal that convergence rates are crucially influenced by the geometry of the loss template, as formalized by Wang and Scott (2024), rather than of the loss function itself. Particularly, we establish risk upper bounds that holds for any decay rate of the loss whose template is smooth with respect to the $p$-norm. In the case of exponentially decaying losses, our results indicates a contrast between the $p=\infty$ case, where the risk exhibits a logarithmic dependence on $k$, and $p=2$ where the risk scales linearly with $k$. To establish this separation formally, we also prove a lower bound in the latter scenario, demonstrating that the polynomial dependence on $k$ is unavoidable. Central to our analysis is a novel bound on the Rademacher complexity of low-noise vector-valued linear predictors with a loss template smooth w.r.t.~general $p$-norms.
中摘: 我们研究了分离线性分类的非正则化梯度方法的一般泛化性能。虽然以往的工作主要集中在二分类情况，但我们关注具有 \(k\) 个类别的多分类设置，并为损失函数在零处衰减至零的情况建立了新的总体风险界。在这个设置下，我们展示了风险界揭示了收敛率对损失模板几何形状的依赖性，而非损失函数本身，这一依赖性由 Wang 和 Scott（2024）正式化。特别是，我们建立了对于任何相对于 \(p\)-范数光滑的损失衰减率的风险上界。在损失以指数方式衰减的情况下，我们的结果表明，在 \(p=\infty\) 的情况下，风险与 \(k\) 的对数依赖关系形成对比，而在 \(p=2\) 的情况下，风险与 \(k\) 线性相关。为了正式建立这种分离，我们还在后者的情况下证明了一个下界，表明与 \(k\) 的多项式依赖关系不可避免。我们分析的核心在于一个新的关于相对于一般 \(p\)-范数光滑的向量值线性预测器的拉德马赫复杂性的界。

[No.13] Simple and Effective Specialized Representations for Fair Classifiers
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 公平分类器的简单有效专门表示
类别: social and economic aspects of machine learning
作者: Alberto Sinigaglia;Davide Sartor;Marina Ceccon;Gian Antonio Susto;
机构: University of Padua;
类型: Poster
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=kYYyEZ1LIX
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11740
英摘: Fair classification is a critical challenge that has gained increasing importance due to international regulations and its growing use in high-stakes decision-making settings. Existing methods often rely on adversarial learning or distribution matching across sensitive groups; however, adversarial learning can be unstable, and distribution matching can be computationally intensive. To address these limitations, we propose a novel approach based on the characteristic function distance. Our method ensures that the learned representation contains minimal sensitive information while maintaining high effectiveness for downstream tasks. By utilizing characteristic functions, we achieve a more stable and efficient solution compared to traditional methods. Additionally, we introduce a simple relaxation of the objective function that guarantees fairness in common classification models with no performance degradation. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently matches or achieves better fairness and predictive accuracy than existing methods. Moreover, our method maintains robustness and computational efficiency, making it a practical solution for real-world applications.
中摘: 公平分类是一个关键性的挑战，随着国际法规的制定及其在高风险决策场景中的广泛应用而变得越来越重要。现有的方法通常依赖于对抗学习或敏感群体间的分布匹配；然而，对抗学习可能不稳定，而分布匹配则可能计算量大。为了应对这些局限性，我们提出了一种基于特征函数距离的新方法。该方法确保学习表示中包含最少的敏感信息，同时保持对下游任务的高度有效性。通过利用特征函数，我们实现了比传统方法更加稳定和高效的解决方案。此外，我们引入了一个简单的客观函数松弛，可以在常见的分类模型中保证公平性，且不会影响性能。在基准数据集上的实验结果显示，我们的方法在公平性和预测准确性方面始终能够与现有方法相匹敌甚至超越它们。更重要的是，我们的方法保持了鲁棒性和计算效率，使其成为实际应用中的一个可行解决方案。

[No.14] Incremental Sequence Classification with Temporal Consistency
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 增量序列分类与时间一致性
类别: deep learning
作者: Lucas Maystre;Gabriel Barello;Tudor Berariu;Aleix Cambray;Rares Dolga;Alvaro Ortega Gonzalez;Andrei Cristian Nica;David Barber;
机构: UiPath;Imperial College London;University College London;
类型: Spotlight
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=bTssV4Cnjn
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.16548
英摘: We address the problem of incremental sequence classification, where predictions are updated as new elements in the sequence are revealed. Drawing on temporal-difference learning from reinforcement learning, we identify a temporal-consistency condition that successive predictions should satisfy. We leverage this condition to develop a novel loss function for training incremental sequence classifiers. Through a concrete example, we demonstrate that optimizing this loss can offer substantial gains in data efficiency. We apply our method to text classification tasks and show that it improves predictive accuracy over competing approaches on several benchmark datasets. We further evaluate our approach on the task of verifying large language model generations for correctness in grade-school math problems. Our results show that models trained with our method are better able to distinguish promising generations from unpromising ones after observing only a few tokens.
中摘: 我们解决了增量序列分类问题，即随着序列中新元素的揭示，预测会不断更新。借鉴强化学习中的时差学习方法，我们确定了一个时间一致性条件，要求后续预测满足这一条件。利用这一条件，我们开发了一种新的损失函数来训练增量序列分类器。通过一个具体的例子，我们证明了优化这种损失可以显著提高数据效率。我们将该方法应用于文本分类任务，并展示了在多个基准数据集上，与竞争方法相比，它可以提高预测准确性。进一步地，我们在验证大型语言模型生成是否正确（特别是在小学数学问题上）的任务中评估了我们的方法。结果显示，使用该方法训练的模型在观察到少量标记后，更能区分有希望的生成和无希望的生成。

[No.15] Conservative classifiers do consistently well with improving agents: characterizing statistical and online learning
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 保守分类器在改进代理方面表现一致良好：描述统计学习和在线学习特征
类别: theory
作者: Dravyansh Sharma;Alec Sun;

类型: Spotlight

英摘: Machine learning is now ubiquitous in societal decision-making, for example in evaluating job candidates or loan applications, and it is increasingly important to take into account how classified agents will react to the learning algorithms. The majority of recent literature on strategic classification has focused on reducing and countering deceptive behaviors by the classified agents, but recent work of Attias et al. identifies surprising properties of learnability when the agents genuinely improve in order to attain the desirable classification, such as smaller generalization error than standard PAC-learning. In this paper we characterize so-called learnability with improvements across multiple new axes. We resolve open questions posed by Attias et al. for both proper and improper learning.

[No.16] Improved Balanced Classification with Theoretically Grounded Loss Functions
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 基于理论支撑的损失函数改进的平衡分类方法
类别: theory
作者: Corinna Cortes;Mehryar Mohri;Yutao Zhong;
机构: Google;New York University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=SkZUo6Xg61
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23947
英摘: The balanced loss is a widely adopted objective for multi-class classification under class imbalance. By assigning equal importance to all classes, regardless of their frequency, it promotes fairness and ensures that minority classes are not overlooked. However, directly minimizing the balanced classification loss is typically intractable, which makes the design of effective surrogate losses a central question. This paper introduces and studies two advanced surrogate loss families: Generalized Logit-Adjusted (GLA) loss functions and Generalized Class-Aware weighted (GCA) losses. GLA losses generalize Logit-Adjusted losses, which shift logits based on class priors, to the broader general cross-entropy loss family. GCA loss functions extend the standard class-weighted losses, which scale losses inversely by class frequency, by incorporating class-dependent confidence margins and extending them to the general cross-entropy family. We present a comprehensive theoretical analysis of consistency for both loss families. We show that GLA losses are Bayes-consistent, but only $H$-consistent for complete (i.e., unbounded) hypothesis sets. Moreover, their $H$-consistency bounds depend inversely on the minimum class probability, scaling at least as $1/\mathsf p_{\min}$. In contrast, GCA losses are $H$-consistent for any hypothesis set that is bounded or complete, with $H$-consistency bounds that scale more favorably as $1/\sqrt{\mathsf p_{\min}}$, offering significantly stronger theoretical guarantees in imbalanced settings. We report the results of experiments demonstrating that, empirically, both the GCA losses with calibrated class-dependent confidence margins and GLA losses can greatly outperform straightforward class-weighted losses as well as the LA losses. GLA generally performs slightly better in common benchmarks, whereas GCA exhibits a slight edge in highly imbalanced settings.
中摘: 平衡损失在处理类别不平衡的多分类问题时被广泛采用为目标函数。通过赋予所有类别相同的重视程度，无论它们出现的频率如何，平衡损失促进了公平性并确保了少数类不会被忽视。然而，直接最小化平衡分类损失通常是不可解的，这使得设计有效的替代损失成为一个核心问题。本文介绍了并研究了两个先进的替代损失家族：广义逻辑调整（GLA）损失函数和广义类别感知加权（GCA）损失函数。GLA损失函数将基于类别先验进行逻辑调整的Logit-Adjusted损失泛化为更广泛的交叉熵损失家族。GCA损失函数扩展了标准的类别加权损失，这些损失通过反比于类别频率来调整损失，引入了类别相关的置信度边界，并将其扩展到一般的交叉熵损失家族。我们对这两个损失家族的一致性进行了全面的理论分析。我们表明，GLA损失函数是贝叶斯一致的，但在完全（即无界）假设集的情况下，只有$H$-一致。此外，它们的$H$-一致性界限与最小类别概率成反比，至少按$1/\mathsf p_{\min}$的比例缩放。相比之下，GCA损失函数对于任何有界或完全的假设集都是$H$-一致的，其$H$-一致性界限按更有利于的比例$1/\sqrt{\mathsf p_{\min}}$缩放，在类别不平衡的环境中提供了显著更强的理论保证。实验结果显示，从实际效果来看，无论是校准了类别相关置信度边界的GCA损失函数还是GLA损失函数，都能显著优于简单的类别加权损失以及Logit-Adjusted损失。GLA在常见基准测试中通常表现稍好一些，而GCA在高度不平衡的环境中则略占优势。

英摘: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved strong performance across a range of graph representation learning tasks, yet their adversarial robustness in graph classification remains underexplored compared to node classification. While most existing defenses focus on the message-passing component, this work investigates the overlooked role of pooling operations in shaping robustness. We present a theoretical analysis of standard flat pooling methods (sum, average and max), deriving upper bounds on their adversarial risk and identifying their vulnerabilities under different attack scenarios and graph structures. In this work, we establish optimal generalization rates for GD with deep ReLU networks by carefully trading off optimization and generalization errors, achieving only polynomial dependence on depth. [No.36] Latent Zoning Network: A Unified Principle for Generative Modeling, Representation Learning, and Classification
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 潜在分区网络：生成建模、表示学习和分类的统一原则
类别: general machine learning
作者: Zinan Lin;Enshu Liu;Xuefei Ning;Junyi Zhu;Wenyu Wang;Sergey Yekhanin;

英摘: Generative modeling, representation learning, and classification are three core problems in machine learning (ML), yet their state-of-the-art (SoTA) solutions remain largely disjoint. In this paper, we ask: Can a unified principle address all three? Such unification could simplify ML pipelines and foster greater synergy across tasks. We introduce Latent Zoning Network (LZN) as a step toward this goal. At its core, LZN creates a shared Gaussian latent space that encodes information across all tasks. Each data type (e.g., images, text, labels) is equipped with an encoder that maps samples to disjoint latent zones, and a decoder that maps latents back to data. ML tasks are expressed as compositions of these encoders and decoders: for example, label-conditional image generation uses a label encoder and image decoder; image embedding uses an image encoder; classification uses an image encoder and label decoder. We demonstrate the promise of LZN in three increasingly complex scenarios: (1) LZN can enhance existing models (image generation): When combined with the SoTA Rectified Flow model, LZN improves FID on CIFAR10 from 2.76 to 2.59-without modifying the training objective. (2) LZN can solve tasks independently (representation learning): LZN can implement unsupervised representation learning without auxiliary loss functions, outperforming the seminal MoCo and SimCLR methods by 9.3% and 0.2%, respectively, on downstream linear classification on ImageNet. (3) LZN can solve multiple tasks simultaneously (joint generation and classification): With image and label encoders/decoders, LZN performs both tasks jointly by design, improving FID and achieving SoTA classification accuracy on CIFAR10. The code and trained models are available at https://github.com/microsoft/latent-zoning-networks. The project website is at https://zinanlin.me/blogs/latent_zoning_networks.html.

[No.37] Quantifying Uncertainty in Error Consistency: Towards Reliable Behavioral Comparison of Classifiers
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 量化误差一致性中的不确定性：迈向可靠的分类器行为比较
类别: neuroscience and cognitive science
作者: Thomas Klein;Sascha Meyen;Wieland Brendel;Felix A. Wichmann;Kristof Meding;

英摘: Benchmarking models is a key factor for the rapid progress in machine learning (ML) research. Thus, further progress depends on improving benchmarking metrics. A standard metric to measure the behavioral alignment between ML models and human observers is error consistency (EC). EC allows for more fine-grained comparisons of behavior than other metrics such as accuracy, and has been used in the influential Brain-Score benchmark to rank different DNNs by their behavioral consistency with humans. Previously, EC values have been reported without confidence intervals. However, empirically measured EC values are typically noisy -- thus, without confidence intervals, valid benchmarking conclusions are problematic. Here we improve on standard EC in two ways: First, we show how to obtain confidence intervals for EC using a bootstrapping technique, allowing us to derive significance tests for EC. Second, we propose a new computational model relating the EC between two classifiers to the implicit probability that one of them copies responses from the other. This view of EC allows us to give practical guidance to scientists regarding the number of trials required for sufficiently powerful, conclusive experiments. Finally, we use our methodology to revisit popular NeuroAI-results. We find that while the general trend of behavioral differences between humans and machines holds up to scrutiny, many reported differences between deep vision models are statistically insignificant. Our methodology enables researchers to design adequately powered experiments that can reliably detect behavioral differences between models, providing a foundation for more rigorous benchmarking of behavioral alignment.

[No.43] DPA: A one-stop metric to measure bias amplification in classification datasets
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: DPA：一个一站式度量标准，用于测量分类数据集中的偏见放大
类别: social and economic aspects of machine learning
作者: Bhanu Tokas;Rahul Nair;Hannah Kerner;
机构: Arizona State University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=efuY2yYC1U
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.11060
英摘: Most ML datasets today contain biases. When we train models on these datasets, they often not only learn these biases but can worsen them -- a phenomenon known as bias amplification. Several co-occurrence-based metrics have been proposed to measure bias amplification in classification datasets. They measure bias amplification between a protected attribute (e.g., gender) and a task (e.g., cooking). These metrics also support fine-grained bias analysis by identifying the direction in which a model amplifies biases. However, co-occurrence-based metrics have limitations -- some fail to measure bias amplification in balanced datasets, while others fail to measure negative bias amplification. To solve these issues, recent work proposed a predictability-based metric called leakage amplification (LA). However, LA cannot identify the direction in which a model amplifies biases. We propose Directional Predictability Amplification (DPA), a predictability-based metric that is (1) directional, (2) works with balanced and unbalanced datasets, and (3) correctly identifies positive and negative bias amplification. DPA eliminates the need to evaluate models on multiple metrics to verify these three aspects. DPA also improves over prior predictability-based metrics like LA: it is less sensitive to the choice of attacker function (a hyperparameter in predictability-based metrics), reports scores within a bounded range, and accounts for dataset bias by measuring relative changes in predictability. Our experiments on well-known datasets like COMPAS (a tabular dataset), COCO, and ImSitu (image datasets) show that DPA is the most reliable metric to measure bias amplification in classification problems. To compare DPA with existing bias amplification metrics, we released a one-stop library of major bias amplification metrics at https://github.com/kerner-lab/Bias-Amplification.
中摘: 当今大多数机器学习（ML）数据集都存在偏见。当我们使用这些数据集训练模型时，它们不仅会学习这些偏见，还可能导致偏见进一步恶化——这一现象被称为偏见放大。已经提出了几种共现为基础的指标来衡量分类数据集中的偏见放大。这些指标通过识别保护属性（例如，性别）与任务（例如，烹饪）之间的关系来测量偏见放大，并支持对模型放大偏见方向的精细分析。然而，共现为基础的指标也有局限性——有些无法在平衡的数据集中测量偏见放大，而另一些则无法测量负向偏见放大。为了解决这些问题，最近的研究提出了一种基于可预测性的指标，称为泄漏放大（Leakage Amplification，LA）。但是，LA无法识别模型放大偏见的方向。我们提出了一种名为定向可预测性放大（Directional Predictability Amplification，DPA）的基于可预测性的指标，该指标具有以下三个特点：（1）具有方向性；（2）适用于平衡和不平衡的数据集；（3）能够正确识别正向和负向偏见放大。DPA消除了需要评估模型在多个指标上以验证这三个方面的必要性。此外，DPA相比之前的基于可预测性的指标如LA有改进：它对攻击函数（基于可预测性指标中的超参数）的选择不那么敏感，报告的分数处于一个限定范围内，并通过测量可预测性相对变化来考虑数据集本身的偏见。我们在知名的COMPAS（一个表格数据集）、COCO和ImSitu（图像数据集）等数据集上的实验表明，DPA是最可靠的用于衡量分类问题中偏见放大的指标。为了对比DPA与其他现有的偏见放大指标，我们已在https://github.com/kerner-lab/Bias-Amplification发布了主要偏见放大指标的一站式库。

[No.47] Convolution Goes Higher-Order: A Biologically Inspired Mechanism Empowers Image Classification

作者: Simone Azeglio;Olivier Marre;Peter Neri;Ulisse Ferrari;

英摘: We propose a novel approach to image classification inspired by complex nonlinear biological visual processing, whereby classical convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are equipped with learnable higher-order convolutions. Our model incorporates a Volterra-like expansion of the convolution operator, capturing multiplicative interactions akin to those observed in early and advanced stages of biological visual processing. We evaluated this approach on synthetic datasets by measuring sensitivity to testing higher-order correlations and performance in standard benchmarks (MNIST, FashionMNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100 and Imagenette). [No.48] Noise Matters: Optimizing Matching Noise for Diffusion Classifiers
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 噪声很重要：优化扩散分类器中的匹配噪声
类别: deep learning
作者: Yanghao Wang;Long Chen;
机构: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology;
类型: Poster
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=uG8bjnN1Nl
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.11330
英摘: Although today's pretrained discriminative vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) have demonstrated strong perception abilities, such as zero-shot image classification, they also suffer from the bag-of-words problem and spurious bias. To mitigate these problems, some pioneering studies leverage powerful generative models (e.g., pretrained diffusion models) to realize generalizable image classification, dubbed Diffusion Classifier (DC). Specifically, by randomly sampling a Gaussian noise, DC utilizes the differences of denoising effects with different category conditions to classify categories. Unfortunately, an inherent and notorious weakness of existing DCs is noise instability: different random sampled noises lead to significant performance changes. To achieve stable classification performance, existing DCs always ensemble the results of hundreds of sampled noises, which significantly reduces the classification speed. To this end, we firstly explore the role of noise in DC, and conclude that: there are some ``good noises'' that can relieve the instability. Meanwhile, we argue that these good noises should meet two principles: Frequency Matching and Spatial Matching. Regarding both principles, we propose a novel Noise Optimization method to learn matching (i.e., good) noise for DCs: NoOp. For frequency matching, NoOp first optimizes a dataset-specific noise: Given a dataset and a timestep t, optimize one randomly initialized parameterized noise. For Spatial Matching, NoOp trains a Meta-Network that adopts an image as input and outputs image-specific noise offset. The sum of optimized noise and noise offset will be used in DC to replace random noise. Extensive ablations on various datasets demonstrated the effectiveness of NoOp.
中摘: 尽管今天的预训练辨别性视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）已经展示了强大的感知能力，例如零样本图像分类，它们也面临着“词袋”问题和虚假偏见。为缓解这些问题，一些开创性的研究利用强大的生成模型（如预训练扩散模型）实现了一种可泛化的图像分类方法，称为扩散分类器（DC）。具体来说，通过随机采样高斯噪声，DC 利用不同类别条件下去噪效果的差异来进行分类。然而，现有的 DC 存在一个固有的、众所周知的弱点：噪声不稳定。不同的随机噪声会导致显著的性能变化。为了实现稳定的分类性能，现有的 DC 总是将数百次采样噪声的结果进行集成，这大大降低了分类速度。为此，我们首先探讨了噪声在 DC 中的作用，并得出结论：存在一些“好的噪声”，可以缓解这种不稳定性。同时，我们认为这些好的噪声应该满足两个原则：频率匹配和空间匹配。基于这两个原则，我们提出了一种新的噪声优化方法（NoOp），以学习适合 DC 的匹配（即“好”的）噪声：NoOp 首先针对特定数据集优化一种噪声：给定一个数据集和时间步 t，优化一个随机初始化的参数化噪声。对于空间匹配，NoOp 训练一个元网络，该网络接受图像作为输入并输出与图像特定相关的噪声偏移量。优化后的噪声加上噪声偏移量将在 DC 中用于替代随机噪声。在各种数据集上的广泛消融实验表明了 NoOp 的有效性。

[No.51] Rethinking Approximate Gaussian Inference in Classification
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 重新思考分类中的近似高斯推断
类别: probabilistic methods
作者: Bálint Mucsányi;Nathaël Da Costa;Philipp Hennig;
机构: Eberhard Karls University of Tübingen;University of Oxford;University of Tübingen;
类型: Poster
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=xPQyRmZ8hz
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.03366
英摘: In classification tasks, softmax functions are ubiquitously used as output activations to produce predictive probabilities. Such outputs only capture aleatoric uncertainty. To capture epistemic uncertainty, approximate Gaussian inference methods have been proposed. We develop a common formalism to describe such methods, which we view as outputting Gaussian distributions over the logit space. Predictives are then obtained as the expectations of the Gaussian distributions pushed forward through the softmax. However, such softmax Gaussian integrals cannot be solved analytically, and Monte Carlo (MC) approximations can be costly and noisy. We propose to replace the softmax activation by element-wise normCDF or sigmoid, which allows for the accurate sampling-free approximation of predictives. This also enables the approximation of the Gaussian pushforwards by Dirichlet distributions with moment matching. This approach entirely eliminates the runtime and memory overhead associated with MC sampling. We evaluate it combined with several approximate Gaussian inference methods (Laplace, HET, SNGP) on large- and small-scale datasets (ImageNet, CIFAR-100, CIFAR-10), demonstrating improved uncertainty quantification capabilities compared to softmax MC sampling. Our code is available at https://github.com/bmucsanyi/probit.
中摘: 在分类任务中，softmax函数广泛用作输出激活函数以生成预测概率。这类输出仅捕捉了 aleatoric 不确定性。为了捕捉 epistemic 不确定性，已经提出了近似高斯推断方法。我们发展了一种通用的形式化方法来描述这些方法，将它们视为在逻辑空间上输出高斯分布。然后，通过softmax函数推进高斯分布以获得预测值。然而，这样的softmax高斯积分无法解析求解，并且蒙特卡洛（MC）近似可能会非常昂贵且噪声较大。我们提出用逐元素的normCDF或sigmoid替换softmax激活函数，这允许我们通过精确的无采样近似来估计预测值。这种方法还使高斯推进近似能够通过矩匹配转换为狄利克雷分布。这种方法完全消除了与MC采样相关的运行时和内存开销。我们在多个大型和小型数据集（ImageNet、CIFAR-100、CIFAR-10）上结合了几种近似高斯推断方法（拉普拉斯法、HET、SNGP），评估了该方法，结果显示其在不确定性量化能力方面优于softmax MC采样。我们的代码可在https://github.com/bmucsanyi/probit获取。

[No.53] Transformers are almost optimal metalearners for linear classification
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 变压器几乎是最优的元学习者，适用于线性分类任务
类别: theory
作者: Roey Magen;Gal Vardi;
机构: Weizmann Institute of Science;
类型: Poster
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Smy93p3NCT
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.19797
英摘: Transformers have demonstrated impressive in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, raising the question of whether they can serve as metalearners that adapt to new tasks using only a small number of in-context examples, without any further training. While recent theoretical work has studied transformers' ability to perform ICL, most of these analyses do not address the formal metalearning setting, where the objective is to solve a collection of related tasks more efficiently than would be possible by solving each task individually. In this paper, we provide the first theoretical analysis showing that a simplified transformer architecture trained via gradient descent can act as a near-optimal metalearner in a linear classification setting. We consider a natural family of tasks where each task corresponds to a class-conditional Gaussian mixture model, with the mean vectors lying in a shared $k$-dimensional subspace of $R^d$. After training on a sufficient number of such tasks, we show that the transformer can generalize to a new task using only $O(k / R^4)$ in-context examples, where $R$ denotes the signal strength at test time. This performance (almost) matches that of an optimal learner that knows exactly the shared subspace and significantly outperforms any learner that only has access to the in-context data, which requires $Ω(d / R^4)$ examples to generalize. Importantly, our bounds on the number of training tasks and examples per task needed to achieve this result are independent of the ambient dimension $d$.
中摘: 变压器展示了令人印象深刻的上下文内学习（ICL）能力，这引发了一个问题：它们是否可以作为元学习器，在仅使用少量上下文内示例的情况下适应新任务，而无需进一步训练。尽管近期的理论研究已经探讨了变压器进行ICL的能力，但大多数分析并未涉及正式的元学习设置，而在这种设置中，目标是在解决一组相关任务时比单独解决每个任务更高效。在本文中，我们提供了首个理论分析，证明通过梯度下降训练的一种简化变压器架构可以在线性分类设置中近似最优地充当元学习器。我们考虑了一类自然的任务，其中每个任务对应于一个条件高斯混合模型，均值向量位于共享的$d$维空间中的$k$维子空间内。经过足够的此类任务的训练后，我们展示了变压器仅需使用$O(k / R^4)$个上下文内示例就能泛化到新任务上，其中$R$表示测试时的信号强度。这种性能几乎与最优学习器相当，该学习器确切知道共享的子空间，同时显著优于只能访问上下文数据的学习器，后者需要$Ω(d / R^4)$个示例才能泛化。重要的是，我们的训练任务数量和每个任务所需的示例数的上限与环境维度$d$无关。

[No.57] Diffusion-Classifier Synergy: Reward-Aligned Learning via Mutual Boosting Loop for FSCIL
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 扩散分类协同效应：通过相互增强循环实现奖励对齐学习以应对多任务持续学习
类别: deep learning
作者: Ruitao Wu;Yifan Zhao;Guangyao Chen;Jia Li;
机构: Beihang University;Cornell University;

英摘: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) challenges models to sequentially learn new classes from minimal examples without forgetting prior knowledge, a task complicated by the stability-plasticity dilemma and data scarcity. Current FSCIL methods often struggle with generalization due to their reliance on limited datasets. While diffusion models offer a path for data augmentation, their direct application can lead to semantic misalignment or ineffective guidance. This paper introduces Diffusion-Classifier Synergy (DCS), a novel framework that establishes a mutual boosting loop between diffusion model and FSCIL classifier. DCS utilizes a reward-aligned learning strategy, where a dynamic, multi-faceted reward function derived from the classifier's state directs the diffusion model. This reward system operates at two levels: the feature level ensures semantic coherence and diversity using prototype-anchored maximum mean discrepancy and dimension-wise variance matching, while the logits level promotes exploratory image generation and enhances inter-class discriminability through confidence recalibration and cross-session confusion-aware mechanisms. This co-evolutionary process, where generated images refine the classifier and an improved classifier state yields better reward signals, demonstrably achieves state-of-the-art performance on FSCIL benchmarks, significantly enhancing both knowledge retention and new class learning.
中摘: 少样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning，FSCIL）挑战模型在仅从少量示例中顺序学习新类别的能力，同时不忘记先前的知识。这一任务因稳定性与可塑性之间的矛盾以及数据稀缺性而变得更加复杂。当前的FSCIL方法往往由于依赖于有限的数据集而在泛化方面遇到困难。虽然扩散模型提供了一条数据增强的道路，但它们直接应用可能会导致语义不一致或无效的指导。本文引入了扩散分类协同（Diffusion-Classifier Synergy，DCS），这是一种新颖的框架，它在扩散模型和FSCIL分类器之间建立了一个相互增强的循环。DCS利用了一种奖励对齐的学习策略，其中分类器的状态导出了一个动态且多方面的奖励函数，指导扩散模型。该奖励系统在两个层面运作：特征层面通过原型锚定的最大均值偏差和维度间方差匹配来确保语义的一致性和多样性；logits层面则通过信心校准和会话间混淆意识机制促进探索性的图像生成并增强跨类别可区分性。这种共同进化的过程，即生成的图像改进分类器，而改进后的分类器状态产生更好的奖励信号，显着提升了FSCIL基准上的性能，显著增强了知识保留和新类别学习的能力。

[No.58] What Does It Take to Build a Performant Selective Classifier?
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 构建高性能选择性分类器需要什么？
类别: other
作者: Stephan Rabanser;Nicolas Papernot;
机构: Princeton University;University of Toronto;Google;
类型: Poster
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=pcwI5cNFJK
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.20242
英摘: Selective classifiers improve model reliability by abstaining on inputs the model deems uncertain. However, few practical approaches achieve the gold-standard performance of a perfect-ordering oracle that accepts examples exactly in order of correctness. Our work formalizes this shortfall as the selective-classification gap and present the first finite-sample decomposition of this gap to five distinct sources of looseness: Bayes noise, approximation error, ranking error, statistical noise, and implementation- or shift-induced slack. Crucially, our analysis reveals that monotone post-hoc calibration -- often believed to strengthen selective classifiers -- has limited impact on closing this gap, since it rarely alters the model's underlying score ranking. Bridging the gap therefore requires scoring mechanisms that can effectively reorder predictions rather than merely rescale them. We validate our decomposition on synthetic two-moons data and on real-world vision and language benchmarks, isolating each error component through controlled experiments. Our results confirm that (i) Bayes noise and limited model capacity can account for substantial gaps, (ii) only richer, feature-aware calibrators meaningfully improve score ordering, and (iii) data shift introduces a separate slack that demands distributionally robust training. Together, our decomposition yields a quantitative error budget as well as actionable design guidelines that practitioners can use to build selective classifiers which approximate ideal oracle behavior more closely.

We introduce and formalize the \textbf{KKT point embedding principle}, establishing that KKT points of a homogeneous network's max-margin problem ($P_Φ$) can be embedded into the KKT points of a larger network's problem ($P_{\tildeΦ}$) via specific linear isometric transformations. Furthermore, we connect this static embedding to the dynamics of gradient flow training with smooth losses. We demonstrate that trajectories initiated from appropriately mapped points remain mapped throughout training and that the resulting $ω$-limit sets of directions are correspondingly mapped, thereby preserving the alignment with KKT directions dynamically when directional convergence occurs. We conduct several experiments to justify that trajectories are preserved. Our findings offer insights into the effects of network width, parameter redundancy, and the structural connections between solutions found via optimization in homogeneous networks of varying sizes.

[No.68] From Contextual Combinatorial Semi-Bandits to Bandit List Classification: Improved Sample Complexity with Sparse Rewards
来源: NeurIPS 2025
命中: classif
标题: 从上下文组合半 bandeits 到带列表分类的bandit问题：稀疏奖励下的改进样本复杂度

英摘: We study the problem of contextual combinatorial semi-bandits, where input contexts are mapped into subsets of size $m$ of a collection of $K$ possible actions. In each round, the learner observes the realized reward of the predicted actions. Motivated by prototypical applications of contextual bandits, we focus on the $s$-sparse regime where we assume that the sum of rewards is bounded by some value $s\ll K$. For example, in recommendation systems the number of products purchased by any customer is significantly smaller than the total number of available products. Our main result is for the $(ε,δ)$-PAC variant of the problem for which we design an algorithm that returns an $ε$-optimal policy with high probability using a sample complexity of $\tilde{O}((poly(K/m)+sm/ε^2) \log(|Π|/δ))$ where $Π$ is the underlying (finite) class and $s$ is the sparsity parameter. This bound improves upon known bounds for combinatorial semi-bandits whenever $s\ll K$, and in the regime where $s=O(1)$, the leading term is independent of $K$. Our algorithm is also computationally efficient given access to an ERM oracle for $Π$. Our framework generalizes the list multiclass classification problem with bandit feedback, which can be seen as a special case with binary reward vectors. In the special case of single-label classification corresponding to $s=m=1$, we prove an $O((K^7+1/ε^2)\log(|H|/δ))$ sample complexity bound, which improves upon recent results in this scenario. Additionally, we consider the regret minimization setting where data can be generated adversarially, and establish a regret bound of $\tilde O(|Π|+\sqrt{smT\log |Π|})$, extending the result of Erez et al. (2024) who consider the simpler single label classification setting.
中摘: 我们研究了一种上下文组合半 bandit 问题，其中输入上下文映射到大小为 $m$ 的 $K$ 种可能行动的一个子集。在每一轮中，学习者观察到预测行动的实际奖励。受上下文 bandit 应用的启发，我们集中在 $s$-稀疏情形下，假设奖励之和被某个值 $s\ll K$ 所限制。例如，在推荐系统中，任何顾客购买的产品数量远小于所有可用产品的总数。我们的主要结果是针对该问题的 $(ε,δ)$-PAC 变体，设计了一个算法，以高概率返回一个 $ε$-最优策略，所需样本复杂度为 $\tilde{O}((poly(K/m)+sm/ε^2) \log(|Π|/δ))$，其中 $Π$ 是底层（有限）类，$s$ 是稀疏参数。这个界值在 $s\ll K$ 的情况下改进了已知的组合半 bandit 界值，并且在 $s=O(1)$ 的情形下，主要项与 $K$ 无关。此外，只要可以访问 $Π$ 的ERM（经验风险最小化）预言机，该算法也是计算高效的。我们的框架还推广了具有 bandit 反馈的列表多分类问题，这可以被视为二元奖励向量的特殊情况。在单标签分类的特殊情形 $s=m=1$ 中，我们证明了一个样本复杂度界值 $\tilde O((K^7+1/ε^2)\log(|H|/δ))$，这改进了该场景下的最近结果。另外，我们还考虑了数据可以由对手生成的后悔最小化设置，并建立了后悔界值 $\tilde O(|Π|+\sqrt{smT\log |Π|})$，扩展了 Erez 等人（2024）的结果，他们考虑的是更简单的单标签分类设置。

作者: Eyar Azar;Boaz Nadler;
机构: Weizmann Institute of Science;
类型: Spotlight
链接: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/94319
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.03335
英摘: The premise of semi-supervised learning (SSL) is that combining labeled and unlabeled data yields significantly more accurate models. Despite empirical successes, the theoretical understanding of SSL is still far from complete. In this work, we study SSL for high dimensional sparse Gaussian classification. To construct an accurate classifier a key task is feature selection, detecting the few variables that separate the two classes. % For this SSL setting, we analyze information theoretic lower bounds for accurate feature selection as well as computational lower bounds, assuming the low-degree likelihood hardness conjecture. % Our key contribution is the identification of a regime in the problem parameters (dimension, sparsity, number of labeled and unlabeled samples) where SSL is guaranteed to be advantageous for classification. Specifically, there is a regime where it is possible to construct in polynomial time an accurate SSL classifier. However, % any computationally efficient supervised or unsupervised learning schemes, that separately use only the labeled or unlabeled data would fail. Our work highlights the provable benefits of combining labeled and unlabeled data for {classification and} feature selection in high dimensions. We present simulations that complement our theoretical analysis.
中摘: 半监督学习（Semi-Supervised Learning，SSL）的前提是结合标记数据和未标记数据可以显著提高模型的准确性。尽管在实际应用中取得了成功，但对SSL的理论理解仍然不完整。在这项工作中，我们研究了SSL在高维稀疏高斯分类中的应用。要构建一个准确的分类器，关键任务是特征选择，即检测出能够区分两类变量的少数几个变量。对于这种SSL设置，我们分析了信息论下的特征选择下界，以及假设低次多项式似然难题猜想成立时的计算复杂性下界。我们的主要贡献是在问题参数（维度、稀疏度、标记样本和未标记样本的数量）的某个范围内，SSL保证对分类是有利的。具体来说，在这个范围内，有可能在多项式时间内构造一个准确的SSL分类器。然而，任何仅单独使用标记数据或未标记数据的高效计算的监督学习或无监督学习方案都会失败。我们的工作突显了在高维分类和特征选择中结合标记和未标记数据的可证明优势。我们还呈现了一些模拟实验来补充我们的理论分析。

[No.71] Overcoming Common Flaws in the Evaluation of Selective Classification Systems
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 克服选择性分类系统评估中的常见缺陷
类别: evaluation
作者: Jeremias Traub;Till J. Bungert;Carsten T. Lüth;Michael Baumgartner;Klaus Maier-Hein;Lena Maier-hein;Paul F Jaeger;
机构: Deutsches Krebsforschungszentrum;German Cancer Research Center;
类型: Spotlight
链接: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/96815
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.01032
英摘: Selective Classification, wherein models can reject low-confidence predictions, promises reliable translation of machine-learning based classification systems to real-world scenarios such as clinical diagnostics. While current evaluation of these systems typically assumes fixed working points based on pre-defined rejection thresholds, methodological progress requires benchmarking the general performance of systems akin to the $\mathrm{AUROC}$ in standard classification. In this work, we define 5 requirements for multi-threshold metrics in selective classification regarding task alignment, interpretability, and flexibility, and show how current approaches fail to meet them. We propose the Area under the Generalized Risk Coverage curve ($\mathrm{AUGRC}$), which meets all requirements and can be directly interpreted as the average risk of undetected failures. We empirically demonstrate the relevance of $\mathrm{AUGRC}$ on a comprehensive benchmark spanning 6 data sets and 13 confidence scoring functions. We find that the proposed metric substantially changes metric rankings on 5 out of the 6 data sets.
中摘: 选择性分类是一种模型可以在预测置信度低时拒绝预测的方法，它为基于机器学习的分类系统向临床诊断等现实场景可靠转化提供了可能。当前对这些系统的评估通常假设固定的工作点，基于预定义的拒绝阈值，但方法学的进步需要像标准分类中的AUROC那样对标记系统的整体性能进行基准测试。在本研究中，我们定义了选择性分类中多阈值指标的5项要求，涉及任务对齐、可解释性和灵活性，并展示了当前方法未能满足这些要求。我们提出了广义风险覆盖曲线下的面积（AUGRC）这一指标，该指标满足所有要求，并可以直接解释为未检测失败的平均风险。我们在涵盖6个数据集和13种置信度评分函数的综合基准上实证证明了AUGRC的相关性。我们发现，所提出的指标在6个数据集中有5个显著改变了指标排名。

[No.74] Fast Rates for Bandit PAC Multiclass Classification
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 快速率下的带宽PAC多分类学习
类别: bandits
作者: Liad Erez;Alon Cohen;Tomer Koren;Yishay Mansour;Shay Moran;
机构: Tel Aviv University;Google;
类型: Poster
链接: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/96490
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.12406
英摘: We study multiclass PAC learning with bandit feedback, where inputs are classified into one of $K$ possible labels and feedback is limited to whether or not the predicted labels are correct. Our main contribution is in designing a novel learning algorithm for the agnostic $(\varepsilon,δ)$-PAC version of the problem, with sample complexity of $O\big( (\operatorname{poly}(K) + 1 / \varepsilon^2) \log (|H| / δ) \big)$ for any finite hypothesis class $H$. In terms of the leading dependence on $\varepsilon$, this improves upon existing bounds for the problem, that are of the form $O(K/\varepsilon^2)$. We also provide an extension of this result to general classes and establish similar sample complexity bounds in which $\log |H|$ is replaced by the Natarajan dimension. This matches the optimal rate in the full-information version of the problem and resolves an open question studied by Daniely, Sabato, Ben-David, and Shalev-Shwartz (2011) who demonstrated that the multiplicative price of bandit feedback in realizable PAC learning is $Θ(K)$. We complement this by revealing a stark contrast with the agnostic case, where the price of bandit feedback is only $O(1)$ as $\varepsilon \to 0$. Our algorithm utilizes a stochastic optimization technique to minimize a log-barrier potential based on Frank-Wolfe updates for computing a low-variance exploration distribution over the hypotheses, and is made computationally efficient provided access to an ERM oracle over $H$.
中摘: 我们研究多类PAC学习中的带宽反馈问题，其中输入被分类为$K$个可能标签之一，反馈仅限于预测标签是否正确。我们的主要贡献在于设计了一种新型的学习算法，该算法在任何有限假设类$H$上具有样本复杂度$O\big( (\operatorname{poly}(K) + 1 / \varepsilon^2) \log (|H| / δ) \big)$，这一样本复杂度优于现有问题的界限$O(K/\varepsilon^2)$，特别是在对$\varepsilon$的主要依赖性方面有所改进。此外，我们还将此结果扩展到一般的假设类，并建立了类似样本复杂度的界限，在这些界限中，$|H|\log$ 被替换为Natarajan维数。这与信息完整版本的问题最优速率相匹配，并解决了Daniely、Sabato、Ben-David和Shalev-Shwartz（2011年）研究的一个开放问题，他们展示了在可实现PAC学习中带宽反馈的乘性价格为$Θ(K)$。相比之下，在不可知论情况下，带宽反馈的价格仅在$\varepsilon \to 0$时为$O(1)$。我们的算法利用了随机优化技术来最小化基于Frank-Wolfe更新计算低方差探索分布的对数障碍潜力，并且只要能够访问$H$上的ERM预言机，就可以使算法高效运行。

[No.75] Classification Diffusion Models: Revitalizing Density Ratio Estimation
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 分类扩散模型：重振密度比率估计
类别: generative models
作者: Shahar Yadin;Noam Elata;Tomer Michaeli;
机构: Technion - Israel Institute of Technology;
类型: Poster
链接: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/94362
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10095
英摘: A prominent family of methods for learning data distributions relies on density ratio estimation (DRE), where a model is trained to $\textit{classify}$ between data samples and samples from some reference distribution. DRE-based models can directly output the likelihood for any given input, a highly desired property that is lacking in most generative techniques. Nevertheless, to date, DRE methods have failed in accurately capturing the distributions of complex high-dimensional data, like images, and have thus been drawing reduced research attention in recent years. In this work we present $\textit{classification diffusion models}$ (CDMs), a DRE-based generative method that adopts the formalism of denoising diffusion models (DDMs) while making use of a classifier that predicts the level of noise added to a clean signal. Our method is based on an analytical connection that we derive between the MSE-optimal denoiser for removing white Gaussian noise and the cross-entropy-optimal classifier for predicting the noise level. Our method is the first DRE-based technique that can successfully generate images beyond the MNIST dataset. Furthermore, it can output the likelihood of any input in a single forward pass, achieving state-of-the-art negative log likelihood (NLL) among methods with this property. Code is available on the project's webpage in https://shaharYadin.github.io/CDM/ .
中摘: 一种广泛使用的数据分布学习方法依赖于密度比率估计（DRE），该方法通过训练一个模型来对数据样本和某些参考分布的样本进行分类。基于DRE的模型可以直接输出任何给定输入的似然性，这是一个非常 desirable的特性，而大多数生成技术则缺乏这一特性。尽管如此，迄今为止，DRE方法在准确捕捉复杂高维数据（如图像）的分布方面表现不佳，并因此近年来受到了较少的研究关注。在这项工作中，我们提出了分类扩散模型（CDMs），这是一种基于DRE的生成方法，采用了去噪扩散模型（DDMs）的形式主义，同时利用了一个预测干净信号中添加噪声水平的分类器。我们的方法基于我们推导出的MSE最优去噪器与交叉熵最优分类器之间的分析连接，前者用于去除白高斯噪声，后者用于预测噪声水平。我们的方法是第一个能够在MNIST数据集之外成功生成图像的基于DRE的技术。此外，它可以在单次前向传递中输出任何输入的似然性，实现了具有这一特性的方法中的最佳负对数似然（NLL）。该项目的代码可在网页https://shaharYadin.github.io/CDM/ 上获取。

[No.77] How many classifiers do we need?
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 我们需要多少个分类器？
类别: learning theory
作者: Hyunsuk Kim;Liam Hodgkinson;Ryan Theisen;Michael W. Mahoney;
机构: University of California, Berkeley;University of Melbourne;
类型: Poster
链接: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/93775
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.00328
英摘: As performance gains through scaling data and/or model size experience diminishing returns, it is becoming increasingly popular to turn to ensembling, where the predictions of multiple models are combined to improve accuracy. In this paper, we provide a detailed analysis of how the disagreement and the polarization (a notion we introduce and define in this paper) among classifiers relate to the performance gain achieved by aggregating individual classifiers, for majority vote strategies in classification tasks. We address these questions in the following ways. (1) An upper bound for polarization is derived, and we propose what we call a neural polarization law: most interpolating neural network models are 4/3-polarized. Our empirical results not only support this conjecture but also show that polarization is nearly constant for a dataset, regardless of hyperparameters or architectures of classifiers. (2) The error of the majority vote classifier is considered under restricted entropy conditions, and we present a tight upper bound that indicates that the disagreement is linearly correlated with the target, and that the slope is linear in the polarization. (3) We prove results for the asymptotic behavior of the disagreement in terms of the number of classifiers, which we show can help in predicting the performance for a larger number of classifiers from that of a smaller number. Our theories and claims are supported by empirical results on several image classification tasks with various types of neural networks.
中摘: 随着通过扩展数据和/或模型规模所获得的性能提升逐渐递减，将多个模型的预测结果进行组合以提高准确性的集成方法变得越来越流行。在本文中，我们详细分析了分类器之间分歧和极化（我们在本文中引入并定义的概念）如何与分类任务中聚合个体分类器所实现的性能提升相关，特别是在多数投票策略中的表现。我们从以下几个方面来回答这些问题：(1) 我们推导出极化的上界，并提出所谓的神经极化定律：大多数插值神经网络模型具有4/3的极化度。我们的实证结果不仅支持这一猜想，还表明极化度几乎对数据集而言是恒定的，与分类器的超参数或架构无关。(2) 在受限熵条件下考虑多数投票分类器的误差，并给出一个紧致的上界，表明分歧与目标之间的关系呈线性相关，且斜率与极化度呈线性关系。(3) 我们证明了关于分歧随分类器数量变化的渐近行为的结果，这些结果表明极化度可以帮助我们从少量分类器的表现预测大量分类器的表现。我们的理论和主张得到了多种类型神经网络在若干图像分类任务上的实证结果的支持。

[No.78] Advancing Fine-Grained Classification by Structure and Subject Preserving Augmentation
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 基于结构和主题保真的细粒度分类增强方法
类别: machine vision
作者: Eyal Michaeli;Ohad Fried;
机构: Reichman University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/95527
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.14551
英摘: Fine-grained visual classification (FGVC) involves classifying closely related sub-classes. This task is difficult due to the subtle differences between classes and the high intra-class variance. Moreover, FGVC datasets are typically small and challenging to gather, thus highlighting a significant need for effective data augmentation. Recent advancements in text-to-image diffusion models offer new possibilities for augmenting classification datasets. While these models have been used to generate training data for classification tasks, their effectiveness in full-dataset training of FGVC models remains under-explored. Recent techniques that rely on Text2Image generation or Img2Img methods, often struggle to generate images that accurately represent the class while modifying them to a degree that significantly increases the dataset's diversity. To address these challenges, we present SaSPA: Structure and Subject Preserving Augmentation. Contrary to recent methods, our method does not use real images as guidance, thereby increasing generation flexibility and promoting greater diversity. To ensure accurate class representation, we employ conditioning mechanisms, specifically by conditioning on image edges and subject representation. We conduct extensive experiments and benchmark SaSPA against both traditional and recent generative data augmentation methods. SaSPA consistently outperforms all established baselines across multiple settings, including full dataset training, contextual bias, and few-shot classification. Additionally, our results reveal interesting patterns in using synthetic data for FGVC models; for instance, we find a relationship between the amount of real data used and the optimal proportion of synthetic data. Code is available at https://github.com/EyalMichaeli/SaSPA-Aug.
中摘: 细粒度视觉分类（FGVC）涉及对密切相关的子类进行分类。由于类之间的细微差异以及高类内方差，这项任务非常困难。此外，FGVC数据集通常较小且收集起来具有挑战性，因此突显了有效数据增强的显著需求。最近在文本到图像扩散模型方面的进展为增强分类数据集提供了新的可能性。尽管这些模型已被用于生成分类任务的训练数据，但它们在FGVC模型的全数据集训练中的有效性仍被低估。依赖于文本到图像生成或图像到图像方法的近期技术往往难以生成准确代表类别的图像，同时又在一定程度上极大地增加了数据集的多样性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了SaSPA：结构和主题保留增强。与近期方法不同，我们的方法不使用真实图像作为指导，从而增加生成的灵活性并促进更大的多样性。为了确保类别表示的准确性，我们采用了条件机制，特别是通过图像边缘和主题表示进行条件化。我们在广泛的实验中对比了SaSPA与传统及近期生成数据增强方法，并发现SaSPA在多个设置中（包括全数据集训练、上下文偏差和少样本分类）始终优于所有已建立的基础模型。此外，我们的结果揭示了使用合成数据对FGVC模型有用的有趣模式；例如，我们发现了真实数据量与合成数据最优比例之间的关系。代码可在https://github.com/EyalMichaeli/SaSPA-Aug获取。

[No.79] FAST: A Dual-tier Few-Shot Learning Paradigm for Whole Slide Image Classification
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 快速分类：一种双层少样本学习框架用于全切片图像分类
类别: machine vision
作者: Kexue Fu;xiaoyuan Luo;Linhao Qu;Shuo Wang;Ying Xiong;Ilias Maglogiannis;Longxiang Gao;Manning Wang;
机构: Qilu University of Technology;Fudan University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/96289
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.19720
英摘: The expensive fine-grained annotation and data scarcity have become the primary obstacles for the widespread adoption of deep learning-based Whole Slide Images (WSI) classification algorithms in clinical practice. Unlike few-shot learning methods in natural images that can leverage the labels of each image, existing few-shot WSI classification methods only utilize a small number of fine-grained labels or weakly supervised slide labels for training in order to avoid expensive fine-grained annotation. They lack sufficient mining of available WSIs, severely limiting WSI classification performance. To address the above issues, we propose a novel and efficient dual-tier few-shot learning paradigm for WSI classification, named FAST. FAST consists of a dual-level annotation strategy and a dual-branch classification framework. Firstly, to avoid expensive fine-grained annotation, we collect a very small number of WSIs at the slide level, and annotate an extremely small number of patches. Then, to fully mining the available WSIs, we use all the patches and available patch labels to build a cache branch, which utilizes the labeled patches to learn the labels of unlabeled patches and through knowledge retrieval for patch classification. In addition to the cache branch, we also construct a prior branch that includes learnable prompt vectors, using the text encoder of visual-language models for patch classification. Finally, we integrate the results from both branches to achieve WSI classification. Extensive experiments on binary and multi-class datasets demonstrate that our proposed method significantly surpasses existing few-shot classification methods and approaches the accuracy of fully supervised methods with only 0.22$\%$ annotation costs. All codes and models will be publicly available on https://github.com/fukexue/FAST.
中摘: 基于深度学习的全切片图像（Whole Slide Images，WSI）分类算法在临床实践中的广泛应用受到了精细标注成本高昂和数据稀缺性的主要阻碍。与自然图像中少量样本学习方法可以利用每张图像的标签不同，现有的少量样本WSI分类方法仅利用少量的精细标签或弱监督切片标签进行训练，以避免昂贵的精细标注。这些方法未能充分挖掘可用的WSI，严重限制了WSI分类性能。为了解决上述问题，我们提出了一种新颖且高效的两层少量样本学习范式，名为FAST。FAST由两层标注策略和两分支分类框架组成。首先，为了规避精细标注的成本，我们在切片级别收集极少量的WSI，并标注极少量的patches。然后，为了充分利用可用的WSI，我们使用所有patches和可用的patch标签构建缓存分支，该分支利用已标注的patches来学习未标注patches的标签，并通过知识检索来进行patch分类。除了缓存分支外，我们还构建了一个先验分支，其中包括可学习的提示向量，使用视觉语言模型的文本编码器进行patch分类。最后，我们将两个分支的结果结合起来，实现WSI分类。在二分类和多分类数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们提出的方法显著超越了现有的少量样本分类方法，并且仅需0.22%的标注成本就能接近完全监督方法的准确性。所有代码和模型将在https://github.com/fukexue/FAST上公开提供。

[No.89] Bandit-Feedback Online Multiclass Classification: Variants and Tradeoffs
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题:  bandit反馈在线多类分类：变体与权衡
类别: online learning
作者: Yuval Filmus;Steve Hanneke;Idan Mehalel;Shay Moran;

英摘: Consider the domain of multiclass classification within the adversarial online setting. What is the price of relying on bandit feedback as opposed to full information? To what extent can an adaptive adversary amplify the loss compared to an oblivious one? To what extent can a randomized learner reduce the loss compared to a deterministic one? We study these questions in the mistake bound model and provide nearly tight answers.
  We demonstrate that the optimal mistake bound under bandit feedback is at most $O(k)$ times higher than the optimal mistake bound in the full information case, where $k$ represents the number of labels. This bound is tight and provides an answer to an open question previously posed and studied by Daniely and Helbertal ['13] and by Long ['17, '20], who focused on deterministic learners.
  Moreover, we present nearly optimal bounds of $\tildeΘ(k)$ on the gap between randomized and deterministic learners, as well as between adaptive and oblivious adversaries in the bandit feedback setting. This stands in contrast to the full information scenario, where adaptive and oblivious adversaries are equivalent, and the gap in mistake bounds between randomized and deterministic learners is a constant multiplicative factor of $2$.
  In addition, our results imply that in some cases the optimal randomized mistake bound is approximately the square-root of its deterministic parallel. Previous results show that this is essentially the smallest it can get.
中摘: 在对抗在线设置下的多类分类领域，依赖于bandit反馈而非完整信息会付出什么代价？适应性对手在bandit反馈设置下相较于非适应性对手能放大损失到何种程度？随机化学习者相较于确定性学习者能在多大程度上减少损失？我们在这类问题的研究中使用了错误上限模型，并提供了几乎精确的答案。

此外，我们在bandit反馈设置下给出了随机化学习者与确定性学习者之间的差距以及适应性对手与非适应性对手之间的差距的几乎最优界$\tildeΘ(k)$。这与完整信息场景形成了对比，在完整信息场景下，适应性和非适应性对手是等价的，而随机化学习者与确定性学习者之间的错误上限差距仅为一个常数倍因子2。

另外，我们的结果还表明，在某些情况下，最优的随机化错误上限大约是其确定性平行版本的平方根。之前的成果显示，这种情况几乎是可能达到的最小值。

[No.90] Building a stable classifier with the inflated argmax
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 使用膨胀argmax构建一个稳定的分类器
类别: learning theory
作者: Jake A Soloff;Rina Foygel Barber;Rebecca Willett;

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.14064
英摘: We propose a new framework for algorithmic stability in the context of multiclass classification. In practice, classification algorithms often operate by first assigning a continuous score (for instance, an estimated probability) to each possible label, then taking the maximizer -- i.e., selecting the class that has the highest score. A drawback of this type of approach is that it is inherently unstable, meaning that it is very sensitive to slight perturbations of the training data, since taking the maximizer is discontinuous. Motivated by this challenge, we propose a pipeline for constructing stable classifiers from data, using bagging (i.e., resampling and averaging) to produce stable continuous scores, and then using a stable relaxation of argmax, which we call the "inflated argmax," to convert these scores to a set of candidate labels. The resulting stability guarantee places no distributional assumptions on the data, does not depend on the number of classes or dimensionality of the covariates, and holds for any base classifier. Using a common benchmark data set, we demonstrate that the inflated argmax provides necessary protection against unstable classifiers, without loss of accuracy.
中摘: 我们提出了一种新的框架，用于多类分类背景下算法稳定性的问题。实践中，分类算法通常通过首先为每个可能的标签分配一个连续得分（例如，估计的概率），然后选择得分最高的类别来运作。这种方法的一个缺点是它本质上是不稳定的，即对训练数据的微小扰动非常敏感，因为选择最大值是不连续的。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种管道方法，用于从数据中构建稳定的分类器。该方法使用自助法（即重采样和平均）来生成稳定的连续得分，然后使用argmax的一种稳定松弛形式，即“膨胀argmax”，将这些得分转换为候选标签集。这种稳定性保证不对数据分布做出任何假设，也不依赖于类别的数量或协变量的维度，并适用于任何基础分类器。通过一个常见的基准数据集，我们展示了膨胀argmax能够提供必要的保护，以防止不稳定分类器的影响，同时不会损失准确性。

Extensive experiments across multiple datasets validate the effectiveness of Con4m in handling segmented TSC tasks on MVD. The source code is available at https://github.com/MrNobodyCali/Con4m.
中摘: 时间序列分类（TSC）包含两种设置：整个序列分类或分段子序列分类。对于分段TSC而言，原始的时间序列通常包含多个具有不同持续时间的类（MVD）。因此，MVD的特点为分段TSC带来了独特的挑战，但这些挑战在现有研究中却往往被忽视。具体来说，在MVD中，需要分类的连续实例（片段）之间存在自然的时间依赖性。然而，主流的TSC模型依赖于独立且同分布（i.i.d.）的假设，专注于独立地建模每个片段。此外，不同专业水平的注释者可能会提供不一致的边界标签，导致无噪声TSC模型的性能不稳定。为了应对这些挑战，我们首先正式证明了有价值的上下文信息可以增强分类实例的区分能力。利用MVD在数据和标签层面的上下文先验，我们提出了一种新的一致性学习框架Con4m，该框架有效地利用了更有利于区分连续片段的上下文信息，并通过和谐化不一致的边界标签来提高训练效果。在多个数据集上的广泛实验验证了Con4m在处理MVD中的分段TSC任务方面的有效性。源代码可在https://github.com/MrNobodyCali/Con4m获取。

[No.100] Fast Graph Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Enhancing and Accelerating Few-Shot Node Classification
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 快速图形锐化感知最小化方法用于增强和加速少-shot节点分类
类别: graph neural networks
作者: Yihong Luo;Yuhan Chen;Siya Qiu;Yiwei Wang;Chen Zhang;Yan Zhou;Xiaochun Cao;Jing Tang;

英摘: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown superior performance in node classification. However, GNNs perform poorly in the Few-Shot Node Classification (FSNC) task that requires robust generalization to make accurate predictions for unseen classes with limited labels. To tackle the challenge, we propose the integration of Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM)--a technique designed to enhance model generalization by finding a flat minimum of the loss landscape--into GNN training. The standard SAM approach, however, consists of two forward-backward steps in each training iteration, doubling the computational cost compared to the base optimizer (e.g., Adam). To mitigate this drawback, we introduce a novel algorithm, Fast Graph Sharpness-Aware Minimization (FGSAM), that integrates the rapid training of Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) with the superior performance of GNNs. Specifically, we utilize GNNs for parameter perturbation while employing MLPs to minimize the perturbed loss so that we can find a flat minimum with good generalization more efficiently. Moreover, our method reutilizes the gradient from the perturbation phase to incorporate graph topology into the minimization process at almost zero additional cost. To further enhance training efficiency, we develop FGSAM+ that executes exact perturbations periodically. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed algorithm outperforms the standard SAM with lower computational costs in FSNC tasks. In particular, our FGSAM+ as a SAM variant offers a faster optimization than the base optimizer in most cases. In addition to FSNC, our proposed methods also demonstrate competitive performance in the standard node classification task for heterophilic graphs, highlighting the broad applicability. The code is available at https://github.com/draym28/FGSAM_NeurIPS24.
中摘: 图神经网络（GNNs）在节点分类任务中表现出了优越的性能。然而，在需要在有限标签的情况下对未见过的类进行准确预测的少量样本节点分类（Few-Shot Node Classification, FSNC）任务中，GNNs 表现不佳。为应对这一挑战，我们提出将一种名为 Sharpness-Aware Minimization（SAM）的技术——该技术旨在通过寻找损失景观中的平坦最小值来增强模型的泛化能力——整合到 GNN 训练中。标准的 SAM 方法在每次训练迭代中包含两个前向-后向步骤，与基础优化器（如 Adam）相比，计算成本翻倍。为了缓解这一问题，我们引入了一种新型算法——快速图 Sharpness-Aware Minimization（FGSAM），该算法结合了多层感知机（MLPs）的快速训练能力和 GNN 的优越性能。具体而言，我们利用 GNN 进行参数扰动，同时使用 MLPs 来最小化扰动后的损失，从而更高效地找到具有良好泛化能力的平坦最小值。此外，我们的方法在扰动阶段重新利用梯度，几乎不增加额外成本的情况下将图拓扑结构纳入最小化过程。为进一步提高训练效率，我们开发了 FGSAM+，该算法定期执行精确扰动。大量实验表明，我们提出的算法在 FSNC 任务中具有较低的计算成本且性能优于标准的 SAM 方法。特别是，我们的 FGSAM+ 作为 SAM 变体，在大多数情况下提供了比基础优化器更快的优化。除了 FSNC 任务，我们提出的方法也在异构图的标准节点分类任务中展示了竞争力，突显了其广泛的适用性。相关代码可在 https://github.com/draym28/FGSAM_NeurIPS24 获取。

[No.101] Bayesian Strategic Classification
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 贝叶斯战略分类
类别: algorithmic game theory
作者: Lee Cohen;Saeed Sharifi -Malvajerdi;Kevin Stangl;Ali Vakilian;Juba Ziani;
机构: Stanford University;Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago;Georgia Institute of Technology;
类型: Poster
链接: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/95094
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.08758
英摘: In strategic classification, agents modify their features, at a cost, to ideally obtain a positive classification from the learner's classifier. The typical response of the learner is to carefully modify their classifier to be robust to such strategic behavior. When reasoning about agent manipulations, most papers that study strategic classification rely on the following strong assumption: agents fully know the exact parameters of the deployed classifier by the learner. This often is an unrealistic assumption when using complex or proprietary machine learning techniques in real-world prediction tasks.
  We initiate the study of partial information release by the learner in strategic classification. We move away from the traditional assumption that agents have full knowledge of the classifier. Instead, we consider agents that have a common distributional prior on which classifier the learner is using. The learner in our model can reveal truthful, yet not necessarily complete, information about the deployed classifier to the agents. The learner's goal is to release just enough information about the classifier to maximize accuracy. We show how such partial information release can, counter-intuitively, benefit the learner's accuracy, despite increasing agents' abilities to manipulate.
  We show that while it is intractable to compute the best response of an agent in the general case, there exist oracle-efficient algorithms that can solve the best response of the agents when the learner's hypothesis class is the class of linear classifiers, or when the agents' cost function satisfies a natural notion of submodularity as we define. We then turn our attention to the learner's optimization problem and provide both positive and negative results on the algorithmic problem of how much information the learner should release about the classifier to maximize their expected accuracy.
中摘: 在战略分类中，代理会以一定的成本修改其特征，以便从学习者的分类器中理想地获得正面分类。学习者通常会对这种战略行为进行仔细调整，使其分类器更具鲁棒性。大多数研究战略分类的论文都基于以下强烈假设：代理完全了解学习者部署的具体分类器参数。然而，在使用复杂或专有的机器学习技术处理现实世界的预测任务时，这一假设往往是不现实的。

我们开始研究学习者在战略分类中的部分信息释放。我们不再依赖传统假设，即代理完全知晓分类器的信息。相反，我们考虑代理对学习者使用的分类器具有共同的概率先验分布的情况。在我们的模型中，学习者可以向代理透露关于已部署分类器的真实但未必完整的信息。学习者的目标是仅透露足够的分类器信息以最大化准确性。我们展示了即使增加代理操纵的能力，这种部分信息释放也可以出乎意料地提高学习者的准确性。

我们证明，在一般情况下计算代理的最佳响应是不可解的，但在特定条件下存在高效的算法来解决代理的最佳响应问题。具体而言，当学习者的假设类是线性分类器类，或者当代理的成本函数满足我们定义的自然子模性概念时，这样的高效算法是存在的。然后我们将注意力转向学习者优化问题，并提供了关于学习者应透露多少分类器信息以最大化其预期准确性的正反面结果。

英摘: We study online classification under smoothed adversaries. [No.111] Graph Classification via Reference Distribution Learning: Theory and Practice
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 通过参考分布学习进行图分类：理论与实践
类别: graph neural networks
作者: Zixiao Wang;Jicong Fan;
机构: Chinese University of Hong Kong;
类型: Poster
链接: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/96839
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.11370
英摘: Graph classification is a challenging problem owing to the difficulty in quantifying the similarity between graphs or representing graphs as vectors, though there have been a few methods using graph kernels or graph neural networks (GNNs). Graph kernels often suffer from computational costs and manual feature engineering, while GNNs commonly utilize global pooling operations, risking the loss of structural or semantic information. This work introduces Graph Reference Distribution Learning (GRDL), an efficient and accurate graph classification method. GRDL treats each graph's latent node embeddings given by GNN layers as a discrete distribution, enabling direct classification without global pooling, based on maximum mean discrepancy to adaptively learned reference distributions. To fully understand this new model (the existing theories do not apply) and guide its configuration (e.g., network architecture, references' sizes, number, and regularization) for practical use, we derive generalization error bounds for GRDL and verify them numerically. More importantly, our theoretical and numerical results both show that GRDL has a stronger generalization ability than GNNs with global pooling operations. Experiments on moderate-scale and large-scale graph datasets show the superiority of GRDL over the state-of-the-art, emphasizing its remarkable efficiency, being at least 10 times faster than leading competitors in both training and inference stages.
中摘: 图分类是一个具有挑战性的问题，原因在于量化图之间的相似性或表示图作为向量的难度，尽管已经有一些方法使用图核或图神经网络（GNNs）。图核通常会遭受计算成本高和手动特征工程的困扰，而GNNs则经常利用全局池化操作，这可能会导致结构或语义信息的丢失。本研究引入了图参考分布学习（GRDL），这是一种高效且准确的图分类方法。GRDL 将每个图由 GNN 层生成的潜在节点嵌入视为离散分布，从而可以直接进行分类，无需全局池化，基于最大均值偏差来适应性地学习参考分布。为了完全理解这一新模型（现有理论不适用）并指导其配置（例如，网络架构、参考分布的大小、数量和正则化）以实现实际应用，我们推导了 GRDL 的泛化误差界，并进行了数值验证。更重要的是，我们的理论和数值结果都表明，GRDL 的泛化能力比带有全局池化操作的 GNNs 更强。在中等规模和大规模图数据集上的实验表明，GRDL 在训练和推理阶段至少比领先竞争对手快 10 倍，突显了其显著的效率优势。

[No.115] Neuronal Competition Groups with Supervised STDP for Spike-Based Classification
来源: NeurIPS 2024

英摘: Spike Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP) is a promising substitute to backpropagation for local training of Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) on neuromorphic hardware. STDP allows SNNs to address classification tasks by combining unsupervised STDP for feature extraction and supervised STDP for classification. Unsupervised STDP is usually employed with Winner-Takes-All (WTA) competition to learn distinct patterns. However, WTA for supervised STDP classification faces unbalanced competition challenges. We incorporate our proposed architecture into spiking classification layers trained with state-of-the-art supervised STDP rules. On top of two different unsupervised feature extractors, we obtain significant accuracy improvements on image recognition datasets such as CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100. [No.119] Amnesia as a Catalyst for Enhancing Black Box Pixel Attacks in Image Classification and Object Detection
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 记忆丧失作为增强黑盒像素攻击在图像分类和目标检测中的催化剂
类别: machine vision
作者: Dongsu Song;Daehwa Ko;Jay Hoon Jung;
机构: Korea Aerospace University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/95435
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.07821
英摘: It is well known that query-based attacks tend to have relatively higher success rates in adversarial black-box attacks. While research on black-box attacks is actively being conducted, relatively few studies have focused on pixel attacks that target only a limited number of pixels. In image classification, query-based pixel attacks often rely on patches, which heavily depend on randomness and neglect the fact that scattered pixels are more suitable for adversarial attacks. Moreover, to the best of our knowledge, query-based pixel attacks have not been explored in the field of object detection. To address these issues, we propose a novel pixel-based black-box attack called Remember and Forget Pixel Attack using Reinforcement Learning(RFPAR), consisting of two main components: the Remember and Forget processes. RFPAR mitigates randomness and avoids patch dependency by leveraging rewards generated through a one-step RL algorithm to perturb pixels. RFPAR effectively creates perturbed images that minimize the confidence scores while adhering to limited pixel constraints. Furthermore, we advance our proposed attack beyond image classification to object detection, where RFPAR reduces the confidence scores of detected objects to avoid detection. Experiments on the ImageNet-1K dataset for classification show that RFPAR outperformed state-of-the-art query-based pixel attacks. For object detection, using the MSCOCO dataset with YOLOv8 and DDQ, RFPAR demonstrates comparable mAP reduction to state-of-the-art query-based attack while requiring fewer query. Further experiments on the Argoverse dataset using YOLOv8 confirm that RFPAR effectively removed objects on a larger scale dataset. Our code is available at https://github.com/KAU-QuantumAILab/RFPAR.

[No.120] Optimal Classification under Performative Distribution Shift
来源: NeurIPS 2024
命中: classif
标题: 最优分类下的表现性分布偏移分类
类别: optimization
作者: Edwige Cyffers;Muni Sreenivas Pydi;Jamal Atif;Olivier Cappé;
机构: INRIA;Université Paris Dauphine;Université Paris-Dauphine;Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique;
类型: Poster
链接: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/96756
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.02023
英摘: Performative learning addresses the increasingly pervasive situations in which algorithmic decisions may induce changes in the data distribution as a consequence of their public deployment. We propose a novel view in which these performative effects are modelled as push-forward measures. This general framework encompasses existing models and enables novel performative gradient estimation methods, leading to more efficient and scalable learning strategies. For distribution shifts, unlike previous models which require full specification of the data distribution, we only assume knowledge of the shift operator that represents the performative changes. This approach can also be integrated into various change-of-variablebased models, such as VAEs or normalizing flows. Focusing on classification with a linear-in-parameters performative effect, we prove the convexity of the performative risk under a new set of assumptions. Notably, we do not limit the strength of performative effects but rather their direction, requiring only that classification becomes harder when deploying more accurate models. In this case, we also establish a connection with adversarially robust classification by reformulating the minimization of the performative risk as a min-max variational problem. Finally, we illustrate our approach on synthetic and real datasets.
中摘: 表现性学习关注的是算法决策在公共部署后可能会引起数据分布的变化的情况。我们提出了一种新的观点，将这些表现性效应建模为推进测度。这一通用框架涵盖了现有的模型，并允许开发新的表现性梯度估计方法，从而实现更高效和可扩展的学习策略。对于数据分布转移，不同于以往需要完全指定数据分布的模型，我们仅假设了解表示现性变化的数据转移算子。这种方法还可以集成到各种变量变换基础上的模型中，例如VAEs或归一化流。专注于具有参数线性表现性效应的分类问题，我们证明了在一组新假设下，表现性风险是凸的。值得注意的是，我们不限制表现性效应的强度，而是限制其方向，只需确保使用更准确的模型进行部署会使分类变得更困难。在这种情况下，我们还通过重新表述表现性风险最小化为一个极小极大变分问题，建立了与对抗鲁棒分类之间的联系。最后，我们在合成和真实数据集上展示了我们的方法。

[No.124] Why are Visually-Grounded Language Models Bad at Image Classification?

英摘: Image classification is one of the most fundamental capabilities of machine vision intelligence. In this work, we revisit the image classification task using visually-grounded language models (VLMs) such as GPT-4V and LLaVA. We find that existing proprietary and public VLMs, despite often using CLIP as a vision encoder and having many more parameters, significantly underperform CLIP on standard image classification benchmarks like ImageNet. To understand the reason, we explore several hypotheses concerning the inference algorithms, training objectives, and data processing in VLMs. Our analysis reveals that the primary cause is data-related: critical information for image classification is encoded in the VLM's latent space but can only be effectively decoded with enough training data. Specifically, there is a strong correlation between the frequency of class exposure during VLM training and instruction-tuning and the VLM's performance in those classes; when trained with sufficient data, VLMs can match the accuracy of state-of-the-art classification models. Based on these findings, we enhance a VLM by integrating classification-focused datasets into its training, and demonstrate that the enhanced classification performance of the VLM transfers to its general capabilities, resulting in an improvement of 11.8% on the newly collected ImageWikiQA dataset.
