[No.359] SCISSOR: Mitigating Semantic Bias through Cluster-Aware Siamese Networks for Robust Classification
来源: ICML 2025
命中: classif
标题: 剪刀：通过集群感知双胞胎网络减轻语义偏见以实现稳健分类
类别: social aspects->robustness
作者: Shuo Yang;Bardh Prenkaj;Gjergji Kasneci;
机构: ;Technische Universität München;University of Tuebingen;
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2025/poster/45266
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.14587
英摘: Shortcut learning undermines model generalization to out-of-distribution data. While the literature attributes shortcuts to biases in superficial features, we show that imbalances in the semantic distribution of sample embeddings induce spurious semantic correlations, compromising model robustness. To address this issue, we propose SCISSOR (Semantic Cluster Intervention for Suppressing ShORtcut), a Siamese network-based debiasing approach that remaps the semantic space by discouraging latent clusters exploited as shortcuts. Unlike prior data-debiasing approaches, SCISSOR eliminates the need for data augmentation and rewriting. We evaluate SCISSOR on 6 models across 4 benchmarks: Chest-XRay and Not-MNIST in computer vision, and GYAFC and Yelp in NLP tasks. Compared to several baselines, SCISSOR reports +5.3 absolute points in F1 score on GYAFC, +7.3 on Yelp, +7.7 on Chest-XRay, and +1 on Not-MNIST. SCISSOR is also highly advantageous for lightweight models with ~9.5% improvement on F1 for ViT on computer vision datasets and ~11.9% for BERT on NLP. Our study redefines the landscape of model generalization by addressing overlooked semantic biases, establishing SCISSOR as a foundational framework for mitigating shortcut learning and fostering more robust, bias-resistant AI systems.
中摘: 快捷学习会削弱模型对未标记数据的泛化能力。尽管文献将快捷学习归因于表层特征上的偏差，我们证明了样本嵌入在语义分布上的不平衡会诱导虚假的语义相关性，损害模型的鲁棒性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SCISSOR（语义簇干预以抑制快捷），这是一种基于双胞胎网络的去偏方法，通过抵制被用作快捷学习的潜在语义簇来重新映射语义空间。与之前的基于数据的去偏方法不同，SCISSOR 消除了数据增强和重写的需求。我们在4个基准任务上的6个模型上评估了SCISSOR：计算机视觉中的Chest-XRay和Not-MNIST，以及自然语言处理中的GYAFC和Yelp。与几个基线相比，SCISSOR 在GYAFC上的F1分数提高了5.3个百分点，在Yelp上的F1分数提高了7.3个百分点，在Chest-XRay上的F1分数提高了7.7个百分点，在Not-MNIST上的F1分数提高了1个百分点。对于轻量级模型，SCISSOR 也具有显著优势，例如在计算机视觉数据集上ViT的F1分数提高了约9.5%，在NLP任务上BERT的F1分数提高了约11.9%。我们的研究通过解决被忽视的语义偏差，重新定义了模型泛化的景观，并将SCISSOR 建立为基础框架，用于缓解快捷学习并促进更稳健、更具抗偏差性的AI系统。

[No.361] $f$-Divergence Based Classification: Beyond the Use of Cross-Entropy
来源: ICML 2024
命中: classif
标题: 基于$f$散度的分类：超越交叉熵的应用
类别: 
作者: Nicola Novello;Andrea M Tonello;
机构: Alpen-Adria-Universität Klagenfurt;
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2024/poster/34057
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.01268
英摘: In deep learning, classification tasks are formalized as optimization problems often solved via the minimization of the cross-entropy. However, recent advancements in the design of objective functions allow the usage of the $f$-divergence to generalize the formulation of the optimization problem for classification. We adopt a Bayesian perspective and formulate the classification task as a maximum a posteriori probability problem. We propose a class of objective functions based on the variational representation of the $f$-divergence. Furthermore, driven by the challenge of improving the state-of-the-art approach, we propose a bottom-up method that leads us to the formulation of an objective function corresponding to a novel $f$-divergence referred to as shifted log (SL). We theoretically analyze the objective functions proposed and numerically test them in three application scenarios: toy examples, image datasets, and signal detection/decoding problems. The analyzed scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach and that the SL divergence achieves the highest classification accuracy in almost all the considered cases.
中摘: 在深度学习中，分类任务通常被形式化为优化问题，并且经常通过最小化交叉熵来求解。然而，最近在目标函数设计方面的进展允许使用$f$-散度来泛化分类优化问题的表述。我们从贝叶斯视角出发，将分类任务形式化为最大后验概率问题。我们提出了一类基于$f$-散度变分表示的目标函数。此外，受提高现有最佳方法性能的挑战驱动，我们提出了一种自底向上的方法，这促使我们提出了一个与一种新型$f$-散度——移位对数（SL）相对应的目标函数。我们对提出的这些目标函数进行了理论分析，并在三种应用场景中进行了数值测试：玩具示例、图像数据集以及信号检测/解码问题。分析的场景展示了所提方法的有效性，并表明SL散度在几乎所有考虑的情况下都能实现最高的分类准确性。

类别:

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05765
英摘: This paper introduces a novel methodology for Feature Selection for Functional Classification, FSFC, that addresses the challenge of jointly performing feature selection and classification of functional data in scenarios with categorical responses and multivariate longitudinal features. FSFC tackles a newly defined optimization problem that integrates logistic loss and functional features to identify the most crucial variables for classification. To address the minimization procedure, we employ functional principal components and develop a new adaptive version of the Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm. The computational efficiency of FSFC enables handling high-dimensional scenarios where the number of features may considerably exceed the number of statistical units. Simulation experiments demonstrate that FSFC outperforms other machine learning and deep learning methods in computational time and classification accuracy. Furthermore, the FSFC feature selection capability can be leveraged to significantly reduce the problem's dimensionality and enhance the performances of other classification algorithms. The efficacy of FSFC is also demonstrated through a real data application, analyzing relationships between four chronic diseases and other health and demographic factors.
中摘: 本文介绍了一种新颖的功能分类特征选择方法（FSFC），该方法解决了在具有类别响应和多变量纵向特征的情况下同时进行功能数据的特征选择和分类的挑战。FSFC解决了一个新定义的优化问题，将逻辑损失和功能特征整合在一起，以识别分类中最关键的变量。为了应对最小化过程，我们采用了功能性主成分，并开发了新的双增广拉格朗日算法的自适应版本。FSFC的计算效率使其能够处理高维场景，在这种场景下，特征的数量可能会显著超过统计单位的数量。模拟实验表明，与其它机器学习和深度学习方法相比，FSFC在计算时间和分类准确性方面表现更优。此外，FSFC的特征选择能力可以显著降低问题的维度，并提升其他分类算法的性能。通过实际数据应用，本文还分析了四种慢性疾病与其他健康和人口统计因素之间的关系，进一步证明了FSFC的有效性。

英摘: Bayesian few-shot classification has been a focal point in the field of few-shot learning. This paper seamlessly integrates mirror descent-based variational inference into Gaussian process-based few-shot classification, addressing the challenge of non-conjugate inference. By leveraging non-Euclidean geometry, mirror descent achieves accelerated convergence by providing the steepest descent direction along the corresponding manifold. It also exhibits the parameterization invariance property concerning the variational distribution. [No.364] Accelerating Heterogeneous Federated Learning with Closed-form Classifiers
来源: ICML 2024
命中: classif
标题: 加速异构联邦学习的闭形式分类器方法
类别: 
作者: Eros Fanì;Raffaello Camoriano;Barbara Caputo;Marco Ciccone;
机构: Polytechnic University of Turin;Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia;Sapienza University of Rome;Vector Institute;
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2024/poster/33597
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.01116
英摘: Federated Learning (FL) methods often struggle in highly statistically heterogeneous settings. Indeed, non-IID data distributions cause client drift and biased local solutions, particularly pronounced in the final classification layer, negatively impacting convergence speed and accuracy. To address this issue, we introduce Federated Recursive Ridge Regression (Fed3R). Our method fits a Ridge Regression classifier computed in closed form leveraging pre-trained features. Fed3R is immune to statistical heterogeneity and is invariant to the sampling order of the clients. Therefore, it proves particularly effective in cross-device scenarios. Furthermore, it is fast and efficient in terms of communication and computation costs, requiring up to two orders of magnitude fewer resources than the competitors. Finally, we propose to leverage the Fed3R parameters as an initialization for a softmax classifier and subsequently fine-tune the model using any FL algorithm (Fed3R with Fine-Tuning, Fed3R+FT). Our findings also indicate that maintaining a fixed classifier aids in stabilizing the training and learning more discriminative features in cross-device settings. Official website: https://fed-3r.github.io/.
中摘: 联邦学习（FL）方法在高度统计异质性环境中常常遇到困难。事实上，非IID数据分布会导致客户端漂移和有偏的局部解决方案，特别是在最终分类层表现得尤为明显，这对收敛速度和准确性产生了负面影响。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了联邦递归岭回归（Fed3R）。该方法利用预训练特征计算闭式形式的岭回归分类器。Fed3R对统计异质性具有免疫力，并且不受客户端采样顺序的影响。因此，它特别适用于跨设备场景。此外，Fed3R在通信和计算成本方面快速且高效，所需的资源比竞争对手少两个数量级。最后，我们提出利用Fed3R参数作为softmax分类器的初始化，并随后使用任何FL算法进行微调（带有微调的Fed3R，即Fed3R+FT）。我们的研究结果还表明，在跨设备设置中保持固定分类器有助于稳定训练并学习更具区分性的特征。官方网站：https://fed-3r.github.io/。

[No.365] Automated Loss function Search for Class-imbalanced Node Classification

标题: 自动化的损失函数搜索用于类不平衡节点分类
类别:

英摘: Class-imbalanced node classification tasks are prevalent in real-world scenarios. Due to the uneven distribution of nodes across different classes, learning high-quality node representations remains a challenging endeavor. The engineering of loss functions has shown promising potential in addressing this issue. It involves the meticulous design of loss functions, utilizing information about the quantities of nodes in different categories and the network's topology to learn unbiased node representations. [No.367] Classification under Nuisance Parameters and Generalized Label Shift in Likelihood-Free Inference
来源: ICML 2024
命中: classif
标题: 无害参数和广义标签转移在似然-free推断中的分类
类别: 
作者: Luca Masserano;Alexander Shen;Michele Doro;Tommaso Dorigo;Rafael Izbicki;Ann B. Lee;
机构: Carnegie Mellon University;Universidade Federal de Sao Carlos;
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2024/poster/34050
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.05330
英摘: An open scientific challenge is how to classify events with reliable measures of uncertainty, when we have a mechanistic model of the data-generating process but the distribution over both labels and latent nuisance parameters is different between train and target data. We refer to this type of distributional shift as generalized label shift (GLS). Direct classification using observed data $\mathbf{X}$ as covariates leads to biased predictions and invalid uncertainty estimates of labels $Y$. We overcome these biases by proposing a new method for robust uncertainty quantification that casts classification as a hypothesis testing problem under nuisance parameters. The key idea is to estimate the classifier's receiver operating characteristic (ROC) across the entire nuisance parameter space, which allows us to devise cutoffs that are invariant under GLS. Our method effectively endows a pre-trained classifier with domain adaptation capabilities and returns valid prediction sets while maintaining high power. We demonstrate its performance on two challenging scientific problems in biology and astroparticle physics with data from realistic mechanistic models.

[No.378] Efficient Online Set-valued Classification with Bandit Feedback
来源: ICML 2024
命中: classif
标题: 高效的在线集值分类与bandit反馈
类别: 
作者: Zhou Wang;Xingye Qiao;

类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2024/poster/34063
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04393
英摘: Conformal prediction is a distribution-free method that wraps a given machine learning model and returns a set of plausible labels that contain the true label with a prescribed coverage rate. In practice, the empirical coverage achieved highly relies on fully observed label information from data both in the training phase for model fitting and the calibration phase for quantile estimation. This dependency poses a challenge in the context of online learning with bandit feedback, where a learner only has access to the correctness of actions (i.e., pulled an arm) but not the full information of the true label. In particular, when the pulled arm is incorrect, the learner only knows that the pulled one is not the true class label, but does not know which label is true. Additionally, bandit feedback further results in a smaller labeled dataset for calibration, limited to instances with correct actions, thereby affecting the accuracy of quantile estimation. To address these limitations, we propose Bandit Class-specific Conformal Prediction (BCCP), offering coverage guarantees on a class-specific granularity. Using an unbiased estimation of an estimand involving the true label, BCCP trains the model and makes set-valued inferences through stochastic gradient descent. Our approach overcomes the challenges of sparsely labeled data in each iteration and generalizes the reliability and applicability of conformal prediction to online decision-making environments.
中摘: 自适应预测是一种不依赖于分布的方法，它将给定的机器学习模型包裹起来，并返回一个包含真实标签的一组可能标签，且这些标签的真实标签覆盖率符合预设的覆盖率率。在实际应用中，实现的经验覆盖率高度依赖于训练阶段和校准阶段从数据中获得的完整标签信息。这种依赖性在具有拉臂反馈的在线学习环境中构成了挑战，在这种环境中，学习者只能访问其行为的正确性（即拉了一个臂），而无法获取完整的真标签信息。特别是当拉的臂不正确时，学习者只知道拉的那个臂不是真实的类别标签，但不知道哪个标签是真的。此外，拉臂反馈还会导致校准阶段可用的标记数据集减小，仅限于具有正确行为的实例，从而影响分位数估计的准确性。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一种基于类别的自适应预测方法（Bandit Class-specific Conformal Prediction，简称BCCP），它提供了在类别级别上的覆盖保证。通过使用涉及真实标签的无偏估计量进行训练和通过随机梯度下降进行集合值推断，BCCP克服了每次迭代中稀疏标记数据的问题，并将自适应预测的可靠性和适用性推广到了在线决策环境。

英摘: In cross-domain few-shot classification, \emph{nearest centroid classifier} (NCC) aims to learn representations to construct a metric space where few-shot classification can be performed by measuring the similarities between samples and the prototype of each class. An intuition behind NCC is that each sample is pulled closer to the class centroid it belongs to while pushed away from those of other classes. However, in this paper, we find that there exist high similarities between NCC-learned representations of two samples from different classes. In order to address this problem, we propose a bi-level optimization framework, \emph{maximizing optimized kernel dependence} (MOKD) to learn a set of class-specific representations that match the cluster structures indicated by labeled data of the given task. Specifically, MOKD first optimizes the kernel adopted in \emph{Hilbert-Schmidt independence criterion} (HSIC) to obtain the optimized kernel HSIC (opt-HSIC) that can capture the dependence more precisely. Then, an optimization problem regarding the opt-HSIC is addressed to simultaneously maximize the dependence between representations and labels and minimize the dependence among all samples. Extensive experiments on Meta-Dataset demonstrate that MOKD can not only achieve better generalization performance on unseen domains in most cases but also learn better data representation clusters. The project repository of MOKD is available at: \href{https://github.com/tmlr-group/MOKD}{https://github.com/tmlr-group/MOKD}.

英摘: We study the certifiable robustness of ML classifiers on dirty datasets that could contain missing values. In this paper, we show theoretically that for Naive Bayes Classifiers (NBC) over dirty datasets with missing values: (i) there exists an efficient polynomial time algorithm to decide whether multiple input test points are all certifiably robust over a dirty dataset; and (ii) the data poisoning attack, which aims to make all input test points certifiably non-robust by inserting missing cells to the clean dataset, is in polynomial time for single test points but NP-complete for multiple test points. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our algorithms are efficient and outperform existing baselines.

英摘: Fairness has become a crucial aspect in the development of trustworthy machine learning algorithms. 来源: ICML 2024

英摘: The goal of strategic classification is to learn decision rules which are robust to strategic input manipulation. [No.394] Progressive Inference: Explaining Decoder-Only Sequence Classification Models Using Intermediate Predictions
来源: ICML 2024

类别:

英摘: This paper proposes Progressive Inference - a framework to compute input attributions to explain the predictions of decoder-only sequence classification models. Our work is based on the insight that the classification head of a decoder-only Transformer model can be used to make intermediate predictions by evaluating them at different points in the input sequence. Due to the causal attention mechanism, these intermediate predictions only depend on the tokens seen before the inference point, allowing us to obtain the model's prediction on a masked input sub-sequence, with negligible computational overheads. We develop two methods to provide sub-sequence level attributions using this insight. First, we propose Single Pass-Progressive Inference (SP-PI), which computes attributions by taking the difference between consecutive intermediate predictions. Second, we exploit a connection with Kernel SHAP to develop Multi Pass-Progressive Inference (MP-PI). MP-PI uses intermediate predictions from multiple masked versions of the input to compute higher quality attributions. Our studies on a diverse set of models trained on text classification tasks show that SP-PI and MP-PI provide significantly better attributions compared to prior work.

英摘: Diffusion models have been applied to improve adversarial robustness of image classifiers by purifying the adversarial noises or generating realistic data for adversarial training. 来源: ICML 2024
命中: classif
标题: 停止退化：通过分类训练价值函数以实现可扩展的深度强化学习

英摘: Value functions are a central component of deep reinforcement learning (RL). These functions, parameterized by neural networks, are trained using a mean squared error regression objective to match bootstrapped target values. However, scaling value-based RL methods that use regression to large networks, such as high-capacity Transformers, has proven challenging. This difficulty is in stark contrast to supervised learning: by leveraging a cross-entropy classification loss, supervised methods have scaled reliably to massive networks. Observing this discrepancy, in this paper, we investigate whether the scalability of deep RL can also be improved simply by using classification in place of regression for training value functions. We demonstrate that value functions trained with categorical cross-entropy significantly improves performance and scalability in a variety of domains. These include: single-task RL on Atari 2600 games with SoftMoEs, multi-task RL on Atari with large-scale ResNets, robotic manipulation with Q-transformers, playing Chess without search, and a language-agent Wordle task with high-capacity Transformers, achieving state-of-the-art results on these domains. Through careful analysis, we show that the benefits of categorical cross-entropy primarily stem from its ability to mitigate issues inherent to value-based RL, such as noisy targets and non-stationarity. Overall, we argue that a simple shift to training value functions with categorical cross-entropy can yield substantial improvements in the scalability of deep RL at little-to-no cost.
中摘: 价值函数是深度强化学习（RL）的核心组成部分。这些函数通过神经网络参数化，并使用均方误差回归目标进行训练，以匹配-bootstrap的目标值。然而，将基于回归的价值函数训练扩展到大型网络，如高容量变换器，证明是一个挑战。这一困难与监督学习形成了鲜明对比：通过利用交叉熵分类损失，监督学习方法能够可靠地扩展到大规模网络。观察到这种差异，在本文中，我们研究是否可以通过在训练价值函数时使用分类而非回归来简单地提高深度RL的可扩展性。我们证明了使用分类交叉熵训练的价值函数在多种领域中显著提高了性能和可扩展性。这些领域包括：使用SoftMoEs的Atari 2600游戏的单任务RL、使用大规模ResNets的Atari多任务RL、使用Q变换器的机器人操作、无需搜索下棋、以及使用高容量变换器的语言代理Wordle任务，实现了这些领域的最新成果。通过仔细分析，我们表明分类交叉熵的好处主要来自于其缓解价值函数训练固有的问题的能力，如噪声目标和非平稳性。总体而言，我们认为通过简单的转变，使用分类交叉熵训练价值函数可以在几乎没有成本的情况下显著提高深度RL的可扩展性。

来源: ICML 2024

类别:

英摘: Deep neural networks are applied in more and more areas of everyday life. However, they still lack essential abilities, such as robustly dealing with spatially transformed input signals. Approaches to mitigate this severe robustness issue are limited to two pathways: Either models are implicitly regularised by increased sample variability (data augmentation) or explicitly constrained by hard-coded inductive biases. The limiting factor of the former is the size of the data space, which renders sufficient sample coverage intractable. The latter is limited by the engineering effort required to develop such inductive biases for every possible scenario. Instead, we take inspiration from human behaviour, where percepts are modified by mental or physical actions during inference. We propose a novel technique to emulate such an inference process for neural nets. This is achieved by traversing a sparsified inverse transformation tree during inference using parallel energy-based evaluations. Our proposed inference algorithm, called Inverse Transformation Search (ITS), is model-agnostic and equips the model with zero-shot pseudo-invariance to spatially transformed inputs. We evaluated our method on several benchmark datasets, including a synthesised ImageNet test set. ITS outperforms the utilised baselines on all zero-shot test scenarios.
中摘: 深度神经网络在日常生活的越来越多领域得到应用。然而，它们仍然缺乏一些基本能力，例如能够稳健地处理空间变换后的输入信号。缓解这一严重稳健性问题的方法主要集中在两个途径上：要么通过增加样本变异性（数据增强）来隐式正则化模型，要么通过硬编码归纳偏置来显式约束模型。前者的限制因素是数据空间的大小，这使得充分覆盖样本变得难以实现。后者的限制因素则是为每种可能的情景开发这种归纳偏置所需的工程努力。相反，我们从人类行为中汲取灵感，在推断过程中通过心理或物理动作修改感知。我们提出了一种新的技术来模拟神经网络中的这种推断过程。这种方法通过在推断过程中使用并行的能量基评估遍历稀疏化的逆变换树来实现。我们提出的推断算法称为逆变换搜索（ITS），它是模型无关的，并且使模型能够在遇到空间变换后的输入时具备零样本伪不变性。我们在多个基准数据集上评估了我们的方法，包括一个合成的ImageNet测试集。在所有零样本测试场景中，ITS都优于所使用的基线方法。

作者: Zixi Wei;Lei Feng;Bo Han;Tongliang Liu;Gang Niu;Xiaofeng Zhu;Heng Tao Shen;

英摘: In conventional supervised classification, true labels are required for individual instances. However, it could be prohibitive to collect the true labels for individual instances, due to privacy concerns or unaffordable annotation costs. This motivates the study on classification from aggregate observations (CFAO), where the supervision is provided to groups of instances, instead of individual instances. CFAO is a generalized learning framework that contains various learning problems, such as multiple-instance learning and learning from label proportions. The goal of this paper is to present a novel universal method of CFAO, which holds an unbiased estimator of the classification risk for arbitrary losses -- previous research failed to achieve this goal. 来源: ICML 2023

英摘: This work introduces the Efficient Transformed Gaussian Process (ETGP), a new way of creating C stochastic processes characterized by: 1) the C processes are non-stationary, 2) the C processes are dependent by construction without needing a mixing matrix, 3) training and making predictions is very efficient since the number of Gaussian Processes (GP) operations (e.g. inverting the inducing point's covariance matrix) do not depend on the number of processes. 来源: ICML 2023

标题: 多类分类中的分布鲁棒损失函数标签标定：一致性、鲁棒性和适应性

英摘: We study a family of loss functions named label-distributionally robust (LDR) losses for multi-class classification that are formulated from distributionally robust optimization (DRO) perspective, where the uncertainty in the given label information are modeled and captured by taking the worse case of distributional weights. The benefits of this perspective are several fold: (i) it provides a unified framework to explain the classical cross-entropy (CE) loss and SVM loss and their variants, (ii) it includes a special family corresponding to the temperature-scaled CE loss, which is widely adopted but poorly understood; (iii) it allows us to achieve adaptivity to the uncertainty degree of label information at an instance level. Our contributions include: (1) we study both consistency and robustness by establishing top-$k$ ($\forall k\geq 1$) consistency of LDR losses for multi-class classification, and a negative result that a top-$1$ consistent and symmetric robust loss cannot achieve top-$k$ consistency simultaneously for all $k\geq 2$; (2) we propose a new adaptive LDR loss that automatically adapts the individualized temperature parameter to the noise degree of class label of each instance; (3) we demonstrate stable and competitive performance for the proposed adaptive LDR loss on 7 benchmark datasets under 6 noisy label and 1 clean settings against 13 loss functions, and on one real-world noisy dataset. The code is open-sourced at \url{https://github.com/Optimization-AI/ICML2023_LDR}.

英摘: In node classification using graph neural networks (GNNs), a typical model generates logits for different class labels at each node. 标题: PINA: 基于预测实例邻域聚合的极端多标签分类中的侧信息利用
类别: 
作者: Eli Chien;Jiong Zhang;Cho-Jui Hsieh;Jyun-Yu Jiang;Wei-Cheng Chang;Olgica Milenkovic;Hsiang-Fu Yu;
机构: Amazon;Georgia Institute of Technology;
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2023/poster/24591
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.12349
英摘: The eXtreme Multi-label Classification~(XMC) problem seeks to find relevant labels from an exceptionally large label space. Most of the existing XMC learners focus on the extraction of semantic features from input query text. However, conventional XMC studies usually neglect the side information of instances and labels, which can be of use in many real-world applications such as recommendation systems and e-commerce product search. We propose Predicted Instance Neighborhood Aggregation (PINA), a data enhancement method for the general XMC problem that leverages beneficial side information. Unlike most existing XMC frameworks that treat labels and input instances as featureless indicators and independent entries, PINA extracts information from the label metadata and the correlations among training instances. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the consistent gain of PINA on various XMC tasks compared to the state-of-the-art methods: PINA offers a gain in accuracy compared to standard XR-Transformers on five public benchmark datasets. Moreover, PINA achieves a $\sim 5\%$ gain in accuracy on the largest dataset LF-AmazonTitles-1.3M. Our implementation is publicly available.
中摘: 极端多标签分类（XMC）问题旨在从异常庞大的标签空间中找到相关的标签。现有的大多数XMC学习者专注于从输入查询文本中提取语义特征。然而，传统的XMC研究通常忽略了实例和标签的辅助信息，这些信息在推荐系统和电子商务产品搜索等许多实际应用中是有用的。我们提出了一种名为Predicted Instance Neighborhood Aggregation（PINA）的数据增强方法，用于解决一般的XMC问题，该方法利用了有益的辅助信息。与大多数现有的XMC框架不同，这些框架将标签和输入实例视为无特征的指示器并独立处理，PINA从标签元数据和训练实例之间的相关性中提取信息。广泛的经验研究表明，与最先进的方法相比，PINA在各种XMC任务上均能提供一致的性能提升：PINA在五个公开基准数据集上相较于标准XR-Transformers提高了准确性。此外，在最大的数据集LF-AmazonTitles-1.3M上，PINA实现了约5%的准确性提升。我们的实现已公开可用。

[No.427] Prefer to Classify: Improving Text Classifiers via Auxiliary Preference Learning
来源: ICML 2023
命中: classif
标题: 偏好分类：通过辅助偏好学习改进文本分类器
类别: 
作者: Jaehyung Kim;Jinwoo Shin;Dongyeop Kang;
机构: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology;University of Minnesota;
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2023/poster/23770
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.04925
英摘: The development of largely human-annotated benchmarks has driven the success of deep neural networks in various NLP tasks. To enhance the effectiveness of existing benchmarks, collecting new additional input-output pairs is often too costly and challenging, particularly considering their marginal impact on improving the current model accuracy. Instead, additional or complementary annotations on the existing input texts in the benchmarks can be preferable as an efficient way to pay the additional human cost. In this paper, we investigate task-specific preferences between pairs of input texts as a new alternative way for such auxiliary data annotation. From 'pair-wise' comparisons with respect to the task, the auxiliary preference learning enables the model to learn an additional informative training signal that cannot be captured with 'instance-wise' task labels. To this end, we propose a novel multi-task learning framework, called prefer-to-classify (P2C), which can enjoy the cooperative effect of learning both the given classification task and the auxiliary preferences. Here, we provide three different ways to collect preference signals in practice: (a) implicitly extracting from annotation records (for free, but often unavailable), (b) collecting explicitly from crowd workers (high paid), or (c) pre-trained large language models such as GPT-3 (low paid). Given existing classification NLP benchmarks, we demonstrate that the proposed auxiliary preference learning via P2C on them is effective in improving text classifiers. Our codes are publicly available.
中摘: 大量人工标注的数据基准推动了深度神经网络在各种自然语言处理（NLP）任务中的成功。为了提高现有基准的有效性，收集新的输入-输出对往往成本高昂且具有挑战性，尤其是在它们对当前模型准确性的提升作用有限的情况下。相反，在基准中的现有输入文本上添加额外或补充的标注可能是一种更有效的方法，以支付额外的人力成本。在这篇论文中，我们研究任务特定的输入文本对之间的偏好作为此类辅助数据标注的新替代方式。通过针对任务进行“成对”比较，辅助偏好学习使模型能够学习一种额外的信息训练信号，而这种信号无法仅通过“实例”级别的任务标签来捕捉。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的多任务学习框架，称为偏好分类（P2C），它可以同时学习给定的分类任务和辅助偏好，并享受两者学习的协同效应。在实践中，我们提供了三种收集偏好信号的方法：(a) 从标注记录中隐式提取（免费但通常不可用），(b) 从众包工作者处收集显式偏好（高成本），或(c) 使用预训练的大语言模型如GPT-3（低成本）。基于现有的分类NLP基准，我们证明了通过P2C进行的辅助偏好学习能够有效地改进文本分类器。我们的代码已公开可供查阅。

[No.428] Probabilistic Imputation for Time-series Classification with Missing Data
来源: ICML 2023
命中: classif
标题: 基于概率插补的时间序列分类缺失数据处理
类别: 
作者: SeungHyun Kim;Hyunsu Kim;Eunggu Yun;Hwangrae Lee;Jaehun Lee;Juho Lee;
机构: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology;Samsung;
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2023/poster/23522
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.06738
英摘: Multivariate time series data for real-world applications typically contain a significant amount of missing values. The dominant approach for classification with such missing values is to impute them heuristically with specific values (zero, mean, values of adjacent time-steps) or learnable parameters. However, these simple strategies do not take the data generative process into account, and more importantly, do not effectively capture the uncertainty in prediction due to the multiple possibilities for the missing values. In this paper, we propose a novel probabilistic framework for classification with multivariate time series data with missing values. Our model consists of two parts; a deep generative model for missing value imputation and a classifier. Extending the existing deep generative models to better capture structures of time-series data, our deep generative model part is trained to impute the missing values in multiple plausible ways, effectively modeling the uncertainty of the imputation. The classifier part takes the time series data along with the imputed missing values and classifies signals, and is trained to capture the predictive uncertainty due to the multiple possibilities of imputations. Importantly, we show that naïvely combining the generative model and the classifier could result in trivial solutions where the generative model does not produce meaningful imputations. To resolve this, we present a novel regularization technique that can promote the model to produce useful imputation values that help classification. Through extensive experiments on real-world time series data with missing values, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
中摘: 真实世界应用中的多变量时间序列数据通常包含大量的缺失值。处理这些缺失值的主要方法是使用特定值（如零、均值或相邻时间步的值）进行启发式填充，或者学习可调整参数。然而，这些简单的策略没有考虑数据生成过程，并且更重要的是，它们不能有效捕捉由于缺失值的多种可能性而导致的预测不确定性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的概率框架，用于处理多变量时间序列数据中的缺失值分类问题。我们的模型由两部分组成：一个用于缺失值填充的深度生成模型和一个分类器。我们将现有的深度生成模型扩展以更好地捕捉时间序列数据的结构，我们的深度生成模型部分被训练为以多种合理的方式填充缺失值，有效地建模了填充的不确定性。分类器部分则接收时间序列数据以及填充后的缺失值，并对信号进行分类，被训练为捕捉由于填充的多种可能性而导致的预测不确定性。重要的是，我们展示了简单地结合生成模型和分类器可能会导致生成模型不产生有意义的填充值的平凡解决方案。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的正则化技术，可以促使模型产生有助于分类的有用填充值。通过在包含缺失值的真实世界时间序列数据上的广泛实验，我们证明了我们方法的有效性。

[No.429] PromptBoosting: Black-Box Text Classification with Ten Forward Passes
来源: ICML 2023
命中: classif
标题: PromptBoosting：十次前向传递的黑盒文本分类
类别: 
作者: Bairu Hou;Joe O'Connor;Jacob Andreas;Shiyu Chang;Yang Zhang;
机构: University of California, Santa Barbara;Microsoft;International Business Machines Corporation;
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2023/poster/24491
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.09257
英摘: We describe PromptBoosting, a query-efficient procedure for building a text classifier from a neural language model (LM) without access to the LM's parameters, gradients, or hidden representations. This form of "black-box" classifier training has become increasingly important as the cost of training and inference in large-scale LMs grows. But existing black-box LM classifier learning approaches are themselves computationally inefficient, typically specializing LMs to the target task by searching in a large space of (discrete or continuous) prompts using zeroth-order optimization methods. Instead of directly optimizing in prompt space, PromptBoosting obtains a small pool of prompts via a gradient-free approach and then constructs a large pool of weak learners by pairing these prompts with different elements of the LM's output distribution. These weak learners are then ensembled using the AdaBoost algorithm. The entire learning process requires only a small number of forward passes and no backward pass. Experiments show that PromptBoosting achieves state-of-the-art performance in multiple black-box few-shot classification tasks, and matches or outperforms full fine-tuning in both few-shot and standard learning paradigms, while training 10x faster than existing black-box methods.
中摘: 我们描述了PromptBoosting，这是一种查询高效的文本分类方法，无需访问神经语言模型（LM）的参数、梯度或隐藏表示。这种“黑盒”分类器训练方式随着大规模LM训练和推理成本的增加而变得越来越重要。然而，现有的黑盒LM分类器学习方法本身计算效率较低，通常通过在大型空间中搜索离散或连续的提示来专门化LM以适应目标任务，使用零阶优化方法。PromptBoosting 不直接在提示空间中进行优化，而是通过无梯度的方法获得一小池提示，然后通过将这些提示与LM输出分布的不同元素配对来构建一大池弱学习者。这些弱学习者随后使用AdaBoost算法进行集成。整个学习过程只需要少量的前向传递，并不需要反向传递。实验表明，PromptBoosting 在多个黑盒少样本分类任务中达到了最先进的性能，并且在少样本和标准学习范式中与完全微调相比具有匹配或超越的表现，同时训练速度比现有黑盒方法快10倍。

[No.431] Revisiting Discriminative vs. Generative Classifiers: Theory and Implications
来源: ICML 2023
命中: classif
标题: 重访判别式分类器与生成式分类器：理论与影响
类别: 
作者: Chenyu Zheng;Guoqiang Wu;Fan Bao;Yue Cao;Chongxuan Li;Jun Zhu;
机构: Wuhan University;Shandong University;Tsinghua University;Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence;Renmin University of China;

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.02334
英摘: A large-scale deep model pre-trained on massive labeled or unlabeled data transfers well to downstream tasks. Linear evaluation freezes parameters in the pre-trained model and trains a linear classifier separately, which is efficient and attractive for transfer. However, little work has investigated the classifier in linear evaluation except for the default logistic regression. Inspired by the statistical efficiency of naive Bayes, the paper revisits the classical topic on discriminative vs. generative classifiers. Theoretically, the paper considers the surrogate loss instead of the zero-one loss in analyses and generalizes the classical results from binary cases to multiclass ones. We show that, under mild assumptions, multiclass naive Bayes requires $O(\log n)$ samples to approach its asymptotic error while the corresponding multiclass logistic regression requires $O(n)$ samples, where $n$ is the feature dimension. To establish it, we present a multiclass $\mathcal{H}$-consistency bound framework and an explicit bound for logistic loss, which are of independent interests. Simulation results on a mixture of Gaussian validate our theoretical findings. Experiments on various pre-trained deep vision models show that naive Bayes consistently converges faster as the number of data increases. Besides, naive Bayes shows promise in few-shot cases and we observe the "two regimes" phenomenon in pre-trained supervised models. Our code is available at https://github.com/ML-GSAI/Revisiting-Dis-vs-Gen-Classifiers.
中摘: 大规模预训练的深度模型在下游任务中表现良好。线性评估会冻结预训练模型中的参数，并单独训练一个线性分类器，这既高效又适用于迁移学习。然而，除了默认的逻辑回归之外，很少有研究调查线性评估中的分类器。受朴素贝叶斯统计效率的启发，该论文重新审视了判别式分类器与生成式分类器的经典主题。理论上，论文在分析中考虑了替代损失函数而非零一损失函数，并将经典的二分类结果推广到了多分类情况。我们证明，在温和假设下，多分类朴素贝叶斯只需要$O(\log n)$个样本即可接近其渐近误差，而相应的多分类逻辑回归则需要$O(n)$个样本，其中$n$是特征维度。为了建立这一点，我们提出了一种多分类$\mathcal{H}$-一致性界框架和逻辑损失的具体界，这些成果具有独立的研究价值。高斯混合模型上的模拟结果验证了我们的理论发现。在各种预训练深度视觉模型上的实验表明，随着数据量的增加，朴素贝叶斯始终能更快地收敛。此外，在少量样本的情况下，朴素贝叶斯显示出潜力，并且我们在预训练监督模型中观察到了“两种模式”现象。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ML-GSAI/Revisiting-Dis-vs-Gen-Classifiers获取。

[No.433] Robust One-Class Classification with Signed Distance Function using 1-Lipschitz Neural Networks
来源: ICML 2023
命中: classif
标题: 使用1-Lipschitz神经网络的带符号距离函数鲁棒单类分类
类别: 
作者: Louis Béthune;Paul Novello;Guillaume Coiffier;Thibaut Boissin;Mathieu Serrurier;Quentin VINCENOT;Andres Troya-Galvis;
机构: Institut de Recherche en Informatique de Toulouse;IRT Saint Exupery;INRIA;IRT Saint Exupéry;Paul Sabatier University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2023/poster/24988
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.01978
英摘: We propose a new method, dubbed One Class Signed Distance Function (OCSDF), to perform One Class Classification (OCC) by provably learning the Signed Distance Function (SDF) to the boundary of the support of any distribution. The distance to the support can be interpreted as a normality score, and its approximation using 1-Lipschitz neural networks provides robustness bounds against $l2$ adversarial attacks, an under-explored weakness of deep learning-based OCC algorithms. As a result, OCSDF comes with a new metric, certified AUROC, that can be computed at the same cost as any classical AUROC. We show that OCSDF is competitive against concurrent methods on tabular and image data while being way more robust to adversarial attacks, illustrating its theoretical properties. Finally, as exploratory research perspectives, we theoretically and empirically show how OCSDF connects OCC with image generation and implicit neural surface parametrization. Our code is available at https://github.com/Algue-Rythme/OneClassMetricLearning
中摘: 我们提出了一种新的方法，称为One Class Signed Distance Function（OCSDF），通过证明学习任何分布的支持边界的Signed Distance Function（SDF）来进行One Class Classification（OCC）。支持边界的距离可以解释为正常性分数，使用1-Lipschitz神经网络对其近似可以提供针对$l_2$对抗攻击的鲁棒性边界，这是基于深度学习的OCC算法的一个未充分探索的弱点。因此，OCSDF配备了一个新的度量标准，即认证AUROC，其计算成本与任何经典的AUROC相同。我们在表格数据和图像数据上展示了OCSDF在对抗攻击鲁棒性方面的优越性，从而突显了其理论特性。最后，作为探索性的研究方向，我们从理论上和实验上展示了OCSDF如何将OCC与图像生成以及隐式神经表面参数化联系起来。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Algue-Rythme/OneClassMetricLearning找到。

[No.437] The multimarginal optimal transport formulation of adversarial multiclass classification
来源: ICML 2023
命中: classif
标题: 多边际最优运输形式下的对抗多类分类
类别: 
作者: Nicolas Garcia Trillos, Matt Jacobs, Jakwang Kim;
机构: 
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2023/poster/25664
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.12676
英摘: We study a family of adversarial multiclass classification problems and provide equivalent reformulations in terms of: 1) a family of generalized barycenter problems introduced in the paper and 2) a family of multimarginal optimal transport problems where the number of marginals is equal to the number of classes in the original classification problem. These new theoretical results reveal a rich geometric structure of adversarial learning problems in multiclass classification and extend recent results restricted to the binary classification setting. A direct computational implication of our results is that by solving either the barycenter problem and its dual, or the MOT problem and its dual, we can recover the optimal robust classification rule and the optimal adversarial strategy for the original adversarial problem. Examples with synthetic and real data illustrate our results.

[No.438] Trading-Off Payments and Accuracy in Online Classification with Paid Stochastic Experts
来源: ICML 2023
命中: classif
标题: 在线分类中的支付与准确性的权衡：带付费随机专家的交易策略
类别: 
作者: Dirk van der Hoeven;Ciara Pike-Burke;Hao Qiu;Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi;
机构: University of Amsterdam;Imperial College London;University of Milan;
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2023/poster/23907
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.00836
英摘: We investigate online classification with paid stochastic experts. Here, before making their prediction, each expert must be paid. The amount that we pay each expert directly influences the accuracy of their prediction through some unknown Lipschitz "productivity" function. In each round, the learner must decide how much to pay each expert and then make a prediction. They incur a cost equal to a weighted sum of the prediction error and upfront payments for all experts. We introduce an online learning algorithm whose total cost after $T$ rounds exceeds that of a predictor which knows the productivity of all experts in advance by at most $\mathcal{O}(K^2(\log T)\sqrt{T})$ where $K$ is the number of experts. In order to achieve this result, we combine Lipschitz bandits and online classification with surrogate losses. These tools allow us to improve upon the bound of order $T^{2/3}$ one would obtain in the standard Lipschitz bandit setting. Our algorithm is empirically evaluated on synthetic data
中摘: 我们研究了带有付费随机专家的在线分类问题。在此过程中，在每个专家作出预测之前，都需要对他们进行付费。我们支付给每个专家的金额会通过某个未知的Lipschitz“生产力”函数间接影响他们的预测准确性。在每一轮中，学习者必须决定向每个专家支付多少费用，然后作出自己的预测。他们需要承担的成本等于所有专家预测误差的加权和以及事先支付给所有专家的费用之和。我们提出了一种在线学习算法，其在$T$轮后的总成本最多超出一个已知所有专家生产力的预测器的成本$\mathcal{O}(K^2(\log T)\sqrt{T})$，其中$K$表示专家的数量。为了达到这一结果，我们在Lipschitz带宽算法和在线分类中结合使用了代理损失函数。这些工具使我们能够在标准Lipschitz带宽设置中获得$T^{2/3}$级别的界的基础上进一步改进。我们的算法在合成数据上进行了实证评估。

英摘: Nuclei segmentation and classification provide an essential basis for tumor immune microenvironment analysis. Recently, Mamba has garnered attention for its ability to model large-scale images with linear time complexity and low memory consumption. To this end, we propose a novel framework to extract comprehensive biases in image datasets based on textual descriptions, a common sense-rich modality. [No.462] PointDGMamba: Domain Generalization of Point Cloud Classification via Generalized State Space Model
来源: AAAI 2025

英摘: Computing an optimal classification tree that provably maximizes training performance within a given size limit, is NP-hard, and in practice, most state-of-the-art methods do not scale beyond computing optimal trees of depth three. Therefore, most methods rely on a coarse binarization of continuous features to maintain scalability. We propose a novel algorithm that optimizes trees directly on the continuous feature data using dynamic programming with branch-and-bound. We develop new pruning techniques that eliminate many sub-optimal splits in the search when similar to previously computed splits and we provide an efficient subroutine for computing optimal depth-two trees. Our experiments demonstrate that these techniques improve runtime by one or more orders of magnitude over state-of-the-art optimal methods and improve test accuracy by 5% over greedy heuristics.

英摘: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used in graph data mining tasks. Traditional GNNs follow a message passing scheme that can effectively utilize local and structural information. Graph Transformers were introduced to address these issues, achieving a global receptive field but suffering from the noise of irrelevant nodes and loss of structural information. Therefore, drawing inspiration from fine-grained token-based representation learning in Natural Language Processing (NLP), we propose the Structure-aware Multi-token Graph Transformer (Tokenphormer), which generates multiple tokens to effectively capture local and structural information and explore global information at different levels of granularity. Experimental results demonstrate that the capability of the proposed Tokenphormer can achieve state-of-the-art performance on node classification tasks.

[No.472] MIETT: Multi-Instance Encrypted Traffic Transformer for Encrypted Traffic Classification
来源: AAAI 2025

英摘: Network traffic includes data transmitted across a network, such as web browsing and file transfers, and is organized into packets (small units of data) and flows (sequences of packets exchanged between two endpoints). Classifying encrypted traffic is essential for detecting security threats and optimizing network management. Recent advancements have highlighted the superiority of foundation models in this task, particularly for their ability to leverage large amounts of unlabeled data and demonstrate strong generalization to unseen data. However, existing methods that focus on token-level relationships fail to capture broader flow patterns, as tokens, defined as sequences of hexadecimal digits, typically carry limited semantic information in encrypted traffic. These flow patterns, which are crucial for traffic classification, arise from the interactions between packets within a flow, not just their internal structure. To address this limitation, we propose a Multi-Instance Encrypted Traffic Transformer (MIETT), which adopts a multi-instance approach where each packet is treated as a distinct instance within a larger bag representing the entire flow. This enables the model to capture both token-level and packet-level relationships more effectively through Two-Level Attention (TLA) layers, improving the model's ability to learn complex packet dynamics and flow patterns. We further enhance the model's understanding of temporal and flow-specific dynamics by introducing two novel pre-training tasks: Packet Relative Position Prediction (PRPP) and Flow Contrastive Learning (FCL). After fine-tuning, MIETT achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results across five datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in classifying encrypted traffic and understanding complex network behaviors. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/Secilia-Cxy/MIETT}.
中摘: 网络流量包括在网络上传输的数据，如网页浏览和文件传输，并组织成数据包（小的数据单元）和流（两个端点之间交换的数据包序列）。对加密流量进行分类对于检测安全威胁和优化网络管理至关重要。最近的研究表明，基础模型在此任务中的表现尤为出色，尤其是它们能够利用大量未标记数据并表现出强大的泛化能力以应对未见过的数据。然而，现有方法专注于标记级别的关系，无法捕捉更广泛的流模式，因为在加密流量中，定义为十六进制数字序列的标记通常携带有限的语义信息。这些流模式对于流量分类至关重要，它们源自流内部数据包之间的交互，而不仅仅是它们的内部结构。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了一种多实例加密流量变换器（MIETT），它采用多实例方法，将每个数据包视为整个流表示的一个独立实例。这种方法通过两层注意力（TLA）层使模型能够更有效地捕捉标记级别和数据包级别的关系，从而提高模型学习复杂数据包动态和流模式的能力。为进一步增强模型对时间和流特定动态的理解，我们引入了两个新的预训练任务：数据包相对位置预测（PRPP）和流对比学习（FCL）。经过微调后，MIETT在五个数据集上取得了最先进的（SOTA）结果，证明了其在分类加密流量和理解复杂网络行为方面的有效性。代码可在 https://github.com/Secilia-Cxy/MIETT 获取。

英摘: Due to the superior ability of global dependency, transformer and its variants have become the primary choice in Masked Time-series Modeling (MTM) towards time-series classification task. In this paper, we experimentally analyze that existing transformer-based MTM methods encounter with two under-explored issues when dealing with time series data: (1) they encode features by performing long-dependency ensemble averaging, which easily results in rank collapse and feature homogenization as the layer goes deeper; (2) they exhibit distinct priorities in fitting different frequency components contained in the time-series, inevitably leading to spectrum energy imbalance of encoded feature. Existing approaches typically develop independent hierarchy-aware models based on shared features extracted from a common base encoder. To overcome this challenge, we propose a novel framework called the Bidirectional Logits Tree (BiLT) for Granularity Reconcilement. The key idea is to develop classifiers sequentially from the finest to the coarsest granularities, rather than parallelly constructing a set of classifiers based on the same input features. In this setup, the outputs of finer-grained classifiers serve as inputs for coarser-grained ones, facilitating the flow of hierarchical semantic information across different granularities. On top of this, we further introduce an Adaptive Intra-Granularity Difference Learning (AIGDL) approach to uncover subtle semantic differences between classes within the same granularity. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.
中摘: 这篇论文探讨了在细粒度分类任务中粒度竞争的挑战，这种挑战源于多粒度标签之间的语义差距。现有的方法通常基于共享特征开发独立的层次感知模型，这些特征是从一个共同的基础编码器中提取出来的。然而，由于粗粒度层次本质上比细粒度层次更容易学习，基础编码器倾向于优先学习粗粒度特征抽象，这阻碍了细粒度特征的学习。为了克服这一挑战，我们提出了一种名为双向逻辑树（BiLT）的新框架，用于粒度协调。关键思想是从最细粒度逐步构建分类器，而不是并行地基于相同的输入特征构建一组分类器。在这种设置下，更细粒度分类器的输出作为更粗粒度分类器的输入，促进不同粒度层次之间层级语义信息的流动。在此基础上，我们进一步引入了一种自适应同粒度差异学习（AIGDL）的方法，以揭示同一粒度内类之间的细微语义差异。广泛的实验表明，我们提出的这种方法的有效性。

[No.498] Open-Set Cross-Network Node Classification via Unknown-Excluded Adversarial Graph Domain Alignment

英摘: Existing cross-network node classification methods are mainly proposed for closed-set setting, where the source network and the target network share exactly the same label space. Firstly, UAGA roughly separates known classes from unknown class, by training a graph neural network encoder and a neighborhood-aggregation node classifier in an adversarial framework. Then, unknown-excluded adversarial domain alignment is customized to align only target nodes from known classes with the source, while pushing target nodes from unknown class far away from the source, by assigning positive and negative domain adaptation coefficient to known class nodes and unknown class nodes. To explore the backdoor vulnerability of GNNs and create a more stealthy backdoor attack method, a clean-label graph backdoor attack method(CGBA) in the node classification task is proposed in this paper. Differently from existing backdoor attack methods, CGBA requires neither modification of node labels nor graph structure. Specifically, to solve the problem of inconsistency between the contents and labels of the samples, CGBA selects poisoning samples in a specific target class and uses the label of sample as the target label (i.e., clean-label) after injecting triggers into the target samples. To guarantee the similarity of neighboring nodes, the raw features of the nodes are elaborately picked as triggers to further improve the concealment of the triggers. Extensive experiments results show the effectiveness of our method. When the poisoning rate is 0.04, CGBA can achieve an average attack success rate of 87.8%, 98.9%, 89.1%, and 98.5%, respectively.
中摘: 在传统的图神经网络（GNNs）领域，后门攻击容易被检测到，因为存在标签混淆的问题。为了探索图神经网络的后门漏洞并创建一种更为隐蔽的后门攻击方法，本文提出了节点分类任务中的清洁标签图后门攻击方法（CGBA）。与现有的后门攻击方法不同，CGBA不需要修改节点标签或图结构。具体来说，为了解决样本内容和标签之间的一致性问题，CGBA选择特定目标类别的污染样本，并在注入触发器后将样本本身的标签作为目标标签（即清洁标签）。为了保证邻近节点之间的相似性，CGBA仔细挑选节点的原始特征作为触发器，进一步提高触发器的隐蔽性。广泛实验的结果显示了该方法的有效性。当污染率为0.04时，CGBA分别可以实现87.8%、98.9%、89.1%和98.5%的平均攻击成功率。

Adapting the concept of uncertainty to multi-label data is not a trivial task, since there are two issues that should be tackled. First, traditional variance or entropy-based uncertainty measures ignore fluctuations of predictions within sliding windows and the importance of the current model state. In this paper, we propose an uncertainty-based multi-label batch selection algorithm. It assesses uncertainty for each label by considering differences between successive predictions and the confidence of current outputs, and further leverages dynamic uncertainty-based label correlations to emphasize instances whose uncertainty is synergistically expressed across multiple labels. Empirical studies demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in improving the performance and accelerating the convergence of various multi-label deep learning models.

[No.515] NOMATTERXAI: Generating “No Matter What” Alterfactual Examples for Explaining Black-Box Text Classification Models
来源: AAAI 2025
命中: classif
标题: NOMATTERXAI: 生成“无论什么情况”的替代事实例以解释黑盒文本分类模型

英摘: In Explainable AI (XAI), counterfactual explanations (CEs) are a well-studied method to communicate feature relevance through contrastive reasoning of "what if" to explain AI models' predictions. However, they only focus on important (i.e., relevant) features and largely disregard less important (i.e., irrelevant) ones. Such irrelevant features can be crucial in many applications, especially when users need to ensure that an AI model's decisions are not affected or biased against specific attributes such as gender, race, religion, or political affiliation. To address this gap, the concept of alterfactual explanations (AEs) has been proposed. AEs explore an alternative reality of "no matter what", where irrelevant features are substituted with alternative features (e.g., "republicans" -> "democrats") within the same attribute (e.g., "politics") while maintaining a similar prediction output. This serves to validate whether AI model predictions are influenced by the specified attributes. Despite the promise of AEs, there is a lack of computational approaches to systematically generate them, particularly in the text domain, where creating AEs for AI text classifiers presents unique challenges. This paper addresses this challenge by formulating AE generation as an optimization problem and introducing MoMatterXAI, a novel algorithm that generates AEs for text classification tasks. Our approach achieves high fidelity of up to 95% while preserving context similarity of over 90% across multiple models and datasets. A human study further validates the effectiveness of AEs in explaining AI text classifiers to end users. All codes will be publicly available.
中摘: 在可解释人工智能（XAI）领域，反事实解释（CEs）是一种经过深入研究的方法，通过对比推理“如果……会怎样”来解释AI模型的预测结果。然而，它们仅关注重要（即相关）特征，而很大程度上忽视了不重要（即无关）的特征。这些无关特征在许多应用中可能至关重要，尤其是在用户需要确保AI模型的决策不受或不对特定属性（如性别、种族、宗教或政治立场）产生偏见时。为了解决这一问题，提出了替代事实解释（AEs）的概念。AEs探索了一个“无论怎样”的替代现实，在这种现实中，无关特征被同一属性中的替代特征所替换（例如，“共和党人”->“民主党人”），同时保持相似的预测输出。这有助于验证AI模型预测是否受到指定属性的影响。尽管AEs具有很大的潜力，但在系统性生成它们方面缺乏计算方法，特别是在文本领域，为AI文本分类器生成AEs提出了独特的挑战。本文通过将AE生成问题形式化为优化问题，并引入MoMatterXAI这一新颖算法来解决这一挑战，该算法能够生成适用于文本分类任务的AEs。我们的方法在多个模型和数据集上实现了高达95%的高保真度，同时保持上下文相似度超过90%。进一步的人类研究表明，AEs在向终端用户提供解释AI文本分类器方面非常有效。所有代码都将公开提供。

[No.517] FROC: Building Fair ROC from a Trained Classifier
来源: AAAI 2025
命中: classif
标题: FROC：构建公平的ROC曲线从训练好的分类器
类别: philosophy and ethics of ai
作者: Avyukta Manjunatha Vummintala;Shantanu Das;Sujit Gujar;
机构: International Institute of Information Technology;
类型: Technical
链接: https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/34836
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.14724
英摘: This paper considers the problem of fair probabilistic binary classification with binary protected groups. The classifier assigns scores, and a practitioner predicts labels using a certain cut-off threshold based on the desired trade-off between false positives vs. false negatives. It derives these thresholds from the ROC of the classifier. The resultant classifier may be unfair to one of the two protected groups in the dataset. It is desirable that no matter what threshold the practitioner uses, the classifier should be fair to both the protected groups; that is, the $\mathcal{L}_p$ norm between FPRs and TPRs of both the protected groups should be at most $\varepsilon$. We call such fairness on ROCs of both the protected attributes $\varepsilon_p$-Equalized ROC. Given a classifier not satisfying $\varepsilon_1$-Equalized ROC, we aim to design a post-processing method to transform the given (potentially unfair) classifier's output (score) to a suitable randomized yet fair classifier. That is, the resultant classifier must satisfy $\varepsilon_1$-Equalized ROC. First, we introduce a threshold query model on the ROC curves for each protected group. The resulting classifier is bound to face a reduction in AUC. With the proposed query model, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis of the minimal AUC loss to achieve $\varepsilon_1$-Equalized ROC. To achieve this, we design a linear time algorithm, namely \texttt{FROC}, to transform a given classifier's output to a probabilistic classifier that satisfies $\varepsilon_1$-Equalized ROC. We prove that under certain theoretical conditions, \texttt{FROC}\ achieves the theoretical optimal guarantees. We also study the performance of our \texttt{FROC}\ on multiple real-world datasets with many trained classifiers.
中摘: 这篇论文探讨了在具有二元受保护群体的情况下进行公平概率二分类的问题。分类器会给出评分，而实践者会根据希望在假阳性率与假阴性率之间取得的权衡来设定一个特定的阈值以预测标签。这些阈值是从分类器的ROC曲线中推导出来的。生成的分类器可能会对数据集中的一种或两种受保护群体不公平。理想情况下，无论实践者使用什么阈值，分类器都应该对两种受保护群体都是公平的；即两种受保护群体的假阳性率（FPR）和真阳性率（TPR）之间的$\mathcal{L}_p$范数应最多为$\varepsilon$。我们称这种基于两种受保护属性的ROC曲线上的公平性为$\varepsilon_p$-Equalized ROC。给定一个不满足$\varepsilon_1$-Equalized ROC的分类器，我们的目标是设计一种后处理方法，将给定的（可能不公平的）分类器输出（评分）转换为一个合适的随机化且公平的分类器。也就是说，生成的分类器必须满足$\varepsilon_1$-Equalized ROC。首先，我们引入了一种针对每种受保护群体的阈值查询模型。由此产生的分类器会导致AUC的下降。通过提出的查询模型，我们提供了一个严格的理论分析，以确定实现$\varepsilon_1$-Equalized ROC所需的最小AUC损失。为了达到这一目的，我们设计了一个线性时间算法，称为\texttt{FROC}，用于将给定分类器的输出转换为一个概率分类器，该分类器满足$\varepsilon_1$-Equalized ROC。我们证明，在某些理论条件下，\texttt{FROC}能够达到理论最优保证。此外，我们还在多个真实世界的数据集上研究了\texttt{FROC}的表现，并测试了多种训练好的分类器。

[No.518] Arbitrariness and Social Prediction: The Confounding Role of Variance in Fair Classification
来源: AAAI 2024
命中: classif
标题: 任意性与社会预测：方差在公平分类中的混淆作用

英摘: Variance in predictions across different trained models is a significant, under-explored source of error in fair binary classification. In practice, the variance on some data examples is so large that decisions can be effectively arbitrary. To investigate this problem, we take an experimental approach and make four overarching contributions: We: 1) Define a metric called self-consistency, derived from variance, which we use as a proxy for measuring and reducing arbitrariness; 2) Develop an ensembling algorithm that abstains from classification when a prediction would be arbitrary; 3) Conduct the largest to-date empirical study of the role of variance (vis-a-vis self-consistency and arbitrariness) in fair binary classification; and, 4) Release a toolkit that makes the US Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) datasets easily usable for future research. Altogether, our experiments reveal shocking insights about the reliability of conclusions on benchmark datasets. Most fair binary classification benchmarks are close-to-fair when taking into account the amount of arbitrariness present in predictions -- before we even try to apply any fairness interventions. This finding calls into question the practical utility of common algorithmic fairness methods, and in turn suggests that we should reconsider how we choose to measure fairness in binary classification.
中摘: 不同训练模型之间预测结果的差异是公平二分类中的一个重要但未充分探索的误差来源。在实践中，某些数据示例之间的差异如此之大，以至于决策可以变得几乎任意。为研究这一问题，我们采取实验性方法，并做出了四项总体贡献：我们1）定义了一个名为自我一致性（self-consistency）的度量标准，该标准源自方差，并将其用作衡量和减少任意性的代理指标；2）开发了一种集成算法，在预测结果可能任意时选择不进行分类；3）进行了迄今为止规模最大的关于方差（从自我一致性及任意性角度）在公平二分类中作用的经验研究；4）发布了工具包，使未来的研究能够轻松使用美国住房抵押贷款披露法案（HMDA）的数据集。我们的实验揭示了基准数据集结论可靠性的令人震惊的见解。考虑到预测中存在的任意性因素，大多数公平二分类基准在很大程度上已经是接近公平的。这一发现质疑了常用算法公平性方法的实际效用，并暗示我们应该重新考虑如何衡量二分类中的公平性。

To address the issue, we develop a cell graph transformer (CGT) that treats nodes and edges as input tokens to enable learnable adjacency and information exchange among all nodes. However, it shows poor performance on multi-label datasets because the global feature tends to be dominated by the most prominent class and the contrastive nature of softmax operation aggravates it. As a result, we dissect the preservation of patch-wise spatial information in CLIP and proposed a local-to-global framework to obtain image tags. It comprises three steps: (1) patch-level classification to obtain coarse scores; (2) dual-masking attention refinement (DMAR) module to refine the coarse scores; (3) class-wise reidentification (CWR) module to remedy predictions from a global perspective. This framework is solely based on frozen CLIP and significantly enhances its multi-label classification performance on various benchmarks without dataset-specific training. Besides, to comprehensively assess the quality and practicality of generated tags, we extend their application to the downstream task, i.e., weakly supervised semantic segmentation (WSSS) with generated tags as image-level pseudo labels. Experiments demonstrate that this classify-then-segment paradigm dramatically outperforms other annotation-free segmentation methods and validates the effectiveness of generated tags. Furthermore, we adopt a pseudo-label-based semi-supervised technique to reuse the pre-training images and a vision-language contrastive learning method to address the confirmation bias issue in semi-supervised learning. We conduct extensive experiments that show our proposed DAT approach meaningfully improves various benchmark datasets performance over traditional adaptation methods by simply.
中摘: 视觉语言基础模型在通过适应方法处理广泛范围的下游计算机视觉任务时取得了巨大成功。然而，由于获取预训练数据集的成本较高，数据集中存在大量图像与文本关联较弱的数据对，我们称之为弱配对样本。由于这些弱配对样本的限制，预训练模型无法从预训练数据中挖掘出所有知识。现有的适应方法没有考虑到缺失的知识，这可能导致下游任务相关的关键知识被忽略。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的适应框架，称为数据自适应追溯（DAT）。具体而言，我们利用零样本方法提取预训练数据中最相关的下游任务子集，以使下游任务能够从中受益。此外，我们采用基于伪标签的半监督技术重用预训练图像，并使用视觉语言对比学习方法来解决半监督学习中的确认偏差问题。我们进行了大量的实验，结果显示，我们的DAT方法通过简单的方式显著提高了各种基准数据集的性能。

[No.536] NeSyFOLD: A Framework for Interpretable Image Classification
来源: AAAI 2024
命中: classif
标题: NeSyFOLD：一种可解释的图像分类框架
类别: computer vision iv
作者: Parth Padalkar;Huaduo Wang;Gopal Gupta;
机构: University of Texas at Dallas;
类型: Technical
链接: https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/28235
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.12667
英摘: Deep learning models such as CNNs have surpassed human performance in computer vision tasks such as image classification. However, despite their sophistication, these models lack interpretability which can lead to biased outcomes reflecting existing prejudices in the data. We aim to make predictions made by a CNN interpretable. Hence, we present a novel framework called NeSyFOLD to create a neurosymbolic (NeSy) model for image classification tasks. The model is a CNN with all layers following the last convolutional layer replaced by a stratified answer set program (ASP). A rule-based machine learning algorithm called FOLD-SE-M is used to derive the stratified answer set program from binarized filter activations of the last convolutional layer. The answer set program can be viewed as a rule-set, wherein the truth value of each predicate depends on the activation of the corresponding kernel in the CNN. The rule-set serves as a global explanation for the model and is interpretable. A justification for the predictions made by the NeSy model can be obtained using an ASP interpreter. We also use our NeSyFOLD framework with a CNN that is trained using a sparse kernel learning technique called Elite BackProp (EBP). This leads to a significant reduction in rule-set size without compromising accuracy or fidelity thus improving scalability of the NeSy model and interpretability of its rule-set. Evaluation is done on datasets with varied complexity and sizes. To make the rule-set more intuitive to understand, we propose a novel algorithm for labelling each kernel's corresponding predicate in the rule-set with the semantic concept(s) it learns. We evaluate the performance of our "semantic labelling algorithm" to quantify the efficacy of the semantic labelling for both the NeSy model and the NeSy-EBP model.
中摘: 深度学习模型如卷积神经网络（CNN）已经在计算机视觉任务如图像分类方面超越了人类的表现。然而，尽管这些模型非常复杂，它们缺乏可解释性，这可能导致预测结果反映出数据中存在的偏见和先入之见。我们旨在使CNN的预测变得可解释。因此，我们提出了一种名为NeSyFOLD的新框架，用于为图像分类任务创建神经符号主义（NeSy）模型。该模型是在所有层（包括最后一层卷积层）的基础上添加了一种分层回答集程序（ASP）来替代原有的卷积层。一种基于规则的机器学习算法FOLD-SE-M被用来从最后一层卷积层的二值化滤波器激活中推导出分层回答集程序。回答集程序可以被视为一组规则，在这些规则中，每个谓词的真值取决于相应CNN内核的激活。这一规则集作为全局解释，具有可解释性。使用回答集程序解释器可以获得NeSy模型预测的合理性证明。此外，我们还使用NeSyFOLD框架与一种稀疏内核学习技术——精英反向传播（EBP）训练的CNN相结合。这种方法在不牺牲准确性和保真度的情况下显著减少了规则集的大小，从而提高了NeSy模型的可扩展性及其规则集的可解释性。我们在不同复杂度和规模的数据集上进行了评估。为了使规则集更加直观易懂，我们提出了一个新颖的算法，用于为规则集中每个内核对应的谓词分配语义概念标签。我们评估了“语义标记算法”的性能，以量化其对NeSy模型和NeSy-EBP模型的语义标记效果。

[No.743] More than Classification: A Unified Framework for Event Temporal Relation Extraction
来源: ACL 2023
命中: classif
标题: 超越分类：一个统一的事件时间关系提取框架
类别: 
作者: Quzhe Huang;Yutong Hu;Shengqi Zhu;Yansong Feng;Chang Liu;Dongyan Zhao;
机构: Peking University;University of Washington;National Key Laboratory of General Artificial Intelligence;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.536/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.17607
英摘: Event temporal relation extraction~(ETRE) is usually formulated as a multi-label classification task, where each type of relation is simply treated as a one-hot label. This formulation ignores the meaning of relations and wipes out their intrinsic dependency. After examining the relation definitions in various ETRE tasks, we observe that all relations can be interpreted using the start and end time points of events. For example, relation \textit{Includes} could be interpreted as event 1 starting no later than event 2 and ending no earlier than event 2. In this paper, we propose a unified event temporal relation extraction framework, which transforms temporal relations into logical expressions of time points and completes the ETRE by predicting the relations between certain time point pairs. Experiments on TB-Dense and MATRES show significant improvements over a strong baseline and outperform the state-of-the-art model by 0.3\% on both datasets. By representing all relations in a unified framework, we can leverage the relations with sufficient data to assist the learning of other relations, thus achieving stable improvement in low-data scenarios. When the relation definitions are changed, our method can quickly adapt to the new ones by simply modifying the logic expressions that map time points to new event relations. The code is released at \url{https://github.com/AndrewZhe/A-Unified-Framework-for-ETRE}.
中摘: 事件时间关系提取（ETRE）通常被表述为一个多标签分类任务，其中每种类型的关系简单地被视为一个独热标签。这种表述忽略了关系的意义，并消除了它们固有的依赖性。在检查各种ETRE任务中的关系定义后，我们观察到所有关系都可以通过事件的时间起点和终点来解释。例如，关系“包括”可以解释为事件1的时间起点不晚于事件2的时间起点，且事件1的时间终点不早于事件2的时间终点。在本文中，我们提出了一种统一的事件时间关系提取框架，该框架将时间关系转换为时间点的逻辑表达式，并通过预测某些时间点对之间的关系来完成ETRE。在TB-Dense和MATRES数据集上的实验显示，与强基线相比，我们的方法取得了显著的改进，并且在两个数据集上分别比最先进的模型高出0.3%。通过在一个统一框架中表示所有关系，我们可以利用数据充足的那些关系来辅助学习其他关系，从而在低数据场景下实现稳定的改进。当关系定义发生变化时，我们的方法可以通过简单修改将时间点映射到新事件关系的逻辑表达式来快速适应新的定义。代码已发布在<https://github.com/AndrewZhe/A-Unified-Framework-for-ETRE>。

[No.744] Neural Networks Against (and For) Self-Training: Classification with Small Labeled and Large Unlabeled Sets
来源: ACL 2023
命中: classif
标题: 神经网络对抗（和支持）自我训练：小标记大未标记集分类
类别: 
作者: Payam Karisani;
机构: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign;Emory University;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.769/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.00575
英摘: We propose a semi-supervised text classifier based on self-training using one positive and one negative property of neural networks. One of the weaknesses of self-training is the semantic drift problem, where noisy pseudo-labels accumulate over iterations and consequently the error rate soars. In order to tackle this challenge, we reshape the role of pseudo-labels and create a hierarchical order of information. In addition, a crucial step in self-training is to use the classifier confidence prediction to select the best candidate pseudo-labels. This step cannot be efficiently done by neural networks, because it is known that their output is poorly calibrated. To overcome this challenge, we propose a hybrid metric to replace the plain confidence measurement. Our metric takes into account the prediction uncertainty via a subsampling technique. We evaluate our model in a set of five standard benchmarks, and show that it significantly outperforms a set of ten diverse baseline models. Furthermore, we show that the improvement achieved by our model is additive to language model pretraining, which is a widely used technique for using unlabeled documents. Our code is available at https://github.com/p-karisani/RST.
中摘: 我们提出了一种基于自训练的半监督文本分类器，利用神经网络的一个正属性和一个负属性。自训练的一个弱点是语义漂移问题，即噪声伪标签在迭代过程中累积，从而导致错误率上升。为了应对这一挑战，我们重塑了伪标签的角色，并创建了一个信息的层次结构。此外，在自训练的关键步骤是使用分类器的信心预测来选择最佳候选伪标签。神经网络无法高效地完成这一步骤，因为它们的输出通常校准不佳。为克服这一挑战，我们提出了一种混合度量来替代简单的信心测量。我们的度量通过子采样技术考虑了预测不确定性。我们在一组五个标准基准上评估了我们的模型，并展示了它显著优于十种不同的基线模型。此外，我们证明了我们的模型对未标注文档的预训练语言模型的改进是叠加的，这是一种广泛使用的技术。我们的代码可在https://github.com/p-karisani/RST获取。

[No.747] PESCO: Prompt-enhanced Self Contrastive Learning for Zero-shot Text Classification
来源: ACL 2023
命中: classif
标题: PESCO：增强提示自对比学习在零样本文本分类中的应用
类别: 
作者: Yau-Shian Wang;Ta-Chung Chi;Ruohong Zhang;Yiming Yang;
机构: Carnegie Mellon University;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.832/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.14963
英摘: We present PESCO, a novel contrastive learning framework that substantially improves the performance of zero-shot text classification. We formulate text classification as a neural text matching problem where each document is treated as a query, and the system learns the mapping from each query to the relevant class labels by (1) adding prompts to enhance label matching, and (2) using retrieved labels to enrich the training set in a self-training loop of contrastive learning. PESCO achieves state-of-the-art performance on four benchmark text classification datasets. On DBpedia, we achieve 98.5\% accuracy without any labeled data, which is close to the fully-supervised result. Extensive experiments and analyses show all the components of PESCO are necessary for improving the performance of zero-shot text classification.
中摘: 我们提出了一种名为PESCO的新颖对比学习框架，该框架显著提高了零样本文本分类的性能。我们将文本分类问题表述为神经文本匹配问题，其中每份文档被视为一个查询，系统通过以下两种方式学习将每个查询映射到相关的类别标签：（1）添加提示以增强标签匹配；（2）在自我训练的对比学习循环中使用检索到的标签来丰富训练集。PESCO在四个基准文本分类数据集上达到了最先进的性能。在DBpedia数据集上，我们实现了98.5%的准确率，几乎与完全监督的结果相同。广泛的实验和分析表明，PESCO的所有组件对于提高零样本文本分类的性能都是必要的。

[No.750] Randomized Smoothing with Masked Inference for Adversarially Robust Text Classifications
来源: ACL 2023
命中: classif
标题: 对抗性鲁棒文本分类的掩码推理随机化平滑方法
类别: 
作者: Han Cheol Moon;Shafiq Joty;Ruochen Zhao;Megh Thakkar;Chi Xu;
机构: Nanyang Technological University;Salesforce;Birla Institute of Technology and Science;Agency for Science, Technology and Research;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.282/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.06522
英摘: Large-scale pre-trained language models have shown outstanding performance in a variety of NLP tasks. However, they are also known to be significantly brittle against specifically crafted adversarial examples, leading to increasing interest in probing the adversarial robustness of NLP systems. We introduce RSMI, a novel two-stage framework that combines randomized smoothing (RS) with masked inference (MI) to improve the adversarial robustness of NLP systems. RS transforms a classifier into a smoothed classifier to obtain robust representations, whereas MI forces a model to exploit the surrounding context of a masked token in an input sequence. RSMI improves adversarial robustness by 2 to 3 times over existing state-of-the-art methods on benchmark datasets. We also perform in-depth qualitative analysis to validate the effectiveness of the different stages of RSMI and probe the impact of its components through extensive ablations. By empirically proving the stability of RSMI, we put it forward as a practical method to robustly train large-scale NLP models. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/Han8931/rsmi_nlp
中摘: 大规模预训练语言模型在各种自然语言处理（NLP）任务中表现出色。然而，它们也已知对特定构造的对抗样本非常脆弱，这引发了对NLP系统对抗鲁棒性的广泛关注。我们提出了一种名为RSMI的新颖两阶段框架，该框架结合了随机化平滑（RS）和掩码推断（MI），以提高NLP系统的对抗鲁棒性。随机化平滑将分类器转换为平滑分类器，以获得鲁棒表示；而掩码推断则迫使模型利用输入序列中掩码标记周围的上下文信息。在基准数据集上，RSMI的对抗鲁棒性比现有最先进的方法提高了2到3倍。我们还进行了深入的定性分析，验证了RSMI各个阶段的有效性，并通过广泛的消融实验探究其组件的影响。通过实证证明RSMI的稳定性，我们将其作为一种实用的方法，用于训练大规模的鲁棒NLP模型。我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Han8931/rsmi_nlp获取。

[No.751] ReGen: Zero-Shot Text Classification via Training Data Generation with Progressive Dense Retrieval
来源: ACL 2023
命中: classif
标题: ReGen：通过渐进密集检索生成训练数据的零样本文本分类
类别: 
作者: Yue Yu;Yuchen Zhuang;Rongzhi Zhang;Yu Meng;Jiaming Shen;Chao Zhang;
机构: Georgia Institute of Technology;University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign;Google;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.748/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.10703
英摘: With the development of large language models (LLMs), zero-shot learning has attracted much attention for various NLP tasks. Different from prior works that generate training data with billion-scale natural language generation (NLG) models, we propose a retrieval-enhanced framework to create training data from a general-domain unlabeled corpus. To realize this, we first conduct contrastive pretraining to learn an unsupervised dense retriever for extracting the most relevant documents using class-descriptive verbalizers. We then further propose two simple strategies, namely Verbalizer Augmentation with Demonstrations and Self-consistency Guided Filtering to improve the topic coverage of the dataset while removing noisy examples. Experiments on nine datasets demonstrate that REGEN achieves 4.3% gain over the strongest baselines and saves around 70% of the time compared to baselines using large NLG models. Besides, REGEN can be naturally integrated with recently proposed large language models to boost performance.
中摘: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的发展，零样本学习因其在各种自然语言处理（NLP）任务中的应用而引起了广泛关注。与之前使用十亿规模的自然语言生成（NLG）模型生成训练数据的工作不同，我们提出了一种检索增强框架，从通用领域未标注的语料库中创建训练数据。为了实现这一点，我们首先进行了对比预训练，以学习一个无监督密集检索器，通过类别描述性词汇表提取最相关的文档。然后，我们进一步提出了两种简单的策略，即示范增强的词汇表扩展和自我一致性引导过滤，以提高数据集的主题覆盖面并移除噪声样本。在九个数据集上的实验表明，REGEN 在最强基准之上实现了 4.3% 的性能提升，并且与使用大型 NLG 模型的基准相比，节省了大约 70% 的时间。此外，REGEN 可以自然地与最近提出的大型语言模型集成，以提升性能。

[No.753] Revisit Few-shot Intent Classification with PLMs: Direct Fine-tuning vs. Continual Pre-training
来源: ACL 2023
命中: classif
标题: 基于PLMs的少量样本意图分类重访：直接微调 vs. 持续预训练
类别: 
作者: Haode Zhang;Haowen Liang;Liming Zhan;Albert Y.S. Lam;Xiao-Ming Wu;
机构: Hong Kong Polytechnic University;Fano Labs;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.706/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.05278
英摘: We consider the task of few-shot intent detection, which involves training a deep learning model to classify utterances based on their underlying intents using only a small amount of labeled data. The current approach to address this problem is through continual pre-training, i.e., fine-tuning pre-trained language models (PLMs) on external resources (e.g., conversational corpora, public intent detection datasets, or natural language understanding datasets) before using them as utterance encoders for training an intent classifier. In this paper, we show that continual pre-training may not be essential, since the overfitting problem of PLMs on this task may not be as serious as expected. Specifically, we find that directly fine-tuning PLMs on only a handful of labeled examples already yields decent results compared to methods that employ continual pre-training, and the performance gap diminishes rapidly as the number of labeled data increases. To maximize the utilization of the limited available data, we propose a context augmentation method and leverage sequential self-distillation to boost performance. Comprehensive experiments on real-world benchmarks show that given only two or more labeled samples per class, direct fine-tuning outperforms many strong baselines that utilize external data sources for continual pre-training. The code can be found at https://github.com/hdzhang-code/DFTPlus.
中摘: 我们考虑一项少样本意图检测任务，该任务涉及使用少量标记数据训练深度学习模型，根据语句的基本意图对其进行分类。当前解决这一问题的方法是通过持续预训练，即在外部资源（如对话语料库、公开的意图检测数据集或自然语言理解数据集）上微调预先训练的语言模型（PLM），然后再将这些模型用作语句编码器来训练意图分类器。在本文中，我们展示了持续预训练可能并非必不可少，因为语言模型在这项任务上的过拟合问题可能没有预期的那么严重。具体而言，我们发现直接在少量标记示例上微调语言模型已经能够获得令人满意的结果，与采用持续预训练方法的其他方法相比，性能差距随着可用标记数据量的增加迅速缩小。为了最大限度地利用有限的数据，我们提出了一种上下文增强方法，并利用序列自我精炼来提升性能。在现实世界基准上的全面实验表明，在每个类别只有两到几个标记样本的情况下，直接微调方法优于许多利用外部数据源进行持续预训练的强大基线方法。相关代码可以在https://github.com/hdzhang-code/DFTPlus找到。

[No.756] TART: Improved Few-shot Text Classification Using Task-Adaptive Reference Transformation
来源: ACL 2023
命中: classif
标题: TART：基于任务适应性参考转换的改进few-shot文本分类
类别: 
作者: Shuo Lei;Xuchao Zhang;Jianfeng He;Fanglan Chen;Chang-Tien Lu;
机构: Virginia Tech;Microsoft;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.617/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.02175
英摘: Meta-learning has emerged as a trending technique to tackle few-shot text classification and achieve state-of-the-art performance. However, the performance of existing approaches heavily depends on the inter-class variance of the support set. As a result, it can perform well on tasks when the semantics of sampled classes are distinct while failing to differentiate classes with similar semantics. In this paper, we propose a novel Task-Adaptive Reference Transformation (TART) network, aiming to enhance the generalization by transforming the class prototypes to per-class fixed reference points in task-adaptive metric spaces. To further maximize divergence between transformed prototypes in task-adaptive metric spaces, TART introduces a discriminative reference regularization among transformed prototypes. Extensive experiments are conducted on four benchmark datasets and our method demonstrates clear superiority over the state-of-the-art models in all the datasets. In particular, our model surpasses the state-of-the-art method by 7.4% and 5.4% in 1-shot and 5-shot classification on the 20 Newsgroups dataset, respectively.
中摘: 元学习已成为应对少样本文本分类问题的一种流行技术，并取得了最先进的性能。然而，现有方法的表现高度依赖于支持集内的类别间方差。因此，它在所采样的类别语义差异较大的任务上表现良好，但在区分具有相似语义的类别时却失败了。本文提出了一种新型的任务自适应参考转换（TART）网络，旨在通过在任务自适应度量空间中将类别原型转换为固定参考点来增强泛化能力。为了进一步在任务自适应度量空间中最大化转换后的原型之间的差异性，TART引入了转换后原型之间的辨别性参考正则化。我们在四个基准数据集上进行了广泛的实验，结果显示我们的方法在所有数据集中的表现都优于最先进的模型。特别是，在20 Newsgroups数据集上的1-shot和5-shot分类任务中，我们的模型分别超越了最先进的方法7.4%和5.4%。

[No.757] Teamwork Is Not Always Good: An Empirical Study of Classifier Drift in Class-incremental Information Extraction
来源: ACL 2023
命中: classif
标题: 团队合作并不总是好的：一类增量信息提取中分类器漂移的经验研究
类别: 
作者: Minqian Liu;Lifu Huang;
机构: Virginia Tech;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.141/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16559
英摘: Class-incremental learning (CIL) aims to develop a learning system that can continually learn new classes from a data stream without forgetting previously learned classes. When learning classes incrementally, the classifier must be constantly updated to incorporate new classes, and the drift in decision boundary may lead to severe forgetting. This fundamental challenge, however, has not yet been studied extensively, especially in the setting where no samples from old classes are stored for rehearsal. In this paper, we take a closer look at how the drift in the classifier leads to forgetting, and accordingly, design four simple yet (super-) effective solutions to alleviate the classifier drift: an Individual Classifiers with Frozen Feature Extractor (ICE) framework where we individually train a classifier for each learning session, and its three variants ICE-PL, ICE-O, and ICE-PL&O which further take the logits of previously learned classes from old sessions or a constant logit of an Other class as a constraint to the learning of new classifiers. Extensive experiments and analysis on 6 class-incremental information extraction tasks demonstrate that our solutions, especially ICE-O, consistently show significant improvement over the previous state-of-the-art approaches with up to 44.7% absolute F-score gain, providing a strong baseline and insights for future research on class-incremental learning.
中摘: 类增量学习（CIL）旨在开发一种能够从数据流中不断学习新类别的学习系统，同时不忘记之前已学过的类别。在逐步学习新类别时，分类器必须不断更新以纳入新类别，但决策边界的漂移可能会导致严重的遗忘现象。然而，这一基本挑战尚未得到充分研究，尤其是在没有存储旧类别样本进行复习的情况下。在本文中，我们更深入地探讨了分类器漂移如何导致遗忘，并据此设计了四种简单而有效的解决方案来缓解分类器漂移：一个带有冻结特征提取器的个体分类器框架（ICE），其中我们在每次学习会话中单独训练一个分类器；以及其三个变体ICE-PL、ICE-O和ICE-PL&O，这些变体进一步将旧会话或常数“其他”类别的logits作为约束条件应用于新分类器的学习过程。在对6个类增量信息提取任务进行广泛的实验和分析后，我们的解决方案，尤其是ICE-O，一致显示出显著优于先前最先进的方法的效果，绝对F分数提高了高达44.7%，提供了未来类增量学习研究的强大基准和见解。

[No.766] UniS-MMC: Multimodal Classification via Unimodality-supervised Multimodal Contrastive Learning
来源: ACL 2023
命中: classif
标题: UniS-MMC：通过单模性监督多模态对比学习的多模态分类
类别: 
作者: Heqing Zou;Meng Shen;Chen Chen;Yuchen Hu;Deepu Rajan;Eng Siong Chng;
机构: Nanyang Technological University;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.41/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.09299
英摘: Multimodal learning aims to imitate human beings to acquire complementary information from multiple modalities for various downstream tasks. However, traditional aggregation-based multimodal fusion methods ignore the inter-modality relationship, treat each modality equally, suffer sensor noise, and thus reduce multimodal learning performance. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal contrastive method to explore more reliable multimodal representations under the weak supervision of unimodal predicting. Specifically, we first capture task-related unimodal representations and the unimodal predictions from the introduced unimodal predicting task. Then the unimodal representations are aligned with the more effective one by the designed multimodal contrastive method under the supervision of the unimodal predictions. Experimental results with fused features on two image-text classification benchmarks UPMC-Food-101 and N24News show that our proposed Unimodality-Supervised MultiModal Contrastive UniS-MMC learning method outperforms current state-of-the-art multimodal methods. The detailed ablation study and analysis further demonstrate the advantage of our proposed method.
中摘: 多模态学习旨在模仿人类从多种模态中获取互补信息以完成各种下游任务。然而，传统的基于聚合的多模态融合方法忽略了模态间的相互关系，将每个模态等同对待，并受到传感器噪声的影响，从而降低了多模态学习的效果。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的多模态对比方法，在单模态预测的弱监督下探索更可靠的多模态表示。具体来说，我们首先捕获与任务相关的单模态表示和预测。然后，在单模态预测的监督下，通过设计的多模态对比方法将这些单模态表示与更有效的模态对齐。在两个图像-文本分类基准数据集UPMC-Food-101和N24News上使用融合特征的实验结果显示，我们提出的Unimodality-Supervised MultiModal Contrastive UniS-MMC学习方法优于当前最先进的多模态方法。详细的消融研究和分析进一步证明了我们提出方法的优势。
