[No.772] Zero-Shot Classification by Logical Reasoning on Natural Language Explanations
来源: ACL 2023
命中: classif
标题: 基于逻辑推理的自然语言解释零样本分类
类别: 
作者: Chi Han;Hengzhi Pei;Xinya Du;Heng Ji;
机构: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign;University of Texas at Dallas;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.571/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.03252
英摘: Humans can classify data of an unseen category by reasoning on its language explanations. This ability is owing to the compositional nature of language: we can combine previously seen attributes to describe the new category. For example, we might describe a sage thrasher as "it has a slim straight relatively short bill, yellow eyes and a long tail", so that others can use their knowledge of attributes "slim straight relatively short bill", "yellow eyes" and "long tail" to recognize a sage thrasher. Inspired by this observation, in this work we tackle zero-shot classification task by logically parsing and reasoning on natural language expla-nations. To this end, we propose the framework CLORE (Classification by LOgical Reasoning on Explanations). While previous methods usually regard textual information as implicit features, CLORE parses explanations into logical structures and then explicitly reasons along thess structures on the input to produce a classification score. Experimental results on explanation-based zero-shot classification benchmarks demonstrate that CLORE is superior to baselines, which we further show mainly comes from higher scores on tasks requiring more logical reasoning. We also demonstrate that our framework can be extended to zero-shot classification on visual modality. Alongside classification decisions, CLORE can provide the logical parsing and reasoning process as a clear form of rationale. Through empirical analysis we demonstrate that CLORE is also less affected by linguistic biases than baselines.
中摘: 人类可以通过对其语言解释进行推理来对未见过类别的数据进行分类。这种能力归功于语言的组合性质：我们可以将之前见过的属性组合起来描述新的类别。例如，我们可能会描述一个智氏画眉为“它有一个狭长相对笔直较短的喙、黄色的眼睛和长长的尾巴”，这样其他人就可以利用对“狭长相对笔直较短的喙”、“黄色的眼睛”和“长长的尾巴”这些属性的知识来识别智氏画眉。受这一观察的启发，在这项工作中，我们通过逻辑解析和推理自然语言解释来解决零样本分类任务。为此，我们提出了CLORE框架（基于解释的逻辑推理分类）。与以往方法通常将文本信息视为隐含特征不同，CLORE将解释解析为逻辑结构，然后沿着这些结构显式地对输入进行推理以生成分类分数。在基于解释的零样本分类基准上的实验结果显示，CLORE优于基线方法，这主要是因为其在需要更多逻辑推理的任务上得分更高。我们还展示了我们的框架可以扩展到视觉模态的零样本分类。除了分类决策外，CLORE还可以提供清晰的逻辑解析和推理过程作为明确的理由。通过实证分析，我们证明了与基线方法相比，CLORE受语言偏见的影响较小。

[No.773] Zero-Shot Text Classification via Self-Supervised Tuning
来源: ACL 2023
命中: classif
标题: 零样本文本分类通过自我监督调优
类别: 
作者: Chaoqun Liu;Wenxuan Zhang;Guizhen Chen;Xiaobao Wu;Anh Tuan Luu;Chip Hong Chang;Lidong Bing;
机构: Nanyang Technological University;Alibaba Group;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.110/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.11442
英摘: Existing solutions to zero-shot text classification either conduct prompting with pre-trained language models, which is sensitive to the choices of templates, or rely on large-scale annotated data of relevant tasks for meta-tuning. In this work, we propose a new paradigm based on self-supervised learning to solve zero-shot text classification tasks by tuning the language models with unlabeled data, called self-supervised tuning. By exploring the inherent structure of free texts, we propose a new learning objective called first sentence prediction to bridge the gap between unlabeled data and text classification tasks. After tuning the model to learn to predict the first sentence in a paragraph based on the rest, the model is able to conduct zero-shot inference on unseen tasks such as topic classification and sentiment analysis. Experimental results show that our model outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines on 7 out of 10 tasks. Moreover, the analysis reveals that our model is less sensitive to the prompt design. Our code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/DAMO-NLP-SG/SSTuning .
中摘: 现有的零样本文本分类解决方案要么通过预训练语言模型进行提示，这对外部模板的选择非常敏感，要么依赖于大量相关任务的标注数据进行元调优。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于自监督学习的新范式，通过未标注数据对语言模型进行调优以解决零样本文本分类任务，这种方法称为自监督调优。通过探索自由文本的内在结构，我们提出了一个新的学习目标——首句预测，以此来弥合未标注数据与文本分类任务之间的差距。在对段落中的其余部分进行训练后，模型能够对未见过的任务（如主题分类和情感分析）进行零样本推理。实验结果显示，在10个任务中有7个任务上，我们的模型优于最先进的基线方法。此外，分析表明，我们的模型对外部提示设计的敏感性较低。我们的代码和预训练模型已在https://github.com/DAMO-NLP-SG/SSTuning 公开发布。

来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: classif
标题: “我从没说过那句话”：一个关于回应清晰度分类的数据集、分类法和基线模型
类别: 
作者: Konstantinos Thomas;Giorgos Filandrianos;Maria Lymperaiou;Chrysoula Zerva;Giorgos Stamou;
机构: National Technical University of Athens;Instituto de Telecomunicações;Universidade de Lisboa;ELLIS Unit;
类型: finding
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-emnlp.300/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.13879
英摘: Equivocation and ambiguity in public speech are well-studied discourse phenomena, especially in political science and analysis of political interviews. Inspired by the well-grounded theory on equivocation, we aim to resolve the closely related problem of response clarity in questions extracted from political interviews, leveraging the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) and human expertise. To this end, we introduce a novel taxonomy that frames the task of detecting and classifying response clarity and a corresponding clarity classification dataset which consists of question-answer (QA) pairs drawn from political interviews and annotated accordingly. Our proposed two-level taxonomy addresses the clarity of a response in terms of the information provided for a given question (high-level) and also provides a fine-grained taxonomy of evasion techniques that relate to unclear, ambiguous responses (lower-level). We combine ChatGPT and human annotators to collect, validate and annotate discrete QA pairs from political interviews, to be used for our newly introduced response clarity task. We provide a detailed analysis and conduct several experiments with different model architectures, sizes and adaptation methods to gain insights and establish new baselines over the proposed dataset and task.
中摘: 公共演讲中的含糊其辞和歧义是广泛研究的修辞现象，尤其是在政治科学和政治访谈分析领域。受含糊其辞理论的坚实基础启发，我们旨在利用大型语言模型（LLMs）和人类专业知识解决从政治访谈中提取的问题的清晰度问题。为此，我们引入了一个新的分类体系，该体系将检测和分类响应清晰度的任务框架化，并相应地构建了一个由政治访谈中的问答（QA）对组成的清晰度分类数据集。我们提出的两层分类体系从所提供信息的角度（高层）解决了给定问题的响应清晰度问题，并提供了一种关于含糊不清、模糊回答的规避技术的精细分类体系（低层）。我们结合使用ChatGPT和人工标注者来收集、验证并标注来自政治访谈的离散QA对，用于我们新引入的响应清晰度任务。我们提供了详细的分析，并进行了多项实验，涉及不同的模型架构、规模和适应方法，以获得见解并为所提出的数据集和任务建立新的基准。

[No.776] A new approach for fine-tuning sentence transformers for intent classification and out-of-scope detection tasks
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: classif
标题: 一种针对意图分类和超出范围检测任务微调句子变换器的新方法
类别: 
作者: Tianyi Zhang;Atta Norouzian;Aanchan Mohan;Frederick Ducatelle;
机构: Northeastern University;University of Victoria;Cerence Inc;
类型: Industry
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-industry.68/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.13649
英摘: In virtual assistant (VA) systems it is important to reject or redirect user queries that fall outside the scope of the system. One of the most accurate approaches for out-of-scope (OOS) rejection is to combine it with the task of intent classification on in-scope queries, and to use methods based on the similarity of embeddings produced by transformer-based sentence encoders. Typically, such encoders are fine-tuned for the intent-classification task, using cross-entropy loss. Recent work has shown that while this produces suitable embeddings for the intent-classification task, it also tends to disperse in-scope embeddings over the full sentence embedding space. This causes the in-scope embeddings to potentially overlap with OOS embeddings, thereby making OOS rejection difficult. This is compounded when OOS data is unknown. To mitigate this issue our work proposes to regularize the cross-entropy loss with an in-scope embedding reconstruction loss learned using an auto-encoder. Our method achieves a 1-4% improvement in the area under the precision-recall curve for rejecting out-of-sample (OOS) instances, without compromising intent classification performance.
中摘: 在虚拟助手（VA）系统中，对于那些超出系统范围的用户查询，重要的是要拒绝或重新定向这些查询。一种最准确的超出范围（OOS）拒绝方法是将其与处理范围内查询的意图分类任务结合起来，并使用基于变压器句编码器生成的嵌入相似性的方法。通常，这类编码器会针对意图分类任务进行微调，使用交叉熵损失。最近的研究表明，虽然这种方法为意图分类任务生成了合适的嵌入，但它也会倾向于将范围内嵌入分散在整个句子嵌入空间中。这会导致范围内嵌入可能与超出范围嵌入重叠，从而使超出范围的拒绝变得困难。当超出范围的数据未知时，这一问题更为严重。为此，我们的工作提出了一种通过使用自动编码器学习的范围内嵌入重构损失来正则化交叉熵损失的方法。该方法在不牺牲意图分类性能的情况下，实现了拒绝样本外（OOS）实例的精确召回曲线面积下改进1-4%。

来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: classif
标题: 对姓名和困惑中的民族偏见研究及使用现成的情感相关的推文分类器进行分析
类别: 
作者: Valentin Barriere;Sebastian Cifuentes;
机构: Universidad de Chile;CENIA;

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.01834
英摘: In this paper, we apply a method to quantify biases associated with named entities from various countries. We create counterfactual examples with small perturbations on target-domain data instead of relying on templates or specific datasets for bias detection. On widely used classifiers for subjectivity analysis, including sentiment, emotion, hate speech, and offensive text using Twitter data, our results demonstrate positive biases related to the language spoken in a country across all classifiers studied. Notably, the presence of certain country names in a sentence can strongly influence predictions, up to a 23\% change in hate speech detection and up to a 60\% change in the prediction of negative emotions such as anger. We hypothesize that these biases stem from the training data of pre-trained language models (PLMs) and find correlations between affect predictions and PLMs likelihood in English and unknown languages like Basque and Maori, revealing distinct patterns with exacerbate correlations. Further, we followed these correlations in-between counterfactual examples from a same sentence to remove the syntactical component, uncovering interesting results suggesting the impact of the pre-training data was more important for English-speaking-country names. Our anonymized code is [https://anonymous.4open.science/r/biases_ppl-576B/README.md](available here).
中摘: 在本文中，我们应用了一种方法来量化不同国家命名实体相关的偏差。我们通过在目标领域数据上引入微小的扰动来创建反事实例子，而不是依赖于模板或特定的数据集来进行偏差检测。在广泛使用的主观性分析分类器中，包括使用Twitter数据的情感、情绪、仇恨言论和不恰当文本分类器，我们的结果显示，在所有研究的分类器中，与国家语言相关的正向偏差普遍存在。值得注意的是，句子中某些国家名称的存在可以强烈影响预测结果，仇恨言论检测的最大变化可达23%，负面情绪（如愤怒）预测的最大变化可达60%。我们假设这些偏差源自预训练语言模型（PLMs）的训练数据，并发现情感预测与英语及其他未知语言（如巴斯克语和毛利语）的PLMs概率之间存在相关性，揭示了不同的模式并加剧了这种相关性。此外，我们在同一句话的反事实例子之间跟踪这些相关性，移除句法成分，得到了有趣的结论，表明英语-speaking国家名称的预训练数据影响更为显著。我们的匿名代码[https://anonymous.4open.science/r/biases_ppl-576B/README.md]可供查阅。

[No.778] Adapters Mixup: Mixing Parameter-Efficient Adapters to Enhance the Adversarial Robustness of Fine-tuned Pre-trained Text Classifiers
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: classif
标题: 适配器混淆：将参数高效适配器混合以增强微调预训练文本分类器的对抗鲁棒性
类别: 
作者: Tuc Van Nguyen;Thai Le;
机构: Indiana University Bloomington;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.1180/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.10111
英摘: Existing works show that augmenting the training data of pre-trained language models (PLMs) for classification tasks fine-tuned via parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods (PEFT) using both clean and adversarial examples can enhance their robustness under adversarial attacks. However, this adversarial training paradigm often leads to performance degradation on clean inputs and requires frequent re-training on the entire data to account for new, unknown attacks. To overcome these challenges while still harnessing the benefits of adversarial training and the efficiency of PEFT, this work proposes a novel approach, called AdpMixup, that combines two paradigms: (1) fine-tuning through adapters and (2) adversarial augmentation via mixup to dynamically leverage existing knowledge from a set of pre-known attacks for robust inference. Intuitively, AdpMixup fine-tunes PLMs with multiple adapters with both clean and pre-known adversarial examples and intelligently mixes them up in different ratios during prediction. Our experiments show AdpMixup achieves the best trade-off between training efficiency and robustness under both pre-known and unknown attacks, compared to existing baselines on five downstream tasks across six varied black-box attacks and 2 PLMs. All source code will be available.
中摘: 现有研究显示，通过参数高效微调方法（PEFT）增强预训练语言模型（PLMs）分类任务的训练数据，使用干净和对抗性样本可以提升其在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。然而，这种对抗训练范式通常会导致在干净输入上的性能下降，并且需要频繁对整个数据集进行重新训练以应对新的未知攻击。为了克服这些挑战同时仍然利用对抗训练和PEFT的效率优势，本研究提出了一种名为AdpMixup的新方法，该方法结合了两种范式：（1）通过适配器进行微调，以及（2）通过mixup进行对抗性增强，以动态地利用已知攻击的知识进行鲁棒推理。直观而言，AdpMixup使用多个适配器和已知的对抗性样本以及干净样本，在预测时以不同的比例智能地混合它们。我们的实验表明，AdpMixup在五个下游任务上实现了训练效率和鲁棒性之间的最佳权衡，尤其是在六种不同类型的黑盒攻击和两种PLMs的情况下，优于现有的基线方法。所有源代码将公开提供。

[No.779] African or European Swallow? Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models for Fine-Grained Object Classification
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: classif
标题: 非洲燕子还是欧洲燕子？大型视觉-语言模型在细粒度对象分类中的基准测试
类别: 
作者: Gregor Geigle;Radu Timofte;Goran Glavaš;
机构: Wuhan University Natural Language Processing Group;University of Würzburg;
类型: Main

英摘: Recent Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate impressive abilities on numerous image understanding and reasoning tasks. The task of fine-grained object classification (e.g., distinction between \textit{animal species}), however, has been probed insufficiently, despite its downstream importance. We fill this evaluation gap by creating \texttt{FOCI} (\textbf{F}ine-grained \textbf{O}bject \textbf{C}lass\textbf{I}fication), a difficult multiple-choice benchmark for fine-grained object classification, from existing object classification datasets: (1) multiple-choice avoids ambiguous answers associated with casting classification as open-ended QA task; (2) we retain classification difficulty by mining negative labels with a CLIP model. \texttt{FOCI}\xspace complements five popular classification datasets with four domain-specific subsets from ImageNet-21k. We benchmark 12 public LVLMs on \texttt{FOCI} and show that it tests for a \textit{complementary skill} to established image understanding and reasoning benchmarks. Crucially, CLIP models exhibit dramatically better performance than LVLMs. Since the image encoders of LVLMs come from these CLIP models, this points to inadequate alignment for fine-grained object distinction between the encoder and the LLM and warrants (pre)training data with more fine-grained annotation. We release our code at \url{https://github.com/gregor-ge/FOCI-Benchmark}.
中摘: 近年来，大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在多项图像理解与推理任务上展现了令人印象深刻的性能。然而，细粒度对象分类任务（例如，区分不同种类的动物）却未得到充分探究，尽管其下游应用十分重要。我们通过从现有的对象分类数据集中创建\texttt{FOCI}（细粒度对象分类）基准来填补这一评估空白：这是一个困难的多项选择基准，用于细粒度对象分类。（1）多项选择避免了将分类任务视为开放式问答时可能出现的模糊答案；（2）我们通过使用CLIP模型挖掘负面标签，保留了分类难度。\texttt{FOCI}\xspace 与五个流行的分类数据集以及来自ImageNet-21k的四个领域特定子集相补充。我们在\texttt{FOCI}上对12个公开的LVLMs进行了基准测试，并表明它测试了一种与现有图像理解和推理基准互补的能力。至关重要的是，CLIP模型的表现明显优于LVLMs。由于LVLMs的图像编码器源自这些CLIP模型，这表明编码器和LLM之间对于细粒度对象区分的对齐不足，并且需要更多的细粒度注释来进行（预）训练数据的准备。我们已将我们的代码发布在\url{https://github.com/gregor-ge/FOCI-Benchmark}。

[No.781] An Effective Deployment of Diffusion LM for Data Augmentation in Low-Resource Sentiment Classification
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: classif
标题: 有效部署扩散语言模型进行低资源情感分类的数据增强
类别: 
作者: Zhuowei Chen;Lianxi Wang;Yuben Wu;Xinfeng Liao;Yujia Tian;Junyang Zhong;
机构: Guangdong University of Foreign Studies;Guangzhou Key Laboratory of Multilingual Intelligent Processing;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.109/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.03203
英摘: Sentiment classification (SC) often suffers from low-resource challenges such as domain-specific contexts, imbalanced label distributions, and few-shot scenarios. The potential of the diffusion language model (LM) for textual data augmentation (DA) remains unexplored, moreover, textual DA methods struggle to balance the diversity and consistency of new samples. Most DA methods either perform logical modifications or rephrase less important tokens in the original sequence with the language model. In the context of SC, strong emotional tokens could act critically on the sentiment of the whole sequence. Therefore, contrary to rephrasing less important context, we propose DiffusionCLS to leverage a diffusion LM to capture in-domain knowledge and generate pseudo samples by reconstructing strong label-related tokens. This approach ensures a balance between consistency and diversity, avoiding the introduction of noise and augmenting crucial features of datasets. DiffusionCLS also comprises a Noise-Resistant Training objective to help the model generalize. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in various low-resource scenarios including domain-specific and domain-general problems. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of our framework's modules, and visualization studies highlight optimal deployment conditions, reinforcing our conclusions.
中摘: 情感分类（SC）经常面临低资源挑战，如领域特定的上下文、标签分布不平衡以及少量样本的情况。此外，扩散语言模型（LM）在文本数据增强（DA）方面的潜力尚未被充分利用，而且大多数文本DA方法难以平衡新样本的多样性和一致性。大多数DA方法要么对原始序列进行逻辑修改，要么使用语言模型重新表述原序列中不那么重要的标记。在情感分类的背景下，强烈的情感标记可能对整个序列的情感具有关键影响。因此，与重新表述不那么重要的上下文不同，我们提出了一种名为DiffusionCLS的方法，利用扩散LM捕获领域内知识并生成伪样本，通过重构强标签相关的标记来进行重建。这种方法确保了多样性和一致性的平衡，避免引入噪声，并增强数据集的关键特征。DiffusionCLS还包含一个抗噪训练目标，帮助模型泛化。实验表明，在包括领域特定和领域通用问题的各种低资源场景中，我们的方法非常有效。消融研究证实了框架各个模块的有效性，而可视化研究则突显了最佳部署条件，进一步强化了我们的结论。

[No.788] Breaking the Ceiling of the LLM Community by Treating Token Generation as a Classification for Ensembling
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: classif
标题: 打破LLM社区的天花板：将token生成视为分类进行集成学习
类别:

英摘: Ensembling multiple models has always been an effective approach to push the limits of existing performance and is widely used in classification tasks by simply averaging the classification probability vectors from multiple classifiers to achieve better accuracy. However, in the thriving open-source Large Language Model (LLM) community, ensembling methods are rare and typically limited to ensembling the full-text outputs of LLMs, such as selecting the best output using a ranker, which leads to underutilization of token-level probability information. In this paper, we treat the Generation of each token by LLMs as a Classification (GaC) for ensembling. This approach fully exploits the probability information at each generation step and better prevents LLMs from producing early incorrect tokens that lead to snowballing errors. In experiments, we ensemble state-of-the-art LLMs on several benchmarks, including exams, mathematics and reasoning, and observe that our method breaks the existing community performance ceiling. Furthermore, we observed that most of the tokens in the answer are simple and do not affect the correctness of the final answer. Therefore, we also experimented with ensembling only key tokens, and the results showed better performance with lower latency across benchmarks.

英摘: Despite their high predictive accuracies, current machine learning systems often exhibit systematic biases stemming from annotation artifacts or insufficient support for certain classes in the dataset. 英摘: Streaming text generation has become a common way of increasing the responsiveness of language model powered applications, such as chat assistants. Currently, this requires either separate models during inference, which increases computational cost, or destructive fine-tuning of the language model. 英摘: Extreme multi-label classification (XMC) aims to identify relevant subsets from numerous labels. Among the various approaches for XMC, tree-based linear models are effective due to their superior efficiency and simplicity. However, the space complexity of tree-based methods is not well-studied. Many past works assume that storing the model is not affordable and apply techniques such as pruning to save space, which may lead to performance loss. In this work, we conduct both theoretical and empirical analyses on the space to store a tree model under the assumption of sparse data, a condition frequently met in text data. [No.821] On the Fragility of Active Learners for Text Classification
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: classif
标题: 文本分类中的积极学习者的脆弱性
类别: 
作者: Abhishek Ghose;Emma Thuong Nguyen;
机构: 7.ai;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.1240/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.15744
英摘: Active learning (AL) techniques optimally utilize a labeling budget by iteratively selecting instances that are most valuable for learning. However, they lack ``prerequisite checks'', i.e., there are no prescribed criteria to pick an AL algorithm best suited for a dataset. A practitioner must pick a technique they \emph{trust} would beat random sampling, based on prior reported results, and hope that it is resilient to the many variables in their environment: dataset, labeling budget and prediction pipelines. The important questions then are: how often on average, do we expect any AL technique to reliably beat the computationally cheap and easy-to-implement strategy of random sampling? Does it at least make sense to use AL in an ``Always ON'' mode in a prediction pipeline, so that while it might not always help, it never under-performs random sampling? How much of a role does the prediction pipeline play in AL's success?
  We examine these questions in detail for the task of text classification using pre-trained representations, which are ubiquitous today.
  Our primary contribution here is a rigorous evaluation of AL techniques, old and new, across setups that vary wrt datasets, text representations and classifiers. This unlocks multiple insights around warm-up times, i.e., number of labels before gains from AL are seen, viability of an ``Always ON'' mode and the relative significance of different factors. Additionally, we release a framework for rigorous benchmarking of AL techniques for text classification.
中摘: 主动学习（AL）技术通过迭代选择对学习最有价值的实例，最优地利用了标注预算。然而，它们缺乏“先决条件检查”，即没有规定的选择最适合数据集的AL算法的标准。实践者必须根据以往报道的结果选择一种他们信任的AL技术，并希望这种技术能够抵御其环境中众多变量的影响：数据集、标注预算和预测管道。因此，重要问题在于：我们期望任何AL技术平均而言能可靠地优于随机采样策略的频率是多少？至少在预测管道中使用AL的“始终开启”模式是否有意义，这样即使它不一定总是有帮助，但它也不会表现得不如随机采样？预测管道在AL的成功中扮演着怎样的角色？

来源: EMNLP 2024

类别:

中摘: 我们在极度弱监督（XWS）条件下研究开放世界多标签文本分类问题，其中用户仅提供简要的分类目标描述，而不提供任何标签或真实标签空间。最近，类似的单标签XWS设置已被探索，但这些方法难以直接应用于多标签分类。我们观察到以下两点：（1）大多数文档有一个主导类别，涵盖了内容的主要部分；（2）长尾标签会在某些文档中作为主导类别出现。因此，我们首先利用用户描述来提示大型语言模型（LLM）提取一部分原始文档的主要关键词，然后通过聚类构建一个初始的标签空间。进一步地，我们应用零样本多标签分类器来定位预测得分较低的文档，以便重新审视其主要关键词，以发现更多的长尾标签。我们不断迭代这一过程，以发现一个全面的标签空间，并构建一种新型方法X-MLClass作为多标签分类器。X-MLClass在多种数据集上显著提高了真实标签空间的覆盖范围，例如，在AAPD数据集上的表现比主题建模和关键词提取方法提高了40%。此外，X-MLClass实现了端到端最佳的多标签分类准确率。

[No.831] Text Grafting: Near-Distribution Weak Supervision for Minority Classes in Text Classification
来源: EMNLP 2024

标题: 文本嫁接：近分布弱监督在文本分类中的少数类处理
类别:

英摘: For extremely weak-supervised text classification, pioneer research generates pseudo labels by mining texts similar to the class names from the raw corpus, which may end up with very limited or even no samples for the minority classes. In this paper, we combine the advantages of these two approaches and propose to bridge the gap via a novel framework, \emph{text grafting}, which aims to obtain clean and near-distribution weak supervision for minority classes. Specifically, we first use LLM-based logits to mine masked templates from the raw corpus, which have a high potential for data synthesis into the target minority class. Then, the templates are filled by state-of-the-art LLMs to synthesize near-distribution texts falling into minority classes. [No.840] PIEClass: Weakly-Supervised Text Classification with Prompting and Noise-Robust Iterative Ensemble Training
来源: EMNLP 2023
命中: classif
标题: 弱监督文本分类：通过提示和噪声鲁棒迭代集成训练
类别: 
作者: Yunyi Zhang;Minhao Jiang;Yu Meng;Yu Zhang;Jiawei Han;
机构: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign;
类型: Long Main
链接: https://openreview.net/forum?id=DDvcWpZNgl
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13723
英摘: Weakly-supervised text classification trains a classifier using the label name of each target class as the only supervision, which largely reduces human annotation efforts. Most existing methods first use the label names as static keyword-based features to generate pseudo labels, which are then used for final classifier training. While reasonable, such a commonly adopted framework suffers from two limitations: (1) keywords can have different meanings in different contexts and some text may not have any keyword, so keyword matching can induce noisy and inadequate pseudo labels; (2) the errors made in the pseudo label generation stage will directly propagate to the classifier training stage without a chance of being corrected. In this paper, we propose a new method, PIEClass, consisting of two modules: (1) a pseudo label acquisition module that uses zero-shot prompting of pre-trained language models (PLM) to get pseudo labels based on contextualized text understanding beyond static keyword matching, and (2) a noise-robust iterative ensemble training module that iteratively trains classifiers and updates pseudo labels by utilizing two PLM fine-tuning methods that regularize each other. Extensive experiments show that PIEClass achieves overall better performance than existing strong baselines on seven benchmark datasets and even achieves similar performance to fully-supervised classifiers on sentiment classification tasks.
中摘: 弱监督文本分类使用每个目标类别的标签名称作为唯一的监督信息来训练分类器，这大大减少了人工标注的工作量。大多数现有方法首先将标签名称用作静态关键词特征以生成伪标签，然后用于最终分类器的训练。虽然这种方法合理，但普遍采用的框架存在两个局限性：（1）关键词在不同上下文中可能有不同的含义，有些文本可能根本不包含关键词，因此关键词匹配可能会导致噪声和不充分的伪标签；（2）伪标签生成阶段产生的错误会直接传播到分类器训练阶段，而没有机会被纠正。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的方法——PIEClass，该方法由两个模块组成：（1）一个伪标签获取模块，利用预训练语言模型（PLM）的零样本提示进行基于上下文理解的伪标签获取，超越了静态关键词匹配；（2）一个噪声鲁棒迭代集成训练模块，通过利用两种相互正则化的PLM微调方法，该模块迭代地训练分类器并更新伪标签。广泛的实验表明，PIEClass在七个基准数据集上的总体性能优于现有的强基线，并且在情感分类任务上甚至达到了与全监督分类器相似的性能。

Our approach provides two significant advantages. Firstly, it does not require annotations of sensitive attributes in both testing and training data. This is more suitable for real-life scenarios compared to existing methods that require annotations of sensitive attributes at train time. Second, our approach exhibits a comparable or better fairness-accuracy trade-off compared to existing methods.

来源: EMNLP 2023

英摘: Proprietary and closed APIs are becoming increasingly common to process natural language, and are impacting the practical applications of natural language processing, including few-shot classification. Few-shot classification involves training a model to perform a new classification task with a handful of labeled data. This paper presents three contributions. First, we introduce a scenario where the embedding of a pre-trained model is served through a gated API with compute-cost and data-privacy constraints. Second, we propose a transductive inference, a learning paradigm that has been overlooked by the NLP community. Transductive inference, unlike traditional inductive learning, leverages the statistics of unlabeled data. We also introduce a new parameter-free transductive regularizer based on the Fisher-Rao loss, which can be used on top of the gated API embeddings. This method fully utilizes unlabeled data, does not share any label with the third-party API provider and could serve as a baseline for future research. Third, we propose an improved experimental setting and compile a benchmark of eight datasets involving multiclass classification in four different languages, with up to 151 classes. We evaluate our methods using eight backbone models, along with an episodic evaluation over 1,000 episodes, which demonstrate the superiority of transductive inference over the standard inductive setting.

来源: EMNLP 2023

英摘: Recent work has found that few-shot sentence classification based on pre-trained Sentence Encoders (SEs) is efficient, robust, and effective. We first establish that unsupervised Domain-Adaptive Pre-Training (DAPT) of a base Pre-trained Language Model (PLM) (i.e., not an SE) substantially improves the accuracy of few-shot sentence classification by up to 8.4 points. 来源: EMNLP 2023

英摘: Transformer-based models have achieved dominant performance in numerous NLP tasks. Token pruning eliminates less important tokens in the attention mechanism's key and value as they pass through the layers. [No.880] MEGClass: Extremely Weakly Supervised Text Classification via Mutually-Enhancing Text Granularities

类别:

英摘: Text classification is essential for organizing unstructured text. 中摘: 文本分类对于组织未结构化文本至关重要。传统方法依赖于人工注释或最近的一组类别种子词进行监督，这在特定领域或新兴领域尤其昂贵。为了解决这一问题，仅使用类别表面名称作为极其弱的监督来源已被提出。然而，现有的方法独立处理不同级别的文本粒度（文档、句子或单词），忽略了通过联合提取识别的跨粒度类别的分歧以及唯一可通过联合提取识别的上下文信号。为了应对这些问题，我们引入了MEGClass，这是一种利用互增强文本粒度的极其弱监督文本分类方法。MEGClass 利用通过同时考虑文档中最能指示类别的单词和句子获得的粗粒度和细粒度上下文信号。这种方法使模型能够学习一个上下文化的文档表示，捕捉到最具区分性的类别指标。通过保留潜在类别的异质性，MEGClass 可以选择最具信息量的类别指示文档作为迭代反馈，逐步增强初始基于单词的类别表示，并最终微调预训练的文本分类器。在七个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，MEGClass 在其他极其弱监督方法中表现出更优的效果。

[No.884] Text Classification via Large Language Models
来源: EMNLP 2023
命中: classif
标题: 通过大型语言模型进行文本分类
类别: 
作者: Xiaofei Sun;Xiaoya Li;Jiwei Li;Fei Wu;Shangwei Guo;Tianwei Zhang;Guoyin Wang;
机构: Zhejiang University;Shannon.AI;Chongqing University;Nanyang Technological University;Amazon;
类型: Long Findings

英摘: Despite the remarkable success of large-scale Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT-3, their performances still significantly underperform fine-tuned models in the task of text classification. This is due to (1) the lack of reasoning ability in addressing complex linguistic phenomena (e.g., intensification, contrast, irony etc); (2) limited number of tokens allowed in in-context learning.
  In this paper, we introduce Clue And Reasoning Prompting (CARP). CARP adopts a progressive reasoning strategy tailored to addressing the complex linguistic phenomena involved in text classification: CARP first prompts LLMs to find superficial clues (e.g., keywords, tones, semantic relations, references, etc), based on which a diagnostic reasoning process is induced for final decisions. To further address the limited-token issue, CARP uses a fine-tuned model on the supervised dataset for $k$NN demonstration search in the in-context learning, allowing the model to take the advantage of both LLM's generalization ability and the task-specific evidence provided by the full labeled dataset. Remarkably, CARP yields new SOTA performances on 4 out of 5 widely-used text-classification benchmarks, 97.39 (+1.24) on SST-2, 96.40 (+0.72) on AGNews, 98.78 (+0.25) on R8 and 96.95 (+0.6) on R52, and a performance comparable to SOTA on MR (92.39 v.s. 93.3). More importantly, we find that CARP delivers impressive abilities on low-resource and domain-adaptation setups. Specifically, using 16 examples per class, CARP achieves comparable performances to supervised models with 1,024 examples per class.
中摘: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）如GPT-3取得了显著的成功，但在文本分类任务上，它们的表现仍然明显逊于微调模型。这主要是因为（1）LLMs在处理复杂的语言现象（例如强化、对比、讽刺等）时缺乏推理能力；（2）LLMs在上下文学习中允许的令牌数量有限。

在这篇论文中，我们引入了一种名为Clue And Reasoning Prompting（CARP）的方法。CARP采用了一种渐进式的推理策略，专门用于解决文本分类中涉及的复杂语言现象：CARP首先提示LLMs找到表面线索（例如关键词、语气、语义关系、参考等），基于这些线索引发诊断性推理过程以做出最终决策。为了进一步解决令牌数量限制的问题，CARP使用了一个在监督数据集上微调的模型来进行$k$NN示例搜索，在上下文学习中利用该模型的优势，既保留了LLMs的一般化能力，又结合了完整标记数据集中提供的特定任务证据。值得注意的是，CARP在5个广泛使用的文本分类基准中的4个上达到了新的最佳性能：在SST-2上达到97.39（+1.24），在AGNews上达到96.40（+0.72），在R8上达到98.78（+0.25），在R52上达到96.95（+0.6），而在MR上的表现与最佳性能相当（92.39 vs. 93.3）。更重要的是，我们发现CARP在低资源和领域适应设置中表现出色。具体来说，使用每类16个示例，CARP在每类1024个示例的监督模型面前实现了相当的性能。

[No.889] Instances and Labels: Hierarchy-aware Joint Supervised Contrastive Learning for Hierarchical Multi-Label Text Classification
来源: EMNLP 2023

英摘: Hierarchical multi-label text classification (HMTC) aims at utilizing a label hierarchy in multi-label classification. Recent approaches to HMTC deal with the problem of imposing an over-constrained premise on the output space by using contrastive learning on generated samples in a semi-supervised manner to bring text and label embeddings closer. However, the generation of samples tends to introduce noise as it ignores the correlation between similar samples in the same batch. One solution to this issue is supervised contrastive learning, but it remains an underexplored topic in HMTC due to its complex structured labels. To overcome this challenge, we propose $\textbf{HJCL}$, a $\textbf{H}$ierarchy-aware $\textbf{J}$oint Supervised $\textbf{C}$ontrastive $\textbf{L}$earning method that bridges the gap between supervised contrastive learning and HMTC. To address this challenge, we introduce DRAFT, a simple framework designed to train a classifier for few-shot topic classification. DRAFT uses a few examples of a specific topic as queries to construct Customized dataset with a dense retriever model. Multi-query retrieval (MQR) algorithm, which effectively handles multiple queries related to a specific topic, is applied to construct the Customized dataset. Subsequently, we fine-tune a classifier using the Customized dataset to identify the topic. To demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed approach, we conduct evaluations on both widely used classification benchmark datasets and manually constructed datasets with 291 diverse topics, which simulate diverse contents encountered in real-world applications. DRAFT shows competitive or superior performance compared to baselines that use in-context learning, such as GPT-3 175B and InstructGPT 175B, on few-shot topic classification tasks despite having 177 times fewer parameters, demonstrating its effectiveness.
中摘: 随着多样化信息量的不断增加，对任意主题进行分类的需求变得越来越关键。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了DRAFT，这是一个简单的框架，旨在训练一个用于少量示例主题分类的分类器。DRAFT 使用特定主题的几个示例作为查询，通过密集检索模型构建定制化数据集。我们应用多查询检索（MQR）算法来构建定制化数据集，该算法有效处理与特定主题相关的多个查询。随后，我们使用定制化数据集微调分类器以识别主题。为了证明我们提出的方法的有效性，我们在广泛使用的分类基准数据集和包含291个多样主题的手动构建数据集上进行了评估，这些主题模拟了实际应用场景中遇到的各种内容。尽管DRAFT的参数数量仅为基线模型如GPT-3 175B和InstructGPT 175B的1/177，但在少量示例主题分类任务上仍表现出竞争力或更优性能，展示了其有效性。
